Bava Metzia 29b:10-18: Tanu rabbanan: hashshoel sefer tora mechavero, hare ze lo yashilennu leacher, potcho vekore bo, uvilvad shello yilmod bo battechilla, velo yikra acher immo.

Vechen hammafkid sefer tora etzel chavero, gollo kol shenem asar chodesh, potcho vekore bo, im bishvilo petacho – asur. somchos omer: bechadash – sheloshim yom, beyashan – shenem asar chodesh. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: echad ze veechad ze – shenem asar chodesh.

Amar mar: hashshoel sefer tora mechavero – hare ze lo yashilennu leacher. may irya sefer tora? afillu kol mille name, deamar rabbi shimon ben lakish: kan shana rabbi – en hashshoel rashshay lehasheil, veen hassocher rashshay lehasekir!
Sefer tora itztericha leh, mahu detema: nicha leh leinish detiavid mitzva bemamoneh, ka mashma lan.
Potcho vekore bo. peshita! veella lemay shayyleh minneh? sefa itztericha leh: uvilvad shello yilmod bo battechilla.

Vechen hammafkid sefer tora etzel chavero – gollo kol shenem asar chodesh, potcho vekore bo. may avidteh gabbeh? vetu, im bishvilo petacho – asur, ha amrat: potcho vekore bo! hachi kaamar: im keshehu gollo potcho vekore bo – muttar, im bishvilo petacho – asur.

Somchos omer: bechadash – sheloshim yom, beyashan – shenem asar chodesh. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: echad ze veechad ze – shenem asar chodesh. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov, hayeynu tanna kamma! ella ema: rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer echad ze veechad ze sheloshim yom.

Aval lo yilmod bo battechilla velo yikra acher immo. ureminhu: lo yikra parasha veyishne, velo yikra bo parasha vitargem, velo yiftach bo yoter mishshelosha dappin, velo yikreu bo shelosha bene adam becherech echad – ha shenayim korin!
Amar abbaye: la kashya, kan beinyan echad, kan bishne inyanim.
Berakhot 5b:21-6a:1: Tanya abba binyamin omer: al shene devarim hayiti mitztaer kol yamay — al tefillati shettehe lifne mittati, veal mittati shettehe netuna ben tzafon ledarom. "al tefillati shettehe lifne mittati", may "lifne mittati"? illema "lifne mittati" mammash, vehaamar rav yehuda, amar rav, veittema rabbi yehoshua ben levi: minnayin lammitpallel shello yehe davar chotzetz beno leven hakkir — shenneemar: "vayyassev chizkiyyahu panav el hakkir vayyitpallel"? la tema, "lifne mittati", ella ema "samuch lemittati".
"Veal mittati shettehe netuna ben tzafon laddarom".
Deamar rabbi chama berabbi chanina, amar rabbi yitzchak: kol hannoten mittato ben tzafon ledarom havyin leh banim zecharim, shenneemar: "utzefunecha temalle vitnam yisbeu vanim".
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: af en ishto mappelet nefalim. ketiv hacha: "utzefunecha temalle bitnam", uchetiv hatam: "vayyimleu yameha laledet vehinne tomim bevitnah".

Tanya. abba binyamin omer: shenayim shennichnesu lehitpallel. vekadam echad mehem lehitpallel, velo himtin et chavero. veyatza. torfin lo tefillato befanav, shenneemar: "toref nafsho beappo halemaancha teazav aretz".
Velo od, ella sheggorem lashshechina shettistallek miyyisrael, shenneemar: "veyetak tzor mimkomo". veen "tzur" ella hakkadosh baruch hu, shenneemar: tzor yeladcha teshi".

Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: zoche labberachot hallalu, shenneemar: "lu hikshavta lemitzvotay vayhi channahar shelomecha vetzidkatcha kegalle hayyam. vayhi chachol zarecha vetzeetzae meecha" vegomer.

Mishnah Keritot 5:3-6:
Amar lo rabbi akiva, nirim devarecha bimila meutta. hare shebba al yado sefek meila bemea mane, lo yafe lo sheyyavi asham bishte selaim veal yavi sefek meila bemea mane. ha mode rabbi akiva lerabbi tarfon bimila muatet. haishsha shehevia chattat haof safek, im ad shello nimleka noda lah sheyyalda vadday, taasenna vadday. shemmimmin shehi mevia al lo hoda, mevia al hoda: 
Chaticha shel chullin vachaticha shel kodesh, achal achat mehen veen yadua ezo mehen achal, patur. rabbi akiva mechayyev beasham taluy. achal et hashsheniyya, mevi asham vadday. achal echad et harishona, uva acher veachal et hashsheniyya, ze mevi asham taluy veze mevi asham taluy, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi shimon omer, shenehem meviim asham echad. rabbi yose omer, en shenayim meviim asham echad: 
Chaticha shel chullin vachaticha shel chelev, achal achat mehen veen yadua ezo mehen achal, mevi asham taluy. achal et hashsheniyya, mevi chattat. achal echad et harishona uva acher veachal et hashsheniyya, ze mevi asham taluy veze mevi asham taluy, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi shimon omer, shenehem meviim chattat echat. rabbi yose omer, en shenayim meviim chattat echat: 
Chaticha shel chelev vachaticha shel kodesh, achal et achat mehen veen yadua ezo mehen achal, mevi asham taluy. achal et hashsheniyya, mevi chattat veasham vadday. achal echad et harishona uva acher veachal et hashsheniyya, ze mevi asham taluy, veze mevi asham taluy. rabbi shimon omer, shenehem meviim chattat veasham. rabbi yose omer, en shenayim meviim chattat veasham:
Mishnah Keritot 5:7-6:3:
Chaticha shel chelev vachaticha shel chelev kodesh, achal et achat mehen veen yadua ezo mehen achal, mevi chattat. rabbi akiva omer, mevi asham taluy. achal et hashsheniyya, mevi shete chattaot veasham vadday. achal echad et harishona uva acher veachal et hashsheniyya, ze mevi chattat veze mevi chattat. rabbi akiva omer, ze mevi asham taluy veze mevi asham taluy. rabbi shimon omer, ze chattat veze chattat, ushenehem meviim asham echad. rabbi yose omer, en shenayim meviin asham echad: 
Chaticha shel chelev vachaticha shel chelev notar, achal et achat mehen veen yadua et eze mehen achal, mevi chattat veasham taluy. achal et hashsheniyya, mevi shalosh chattaot. achal echad et harishona uva acher veachal et hashsheniyya, ze mevi chattat veasham taluy veze mevi chattat veasham taluy. rabbi shimon omer, ze chattat veze chattat, ushenehem meviim chattat echat. rabbi yose omer, kol chattat shehi vaa al chet, en shenayim meviim otah: 
Hammevi asham taluy venoda lo shello chata, im ad shello nishchat, yetze veyire vaeder, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, yire ad sheyyistaev, veyimmacher, veyippelu damav lindava. rabbi eliezer omer, yikrav, sheim eno va al chet ze, hare hu va al chet acher. im mishshennishchat noda lo, haddam yishshafech vehabbasar yetze levet hasserefa. nizrak haddam, habbasar yeachel. rabbi yose omer, afillu haddam bakkos, yizzarek, vehabbasar yeachel: 
Asham vadday eno chen. im ad shello nishchat, yetze veyire vaeder. mishshennishchat, hare ze yikkaver. nizrak haddam, habbasar yetze levet hasserefa. shor hanniskal eno chen. im ad shello niskal, yetze veyire vaeder. mishshenniskal, muttar bahanaa. egla arufa enah ken. im ad shello neerfa, tetze vetire vaeder. mishshenneerfa, tikkaver bimkomah, sheal safek baa mittechillatah, kippera sefekah vehalcha lah: 
Rabbi eliezer omer, mitnaddev adam asham taluy bechol yom uvechol shaa sheyyirtze, vehi nikret asham chasidim. amru alav al bava ven buti, shehaya mitnaddev asham taluy bechol yom, chutz meachar yom hakkippurim yom echad. amar, hammaon hazze, illu hayu mannichim li, hayiti mevi, ella omrim li, hameten ad shettikkanes lesafek. vachachamim omrim, en meviim asham taluy ella al davar shezzedono charet veshiggato chattat:
Mishnah Keritot 6:4-7:
Chayyave chattaot vaashamot vaddain sheavar alehen yom hakkippurim, chayyavin lehavi leachar yom hakkippurim. chayyave ashamot teluyin, peturim. mi shebba al yado sefek avera beyom hakkippurim, afillu im chashecha, patur, shekkol hayyom mechapper: 
Haishsha sheyyesh aleha chattat haof safek, sheavar aleha yom hakkippurim, chayyevet lehavi leachar yom hakkippurim, mippene shemmachsherattah leechol bazzevachim. chattat haof habbaa al safek, im mishshennimleka noda lah, hare zo tikkaver: 
Hammafrish shete selaim leasham velakach bahen shene elim leasham, im haya achad mehen yafe shete selaim, yikrav laashamo, vehashsheni yire ad sheyyistaev, veyimmacher, veyippelu damav lindava. lakach bahen shene elim lechullin, echad yafe shete selaim veechad yafe asara zuz, hayyafe shete selaim yikrav laashamo, vehashsheni limilato. echad leasham veechad lechullin, im haya shel asham yafe shete selaim, yikrav laashamo, vehashsheni limilato, veyavi immah sela vechumshah: 
Hammafrish chattato, umet, lo yevienna veno acharav. velo yevienna mechet al chet, afillu al chelev sheachal emesh lo yevienna al chelev sheachal hayyom, shenneemar (Vayikra 4), karbano al chattato, sheyyehe karbano leshem cheto:
Mishnah Keritot 6:8-9:
Meviin mehekdesh kisba, seira. mehekdesh seira, kisba. mehekdesh kisba useira, torin uvene yona. mehekdesh torin uvene yona, asirit haefa. ketzad. hifrish lechisba o lisira, heeni, yavi of. heeni, yavi asirit haefa. hifrish laasirit haefa, heeshir, yavi of. heeshir, yavi chisba useira. hifrish kisba o seira venistaavu, im ratza yavi vidmehen of. hifrish of venistaev, lo yavi vedamav asirit haefa, sheen laof pidyon: 
Rabbi shimon omer, kevasim kodmin laizzim bechol makom. yachol mippene shehen muvcharin mehen. talmud lomar (Vayikra 4), veim keves yavi karbano lechattat, melammed sheshshenehem shekulin. torin kodmin livne yona vechol makom. yachol mippene shehen muvcharim mehen. talmud lomar (sham 12), uven yona o tor lechattat, melammed sheshshenehen shekulin. haav kodem laem bechol makom. yachol shekkevod haav odef al kevod haem, talmud lomar (sham 19), ish immo veaviv tirau, melammed sheshshenehem shekulim. aval amru chachamim, haav kodem laem bechol makom, mippene shehu veimmo chayyavin bichvod aviv. vechen betalmud tora, im zacha habben lifne harav, kodem et haav bechol makom, mippene shehu veaviv chayyavin bichvod rabbo:
Mishnah Meilah 1:1-2:
Kadshe kadashim sheshshechatan baddarom, moalim bahen. shechatan baddarom vekibbel daman batztzafon, batztzafon vekibbel daman baddarom, shechatan bayyom vezarak ballayla, ballayla vezarak bayyom, o sheshshechatan chutz lizmannan vechutz limkoman, moalin bahen. kelal amar rabbi yehoshua, kol shehaya lah sheat hetter lakkohanim, en moalin bah. veshello haya lah sheat hetter lakkohanim, moalin bah. ezo hi shehaya lah sheat hetter lakkohanim. shellana, veshennitmea, vesheyyatza. ezo hi shello haya lah sheat hetter lakkohanim. shennishchata chutz lizmannah, chutz limkomah, veshekkibbelu fesulin vezarku et damah: 
Besar kadshe kadashim sheyyatza lifne zerikat damim, rabbi eliezer omer, moalin bo, veen chayyavin alav mishshum piggul, notar vetame. rabbi akiva omer, en moalin bo, aval chayyavin alav mishshum piggul, notar vetame. amar rabbi akiva, vahare hammafrish chattat veavda, vehifrish acheret tachteha, veachar kach nimtzet harishona vahare shetehen omdot, lo cheshem sheddamah poter et besarah, kach hu foter et besar chavertah. veim patar damah et besar chavertah min hammeila, din hu sheyyiftor et besarah:
Mishnah Meilah 1:3-2:2:
Emure kadashim kallim sheyyatzu lifne zerikat damim, rabbi eliezer omer, en moalin bahen, veen chayyavin alehen mishshum piggul notar vetame. rabbi akiva omer, moalin bahen, vechayyavin alehen mishshum piggul, notar vetame: 
Maase damim bekadshe kadashim, lehakel ulehachamir. uvekadashim kallim, kullan lehachamir. ketzad. kadshe kadashim lifne zerikat damim, moalin baemurin uvabbasar. leachar zerikat damim, moalim baemurim veen moalin babbasar. al ze veal ze, chayyavin mishshum piggul, notar vetame. uvekadashim kallim kullan lehachamir. ketzad. kadashim kallim lifne zerikat damim, en moalin lo vaemurin velo vabbasar. leachar zerikat damim, moalin baemurin veen moalin babbasar. al ze veal ze, chayyavin mishshum piggul, notar vetame. nimtza maase damim bekadshe kadashim, lehakel ulehachamir. uvekadashim kallim, kullo lehachamir: 
Chattat haof, moalin bah mishshehukdesha. nimleka, huchshera lehippasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim uvelina. huzza damah, chayyavin aleha mishshum piggul, notar vetame, veen bah meila: 
Olat haof, moalin bah mishshehukdesha. nimleka, huchshera lehippasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim uvelina. mitztza damah, chayyavin aleha mishshum piggul, notar vetame. umoalin bah ad shettetze levet haddashen:
Mishnah Meilah 2:3-7:
Parim hannisrafin useirim hannisrafin, moalin bahen mishshehukdeshu. nishchatu, huchsheru lehippasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim uvelina. huzza daman, chayyavin alehen mishshum piggul, notar vetame. umoalin bahen bevet haddeshen ad sheyyuttach habbasar: 
Haola, moalin bah mishshehukdesha. nishchata, huchshera lehippasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim uvelina. nizrak damah, chayyavin aleha mishshum piggul, notar vetame. veen moalin beorah, aval moalin babbasar ad sheyyetze levet haddashen: 
Chattat veasham vezivche shalme tzibbur, moalin bahen mishshehukdeshu. nishchatu, huchsheru lehippasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim uvelina. nizrak daman, chayyavin alehem mishshum piggul, notar vetame. en moalin babbasar, aval moalin baemurim ad sheyyetzu levet haddashen: 
Shete hallechem, moalin bahen mishshehukdeshu. karmu vattannur, huchsheru lehippasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim velishchot alehem et hazzavach. nizrak daman shel kevasim, chayyavin alehen mishshum piggul, notar vetame, veen bahen meila: 
Lechem happanim, moalin bo mishshehukdash. karam battannur, huchshar lehippasel bitvul yom uvimchussar kippurim, ulehissader al gabbe hashshulchan. karvu habbezichin, chayyavin alav mishshum piggul, notar vetame, veen bahen meila:
Mishnah Nazir 1:1-4:
Kol kinnuye nezirut kinzirut. haomer ehe, hare ze nazir. o ehe nave, nazir. nazik, naziach, paziach, hare ze nazir. hareni kaze, hareni mesalsel, hareni mechalkel, hare alay leshallach pera, hare ze nazir. hare alay tzipporim, rabbi meir omer, nazir. vachachamim omrim, eno nazir: 
Hareni nazir min hachartzannim, umin hazzaggim, umin hattiglachat, umin hattuma, hare ze nazir vechol dikduke nezirut alav. hareni cheshimshon, keven manoach, kevaal delila, kemi sheakar daltot azza, kemi shennikkeru felishtim et enav, hare ze nezir shimshon. ma ben nezir olam linzir shimshon. nezir olam, hichbid searo, mekel betaar umevi shalosh behemot. veim nitma, mevi karban tuma. nezir shimshon, hichbid searo, eno mekel. veim nitma, eno mevi karban tuma: 
Setam nezirut sheloshim yom. amar hareni nazir achat gedola, hareni nazir achat ketanna, afillu mikkan vead sof haolam, nazir sheloshim yom. hareni nazir veyom echad, hareni nazir veshaa echat, hareni nazir achat umechetza, hare ze nazir shetayim. hareni nazir sheloshim yom veshaa echat, nazir sheloshim veechad yom, sheen nozrim leshaot: 
Hareni nazir kisar roshi, vechaafar haaretz, uchechol hayyam, hare ze nezir olam umegalleach achat lishloshim yom. rabbi omer, en ze megalleach achat lishloshim yom. veezehu shemmegalleach achat lishloshim yom, haomer hare alay nezirut kisar roshi, vechaafar haaretz, uchechol hayyam:
Mishnah Nazir 1:5-2:1:
Hareni nazir melo habbayit o melo hakkuppa, bodkin oto, im amar achat gedola nazarti, nazir sheloshim yom. veim amar setam nazarti, roin et hakkuppa keillu hi melea chardal, venazir kol yamav: 
Hareni nazir mikkan ad makom peloni, omdin kamma yamim mikkan ad makom peloni, im pachot mishsheloshim yom, nazir sheloshim yom, veim lav, nazir keminyan hayyamim: 
Hareni nazir keminyan yemot hachamma, mone nezirut keminyan yemot hachamma. amar rabbi yehuda, maase haya, kevan shehishlim met: 
Hareni nazir min haggerogarot umin haddevela, bet shammay omrim, nazir, uvet hillel omrim, eno nazir. amar rabbi yehuda, af kesheamru vet shammay, lo amru ella veomer hare hen alay karban:
Mishnah Nazir 2:2-5:
Amar, amra fara zo hareni nezira im omedet ani. amar, haddelet hazze hareni nazir im niftach ani. bet shammay omrim, nazir, uvet hillel omrim, eno nazir. amar rabbi yehuda, af kesheamru vet shammay, lo amru ella veomer hare fara zo alay karban im omedet hi: 
Mazgu lo et hakkos, veamar hareni nazir mimmenu, hare ze nazir. maase veishsha achat shehayta shikkora umazgu lah et hakkos, veamra hareni nezira mimmennu, amru chachamim, lo nitkavvena ella lomar hare hu alay karban: 
Hareni nazir al menat sheehe shote yayin umittamme lemetim, hare ze nazir veasur bechullan. yodea ani sheyyesh nezirut aval eni yodea shehannazir asur beyyayin, hare ze asur. verabbi shimon mattir. yodea ani shehannazir asur beyyayin aval savur hayiti shechachamim mattirim li mippene sheen ani yachol lichyot ella veyyayin, o mippene sheani kover et hammetim, hare ze muttar. verabbi shimon oser: 
Hareni nazir vealay legalleach nazir, veshama chavero veamar vaani vealay legalleach nazir, im hayu fikkechim, megallechim ze et ze. veim lav, megallechim nezirim acherim:
Mishnah Nazir 2:6-9:
Hare alay legalleach chatzi nazir, veshama chavero veamar vaani alay legalleach chatzi nazir, ze megalleach nazir shalem veze megalleach nazir shalem, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, ze megalleach chatzi nazir veze megalleach chatzi nazir: 
Hareni nazir lichsheyyihye li ven, venolad lo ven, hare ze nazir. nolad lo vat, tumtum, veanderoginos, eno nazir. im amar, kesheere, kesheyyihye li valad, afillu nolad lo vat, tumtum, veanderoginos, hare ze nazir: 
Hippila ishto, eno nazir. rabbi shimon omer, yomar, im haya ven keyama, hare ani nezir chova. veim lav, hare ani nezir nedava. chazra veyalda, hare ze nazir. rabbi shimon omer, yomar, im harishon ben keyama, harishon chova vezo nedava. veim lav, harishon nedava vezo chova: 
Hareni nazir, venazir kesheyyihye li ven, hitchil mone et shello veachar kach nolad lo ven, mashlim et shello veachar kach mone et shel beno. hareni nazir kesheyyihye li ven venazir, hitchil mone et shello veachar kach nolad lo ven, manniach et shello umone et shel beno, veachar kach mashlim et shello:
Mishnah Nedarim 11:12: Barishona hayu omrim, shalosh nashim yotzot venotlot ketubba, haomeret temea ani lecha, shamayim beni levenecha, netula ani min hayyehudim. chazru lomar, shello tehe ishsha notenet eneha veacher umekalkelet al balah. ella haomeret temea ani lecha, tavi reaya lidvareha. shamayim beni levenecha, yaasu derech bakkasha. netula ani min hayyehudim, yafer chelko, utehe meshammashto, utehe netula min hayyehudim:
Mishnah Nedarim 11:4-7:
Konam sheeni osa al pi abba, veal pi avicha, veal pi achi, veal pi achicha, eno yachol lehafer. sheeni osa al picha, eno tzarich lehafer. rabbi akiva omer, yafer, shemma tadif alav yoter min harauy lo. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer, yafer, shemma yegarshenna utehi asura alav: 
Nadra ishto vesavur shennadra vitto, nadra vitto vesavur shennadra ishto, nadra venazir vesavur shennadra vekarban, nadra vekarban vesavur shennadra venazir, nadra min hatteenim vesavur shennadra min haanavim, nadra min haanavim vesavur shennadra min hatteenim, hare ze yachazor veyafer: 
Amra, konam teenim vaanavim ellu sheeni toemet, kiyyem latteenim, kullo kayyam. hefer latteenim, eno mufar ad sheyyafer af laanavim. amra, konam teenim sheeni toemet vaanavim sheeni toemet, hare ellu shene nedarim: 
Yodea ani sheyyesh nedarim, aval eni yodea sheyyesh meferin, yafer. yodea ani sheyyesh meferin aval eni yodea shezze neder, rabbi meir omer, lo yafer, vachachamim omrim, yafer:
Mishnah Nedarim 11:8-11:
Hammuddar hanaa mechatano vehu rotze latet levitto maot, omer lah, hare hammaot haellu netunim lach bemattana uvilvad shello yehe levalech reshut bahen, ella ma sheat noset venotenet befich: 
Veneder almana ugerusha yakum aleha (Bamidbar 30). ketzad. amra, hareni nezira leachar sheloshim yom, af al pi shennisset betoch sheloshim yom, eno yachol lehafer. nadra vehi virshut habbaal, mefer lah. ketzad. amra, hareni nezira leachar sheloshim, af al pi shennitalmena o nitgarsha vetoch sheloshim, hare ze mufar. nadra vo vayyom, nitgarsha vo vayyom, hechezirah bo vayyom, eno yachol lehafer. ze hakkelal, kol sheyyatzat lirshut atzmah shaa achat, eno yachol lehafer: 
Tesha nearot, nidrehen kayyamin. bogeret vehi yetoma, naara uvagra vehi yetoma, naara shello vagra vehi yetoma, bogeret umet aviha, naara vogeret umet aviha, naara shello vagra umet aviha, naara shemmet aviha umishshemmet aviha bagra, bogeret veaviha kayyam, naara vogeret veaviha kayyam. rabbi yehuda omer, af hammassi vitto hakketanna, venitalmena o nitgarsha vechazra etzlo, adayin hi naara: 
Konam sheeni nehenet leabba uleavicha im osa ani al picha, sheeni nehenet lecha im osa ani al pi abba, veal pi avicha, hare ze yafer:
Mishnah Sheviit 1:3-7:
Echad ilan serak veechad ilan maachol, roin otan keillu hem teenim. im reuyim laasot kikkar devela shel shishshim mane baitalki, chorshim kol bet sea bishvilan. pachot mikkan, en chorshim lahem ella letzarkan: 
Haya echad ose kikkar devela ushenayim en osin, o shenayim osin veechad eno ose, en chorshin lahem ella letzarkan, ad sheyyihyu mishshelosha vead tisha. hayu asara, measara ulemala, ben osin ben sheenan osin, chorshin kol bet sea bishvilan. shenneemar (Shemot led) becharish uvakkatzir tishbot, en tzarich lomar charish vekatzir shel sheviit, ella charish shel erev sheviit shehu nichnas bashsheviit, vekatzir shel sheviit shehu yotze lemotzae sheviit. rabbi yishmael omer, ma charish reshut, af katzir reshut, yatza ketzir haomer: 
Shelosha ilanot shel shelosha anashim, hare ellu mitztarfin, vechorshin kol bet sea bishvilan. vechamma yehe venehem, rabban gamliel omer, kede sheyyehe habbakar over bechelav: 
Eser netiot mefuzzarot betoch bet sea, chorshin kol bet sea bishvilan, ad rosh hashshana. hayu asuyot shura umukkafot atara, en chorshin lahem ella letzarkan: 
Hannetiot vehaddeluim, mitztarfin letoch bet sea. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, kol asara deluim levet sea, chorshin kol bet sea ad rosh hashshana:
Mishnah Sheviit 1:8-2:3:
Ad ematay nikreu netiot. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, ad sheyyachollu. rabbi yehoshua omer, bat sheva shanim. rabbi akiva omer, netia chishmah. ilan shennigmam vehotzi chalifin, mittefach ulematta kintia, mittefach ulemala, keilan, divre rabbi shimon: 
Ad ematay chorshin bisde hallavan erev sheviit. ad shettichle hallecha, kol zeman shebbene adam chorshim litta bammikshaot uvammidlaot. amar rabbi shimon, natatta torat kol echad veechad beyado, ella bisde hallavan ad happesach, uvisde hailan ad atzeret: 
Mezabbelin umeadderin bammikshaot uvammidlaot ad rosh hashshana. vechen bevet hashshelachin. meyabbelin, mefarkin, meabbekin, meashshenin, ad rosh hashshana. rabbi shimon omer, af notel hu et heale min haeshkol bashsheviit: 
Mesakkelin ad rosh hashshana. mekarsemin, mezardin, mefasselin, ad rosh hashshana. rabbi yehoshua omer, kezerudah uchefissulah shel chamishshit, kach shel shishshit. rabbi shimon omer, kol zeman sheani rashshay baavodat hailan, rashshay ani befissulo:
Mishnah Sheviit 2:4-7:
Mezahamin et hannetiot, vechorchin otan, vekotmin otan, veosin lahen battim, umashkin otan, ad rosh hashshana. rabbi elazar bar tzadok omer, af mashke hu et hannof bashsheviit, aval lo et haikkar: 
Sachin et happaggim umenakkevim otam, ad rosh hashshana. pagge erev sheviit shennichnesu lashsheviit, veshel sheviit sheyyatzu lemotzae sheviit, lo sachin velo menakkevin otan. rabbi yehuda omer, mekom shennahagu lasuch, enan sachin, mippene shehi avoda. mekom shennahagu shello lasuch, sachin. rabbi shimon mattir bailan, mippene shehu rashshay baavodat hailan: 
En notin veen mavrichin veen markivin erev sheviit pachot mishsheloshim yom lifne rosh hashshana. veim nata o hivrich o hirkiv, yaakor. rabbi yehuda omer, kol harekava sheenah koletet lishlosha yamim, shuv enah koletet. rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim, lishte shabbatot: 
Haorez vehaddochan vehapperagin vehashshumshemin shehishrishu lifne rosh hashshana, mitasserin lesheavar, umuttarin bashsheviit. veim lav, asurin bashsheviit, umitasserin leshana habbaa:
Mishnah Sheviit 2:8-3:2:
Rabbi shimon shezuri omer, pol hammitzri shezzerao lezera battechilla, kayyotze vahen. rabbi shimon omer, afunin haggamlonin, kayyotze vahen. rabbi elazar omer, afunin haggamlonin, mishshettirmelu lifne rosh hashshana: 
Habbetzalim hassarisim, ufol hammitzri, shemmana mehem mayim sheloshim yom lifne rosh hashshana, mitasserin lesheavar, umuttarim bashsheviit, veim lav, asurim bashsheviit, umitasserin leshana habbaa. veshel baal shemmana mehem mayim shete onot, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, shalosh: 
Haddeluin shekkiyyeman lezera, im hikshu lifne rosh hashshana venifselu meochel adam, muttar lekayyeman bashsheviit. veim lav, asur lekayyeman bashsheviit. hattemarot shellahem, asurot bashsheviit. umarbitzin beafar lavan, divre rabbi shimon, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov oser. memarsin baorez bashsheviit, rabbi shimon omer, aval en mechassechin: 
Meematay motziin zevalim leashfattot. mishsheyyifseku ovde avoda, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, mishsheyyivash hammatok. rabbi yose omer, mishsheyyikshor:  
Ad kamma mezabbelin, ad shalosh shalosh ashpattot levet sea shel eser eser mashpelot shel letech letech. mosifin al hammashpelot, veen mosifin al haashpattot. rabbi shimon omer, af al haashpattot:
Mishnah Sheviit 3:3-6: Ose adam et sadehu shalosh shalosh ashpattot levet sea. yater mikkan, machatziv, divre rabbi shimon. vachachamim osrin, ad sheyyaamik shelosha, o ad sheyyagbiah shelosha. ose adam et zivlo otzar. rabbi meir oser, ad sheyyaamik shelosha, o ad sheyyagbiah shelosha. haya lo davar muat, mosif alav veholech. rabbi elazar ben azarya oser, ad sheyyaamik shelosha, o ad sheyyagbiah shelosha, o ad sheyyitten al hassala:

Hamedayyer et sadehu, ose sahar levet satayim, oker shalosh ruchot umanniach et haemtzait. nimtza medayyer bet arbaat sein. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, bet shemonat sein. hayta chol sadehu bet arbaat sein, meshayyer mimmenna miktzat, mippene marit haayin, umotzi min hassahar venoten letoch sadehu kederech hamezabbelin:
Lo yiftach adam machtzev battechilla letoch sadehu, ad sheyyihyu vo shalosh murebiyyot, shehem shalosh al shalosh al rum shalosh, shiuran esrim vesheva avanim:

Gader sheyyesh bo eser avanim shel masseoy shenayim shenayim, hare ellu yinnatelu. shiur gader, asara tefachim. pachot mikkan, mechatztzev vegommo ad pachot mehaaretz tefach. bamme devarim amurim, mittoch shello, aval mittoch shel chavero, ma shehu rotze, yittol. bamme devarim amurim, bizman shelo hitchil bo meerev sheviit. aval im hitchil bo meerev sheviit, ma shehu rotze, notel:
Mishnah Sheviit 3:7-10: Avanim shezzizeatan hammacharesha, o shehayu mechussot venitgallu, im yesh bahem shetayim shel masseoy shenayim shenayim, hare ellu yinnatelu. hamesakkel et sadehu, notel et haelyonot, umanniach et hannogot baaretz. vechen garger shel tzerorot o gal shel avanim, notel et haelyonot, umanniach et hannogot baaretz. im yesh tachtehen sela o kash, hare ellu yinnatelu:

En bonin madregot al pi haggeayot erev sheviit mishsheppasku haggeshamim, mippene shehu metakkenan lashsheviit. aval bone hu bashsheviit mishsheppasku geshamim, mippene shehu metakkenan lemotzae sheviit. velo yismoch beafar, aval ose hu chayitz. kol even shehu yachol lifshot et yado velittelah, hare zo tinnatel:

Avne chatef, baot mikkol makom. vehakkabbelan, mevi mikkol makom. veellu hem avne chatef, kol sheenah yechola lehinnatel beachat yad, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer, avne chatef kishman, kol shehen nittalot shetayim shalosh al hakkatef:

Habbone gader beno uven reshut harabbim, muttar lehaamik ad hassela. ma yaase beafar, tzovro birshut harabbim umetakkeno, divre rabbi yehoshua. rabbi akiva omer, kederech sheen mekalkelin birshut harabbim, kach lo yetakkenu. ma yaase beafar, tzovro betoch sadehu kederech hamezabbelin. vechen hachofer bor veshiach umeara:
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 1:1: Kol mitzvot shebbattora ben ase ben lo taase im avar adam al achat mehen ben bezadon ben bishgaga kesheyyaase teshuva veyashuv mecheto chayyav lehitvaddot lifne hael baruch hu shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 6)</small> "ish o ishsha ki yaasu" vegomer <small>(Bamidbar 5 7)</small> "vehitvaddu et chattatam asher asu" ze vidduy devarim. vidduy ze mitzvat ase. ketzad mitvaddin. omer anna hashshem chatati aviti pashati lefanecha veasiti kach vechach vahare nichamti uvoshti bemaasay uleolam eni chozer ledavar ze. vezehu ikkaro shel vidduy. vechol hammarbe lehitvaddot umaarich beinyan ze hare ze meshubbach. vechen baale chattaot vaashamot beet shemmeviin karbenotehen al shiggatan o al zedonan en mitkapper lahen bekarbanam ad sheyyaasu teshuva veyitvaddu vidduy devarim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 5)</small> "vehitvadda asher chata aleha". vechen kol mechuyyeve mitot bet din umechuyyeve malkot en mitkapper lahen bemitatan o bilkiyyatan ad sheyyaasu teshuva veyitvaddu. vechen hachovel bachavero vehammazzik mamono af al pi sheshshillem lo ma shehu chayyav lo eno mitkapper ad sheyyitvadde veyashuv millaasot kaze leolam shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 5 6)</small> "mikkol chattot haadam":
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 1:2-3: Sair hammishtalleach lefi shehu kappara al kol yisrael kohen gadol mitvadde alav al leshon kol yisrael shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 21)</small> "vehitvadda alav et kol avonot bene yisrael". sair hammishtalleach mechapper al kol averot shebbattora, hakkallot vehachamurot, ben sheavar bezadon ben sheavar bishgaga, ben shehoda lo ben shello hoda lo, hakkol mitkapper besair hammishtalleach. vehu sheasa teshuva. aval im lo asa teshuva en hassair mechapper lo ella al hakkallot. uma hen hakkallot uma hen hachamurot. hachamurot hen shechayyavin alehem mitat bet din o karet. ushevuat shav vasheker af al pi sheen bahen karet hare hen min hachamurot. ushear mitzvot lo taase umitzvot ase sheen bahen karet hem hakkallot:

Bazzeman hazze sheen bet hammikdash kayyam veen lanu mizbach kappara en sham ella teshuva. hatteshuva mechapperet al kol haaverot. afillu rasha kol yamav veasa teshuva baacharona en mazkirin lo shum davar merisho shenneemar <small>(yechezkel log 12)</small> "rishat harasha lo yikkashel bah beyom shuvo merisho". veatzmo shel yom hakkippurim mechapper lashshavim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 30)</small> "ki vayyom hazze yechapper alechem":
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 1:4: Af al pi shehatteshuva mechapperet al hakkol veatzmo shel yom hakkippurim mechapper. yesh averot shehen mitkapperim lishatan veyesh averot sheen mitkapperim ella leachar zeman. ketzad. avar adam al mitzvat ase sheen bah karet veasa teshuva eno zaz mishsham ad shemmochalin lo, uveellu neemar <small>(yirmeya 3 22)</small> "shuvu banim shovavim erpa meshuvotechem" vegomer. avar al mitzvat lo taase sheen bah karet velo mitat bet din veasa teshuva, teshuva tola veyom hakkippurim mechapper, uveellu neemar <small>(Vayikra 16 30)</small> "ki vayyom hazze yechapper alechem". avar al keretot umitot bet din veasa teshuva, teshuva veyom hakkippurim tolin veyissurin habbain alav gomrin lo hakkappara. uleolam en mitkapper lo kappara gemura ad sheyyavou alav yissurin, uveellu neemar <small>(Tehillim 89 log)</small> "ufakadti veshevet pisham uvingaim avonam". bamme devarim amurim beshello chillel et hashshem beshaa sheavar aval hamechallel et hashshem af al pi sheasa teshuva vehiggia yom hakkippurim vehu omed bitshuvato uvau alav yissurin eno mitkapper lo kappara gemura ad sheyyamut. ella teshuva yom hakkippurim veyissurin shelashtan tolin umita mechapperet shenneemar <small>(yeshaya 22 14)</small> "venigla veaznay Adonai tzevaot vegomer im yechuppar heavon hazze lachem ad temutun":
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 2:1-2: E zo hi teshuva gemura. ze shebba leyado davar sheavar bo veefshar beyado laasoto uferash velo asa mippene hatteshuva. lo miyyira velo mikkishlon koach. ketzad. hare shebba al ishsha baavera uleachar zeman nityached immah vehu omed beahavato bah uvechoach gufo uvammedina sheavar bah ufarash velo avar zehu baal teshuva gemura. hu sheshshelomo amar <small>(Kohelet 12 1)</small> "uzechor et borecha bime bechurotecha". veim lo shav ella bime ziknuto uveet shei efshar lo laasot ma shehaya ose af al pi sheenah teshuva meulla moelet hi lo uvaal teshuva hu. afillu avar kol yamav veasa teshuva beyom mitato umet bitshuvato kol avonotav nimchalin shenneemar <small>(Kohelet 12 b)</small> "ad asher lo techshach hashshemesh vehaor vehayyareach vehakkochavim veshavu heavim achar haggeshem" shehu yom hammita. mikkelal sheim zachar boro veshav kodem sheyyamut nislach lo:

Uma hi hatteshuva. hu sheyyaazov hachote cheto visiro mimmachashavto veyigmor belibbo shello yaasehu od shenneemar <small>(yeshaya noah 7)</small> "yaazov rasha darko" vegomer. vechen yitnachem al sheavar shenneemar <small>(yirmeya lo 19)</small> "ki achare shuvi nichamti". veyaid alav yodea taalumot shello yashuv leze hachet leolam shenneemar <small>(Hoshea 14 4)</small> "velo nomar od elohenu lemaase yadenu" vegomer. vetzarich lehitvaddot bisfatav velomar inyanot ellu sheggamar belibbo:
Mishneh Torah, Repentance 2:3-5: Kol hammitvadde bidvarim velo gamar belibbo laazov hare ze dome letovel vesheretz beyado sheen hattevila moelet lo ad sheyyashlich hashsheretz. vechen hu omer umode veozev yerucham <small>(Mishlei 28 13)</small>. vetzarich lifrot et hachet shenneemar <small>(Shemot 32 lo)</small> "anna chata haam hazze chataa gedola vayyaasu lahem elohe zahav":

Middarche hatteshuva lihyot hashshav tzoek tamid lifne hashshem bivchi uvetachanunim veose tzedaka kefi kocho umitrachek harebe min haddavar shechata bo umeshanne shemo kelomar ani acher veeni oto haish sheasa otan hammaasim umeshanne maasav kullan letova ulederech yeshara vegole mimmekomo. sheggalut mechapperet avon mippene sheggoremet lo lehikkana velihyot anav ushefal ruach:

Veshevach gadol lashshav sheyyitvadde barabbim veyodia peshaav lahem umegalle averot shebbeno leven chavero laacherim veomer lahem amnam chatati lifloni veasiti lo kach vechach vahareni hayyom shav umitnachem. vechol hammitgae veeno modia ella mechasse peshaav en teshuvato gemura shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 28 13)</small> "mechasse feshaav lo yatzliach". bamme devarim amurim baaverot shebben adam lachavero aval baaverot shebben adam lammakom eno tzarich lefarsem atzmo veazzut panim hi lo im gillam. ella shav lifne hael baruch hu uforet chataav lefanav umitvadde alehem lifne rabbim setam. vetova hi lo shello nitgalla avono shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 32 1)</small> "ashre nesuy pesha kesuy chataa":
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 5:7-8:
Notnin gargir shel melach ugeris shel pol al pi hanner beerev shabbat sheyyihye dolek belel shabbat. vechol happetilot sheen madlikin bahen beshabbat osin mehen medura ben lehitchammem kenegdah ben lehishtammesh leorah ben al gabbe menora ben al gabbe karka. velo asru ella laasotan petila lener bilvad: 
Shemen shemmadlikin bo lishabbat tzarich sheyyehe nimshach achar happetila aval shemanin sheen nimshachin achar happetila kegon zefet veshaava veshemen kik vealya vechelev en madlikin bahen. umippene ma en madlikin biftilot sheen haur nitlet bahen velo bishmanim sheen nimshachim achar happetila gezera shemma yihye or hanner afel veyatte otah beshaa sheyyishtammesh leorah:
Niddah 14b:4-8: Mishtabbach leh rabbi lerabbi yishmael berabbi yose berabbi chama bar besa, deadam gadol hu. amar lo: lichsheyyavo leyadcha, haviehu leyadi.
Ki ata, amar leh: bei minnay milleta. bea minneh: badka beed sheeno baduk lah, vehinnichattu bekufesa, ulemachar matza alav dam, mahu?
Amar lo: kedivre abba ema lach, o kedivre rabbi ema lach? amar leh: kedivre rabbi ema li.
Amar rabbi yishmael: zehu sheomrin alav deadam gadol hu? heach mannichin divre harav veshomin divre hattalmid?!
Verabbi chama bar besa savar: rabbi resh metivta hu, ushechichi rabbanan kammeh, umechaddedi shematateh.

Besifte navon timmatze chochma veshevet legev chasar-lev
Proverbs 10:15-19: Hon ashir kiryat uzzo mechittat dallim resham

Berachot lerosh tzaddik ufi reshaim yechasse chamas

Chacham-lev yikkach mitzvot veevil sefatayim yillavet

Shabbat 113b:14-114a:8: Amar rabbi acha bar abba amar rabbi yochanan:

Minnayin leshinnuy begadim min hattora, shenneemar: "ufashat et begadav velavash begadim acherim", vetana deve rabbi yishmael, limmeda tora derech eretz: begadim shebbishshel bahen kedera lerabbo — al yimzog bahen kos lerabbo.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: genay hu letalmid chacham sheyyetze beminalim hametullaim lashshuk. veha rabbi acha bar chanina nafek! amar rabbi acha bereh derav nachman: bitlay al gav telay.

Veamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: kol talmid chacham shennimtza revav al bigdo — chayyayv mita, shenneemar: "kol mesanay ahavu mavet" — al tikre "mesanay", ella "masniay". ravina amar: revad ittemar. vela peligi: ha biglima, ha bilvusha.
Veamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: may dichtiv "kaasher halach avdi yeshayahu arom veyachef". "arom" — bivgadim beluim, "veyachef" — beminalim hametullaim.

Tenan hatam: revav al hammardaat chotzetz. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: ad keissar haitalki. veal habbegadim, mitztzad echad — eno chotzetz, mishshene tzedadin — chotzetz. rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi yishmael: af mitztzad echad chotzetz.

Bea minneh rabbi shimon ben lakish merabbi chanina: mardaat, mitztzad echad o mishshene tzedadin? amar leh: zo lo shamati, kayyotze bah shamati. ditnan rabbi yose omer: shel bannain — mitztzad echad, veshel bur — mishshene tzedadin. velo tehe mardaat chashuva mibbigdo shel am haaretz.

May "bannain"? amar rabbi yochanan: ellu talmide chachamim sheoskin bevinyano shel olam kol yemehen. veamar rabbi yochanan: ezehu talmid chacham shemmachzirin lo aveda bitviut haayin — ze hammakpid al chaluko lehofcho. veamar rabbi yochanan: ezehu talmid chacham shemmemannin oto parnas al hatztzibbur — ze sheshshoalin oto davar halacha bechol makom veomer, vaafillu bemassechet kalla.

Veamar rabbi yochanan: ezehu talmid chacham shebbene iro metzuvvivyn laasot lo melachto — ze shemmanniach cheftzo veosek becheftze shamayim. vehane mille lemitrach berifteh. veamar rabbi yochanan: ezehu talmid chacham — kol sheshshoalin oto halacha bechol makom, veomrah. lemay nafka minna — lemannoyeh parnas al hatztzibbur. i bachada massechta — beatreh, i bechulleh tannoye — beresh metivta.
Yevamot 63a:7-10: Veamar rabbi elazar: atidim kol baale ummaniyyot sheyyaamdu al hakkarka, shenneemar: "veyardu meoniyyotehem kol tofse mashot mallachim kol chovle hayyam al haaretz yaamodu". veamar rabbi elazar: en lecha ummanut pechuta min hakkarka, shenneemar: "veyardu". rabbi elazar chazya lehahi ara deshade bay kerava lefuteya, amar leh: i tishdeyeh leurekaych — happoche beiska tav minnach.

Rav al levene shuyvle, chazanhu deka nayyfan, amar lehu: i nayyfat — itnofe. happoche beiska tav minnach. amar rava: mea zuze beiska — kol yoma bisra vechamra, mea zuze beara — milcha vachafura. velo od ella magneya leh aara, umarmeya leh tigre.
Amar rav pappa: zera vela tizboyn. af al gav dechi hadade ninhu, hane mibbarchan. zabben vela tizzol. hane mille bistarke, aval gelima — la mitramya leh.
Tum vela teshappetz. shappetz vela tivne. shekkol haosek bevinyan — mitmasken. kefotz zevoyn ara, meton nesev itteta. nechet darga nesev itteta. sak darga bechar shoshvina.
Zevachim 115b:10-15: Tannae hi; detanya: "vegam hakkohanim hanniggashim el Adonai yitkaddashu" – rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer: zo perishut bechorot. rabbi omer: zo perishut nadav vaavihu.
Bishlama leman deamar zo perishut nadav vaavihu – hayeynu dichtiv: "hu asher dibber Adonai lemor bikrovay ekkadesh".
Ella leman deamar zo perishut bechorot – hecha remiza? dichtiv: "venoadti shamma livne yisrael venikdash bichvodi" – al tikre "bichvodi", ella "(bimchubbadayy) [bichvudayy]".

Davar ze amar hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe velo yadu, ad shemmetu bene aharon. kevan shemmetu bene aharon, amar lo: aharon achi, lo metu banecha ella lehakedish shemo shel hakkadosh baruch hu. kevan sheyyada aharon shebbanav yedue makom hen, shatak vekibbel sachar; shenneemar: "vayyiddom aharon".

Vechen bedavid hu omer: "dom laAdonai vehitcholel lo" – af al pi shemmappil lecha chalalim chalalim, at shetok. vechen bishlomo hu omer: "et lachashot veet ledabber" – peamim sheshshotek umekabbel sachar al hashshetika, peamim medabber umekabbel sachar al haddibbur.

Vehayeynu deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan, may dichtiv: "nora elohim mimmikdashecha"? al tikre "mimmikdashecha" ella "mimmekuddashecha" – beshaa sheose hakkadosh baruch hu din bikdoshav, mityayre umitalle umithallel.
Zohar, Vayigash 12:123-135: Vayyeesor yosef merkavto, ribbi yitzchak patach veamar, (yechezkel 1:22) udemut al rashe hachayya rakia keen hakkerach hannora natuy al rashehem millemala, hay kera ukemuha. aval ta chaze, it chayya leel min chayya, veit chayya kaddisha dekayyma al rish chevata.

Veit chayya illaa, leela al kol shear chevata, vehay (nusach acher veit) chayya shalta al kullehu. begin dechad hay chevata yahava venahara lechullehu, keden kullehu natlin lematlanoy, vihivat da leda, veshalta da al da.

Veit chevata leela al tattae, al shear chevata letatta, vechullehu ittezanu minah, ved sitre dealma reshimin bah. anpin nehirin yedian (dinin) lechol setar, veihi shalta al 4 sitre. veha ukemuha, deinun 3 listar da, veg listar da, vechen led sitrin dealma.

(Shemot 212 amud alef) veit rakia leel min rakia, vehay rakia deshalta alayyhu, kullehu mistakkelan legabbeh. ma ketiv, (yechezkel 1:23) vetachat harakia kanfehem yesharot ishsha el achotah vegomer. begin dechullehu shaltin al ma deitpakdu, ushelichu dekuseta dekufetra behu.
Veinun lechol setar tisha, (9) led sitrin dealma, veinun 36 bechushebna. vechad mitchabberan kullehu, itavidu reshima chada beraza dishma chada, beyichuda shelim kidkachaze.

Vechad mittakne legabbe karseya, ma ketiv. umimmaal larakia asher al rosham kemare even sappir demut kisse veal demut hakkisse demut kemare adam alav millemala, veha okimna (nusach acher diyyukena) dehay even tava becharseya dekayyma al 4 kayymin, veal hahu karseya diukena deadam, leitchabbera beh kechada, uleitbarcha kedka yeut.

Vechad ihi mittakna legabbeh deadam, lemeheve kolla reticha (nusach acher kaddisha, vechohen kolla reticha) chada, lehay adam. keden ketiv, vayyeesor yosef merkavto da tzaddik. vayyaal likrat yisrael aviv goshna. likrat yisrael, da raza deadam. goshna, tikruveta chada, leitkerava kechada, bekarbana chada veyichuda chada.

Vayyera elav, dechad itchaze shimsha besihara, keden nahir sihara veanhir lechullehu diltatta. vechen kegavvna da, kol zimna dikdushsha dilela shara al makdesha diltatta, itnehir be makdesha vekayyma bishlimuteh. vechad istallak minneh veitchariv be makdesha, keden, vayyevchi al tzavvarav od. devachun kolla al makdesha deitchariv. od, may od. da galuta batraa.

Keden kevan dechama yaakov veistakkal deha tikkuna diltatta ishtachlal kegavvna dilela, keden amar amuta happaam vegomer. ki odcha chay, deitkayymat beraza divrit kaddisha, deikre chay haolamim, uvegin kach ki odcha chay. veal da bekadmita amar, rav od yosef beni chay, deitzterich lemekam beraza dechay, veha ittemar.
Ta chaze, ma ketiv, vayvarech yaakov et paro, amar ribbi yose, paro af al gav deukemuha beraza ochara, semech deka samchinan bealma.

Aval ta chaze, (Shir hashshirim 1:9) lesusati berichve faro dimmitich raayati, ta chaze, it retichin lismala beraza desitra ochora, veit retichin limina beraza dilela dikdushsha, veillen lokovel illen. illen derachame veillen dedina.

Vechad kudesha berich hu avad dina bemitzrae, kol dina deavid, kehahu gavvna deinun retichin mammash, uchegavvna dileh dehahu sitra mammash. ma hahu sitra (mammash) katil veappik nishmatin, uf kudesha berich hu avid behahu gavvna mammash. dichtiv, (Shemot 13:15) vayyaharog Adonai kol bechor, vechen kolla bemitzrayim, behahu gavvna mammash. uvegin kach dimitich raayati, kegavvna dilah mammash lekatla. dichtiv, ki ani Adonai ani hu velo acher. ulezimna deate ma ketiv, (Yeshayahu 63:1) mi ze ba meedom chamutz begadim mibbatzra vegomer.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, vayyeshev yisrael beeretz mitzrayim beeretz goshen vayyeachazu vah vayyifru vayyirbu meod. vayyeachazu vah, achsanat almin. veyyeachazu bah, deha lehon itchaze, kema deukemuha. (davar acher 33 amar rabbi yose) vayyifru vayyirbu meod, vday, deha tzaara la sharat behu, vekayyme betafnuke alma, uvegin kach vayyifru vayyirbu meod. baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen:
Zohar, Vayigash 5: Ribbi yehuda veribbi yose iaru bichfar chanan. ad dehavu yatve be ushepizayyhu, ata chad bar nash vechad matula dechamra kameh veal beveta. addehachi, amar ribbi yehuda leribbi yose, ha taninan, dedavid malka hava mitnamnem kesus, veshenteh zeer, hech hava kam befalgut lelya. hay shiura zeer ihu vela hava itar afillu bitlatut lelya.

Amar leh, beshata deal lelya, hava yativ im kol ravreve veteh vedain dina, veasik bemille deorayyta. ulevatar hava naim shenteh ad palgut lelya, vekam befalgut lelya veitar, veishtedal befulechana demareh, beshirin vetushebchan.

Adhachi amar hahu bar nash, vechi hay milla dekaamrittu, hachi hu. raza demilla hacha, deha david malka chay vekayyaym lealam ulealme almin. vedavid malka hava natir kol yomoy dela yitam taam mita. begin deshenta chad mishshittin bemita ihu. vedavid begin ducheteh deihu chay, la hava naim ella shittin nishme. dead shittin nishme chaser chad, ihu chay. mittamman ulehala, taim bar nash tama demota, veshallit beh sitra deruach mesaava.

Veda hava natir david malka, dela yitam tama demota, veshallit (sefer acher dela yshelayt) beh sitra derucha ochora, begin deshittin nishme chaser chad, ihu raza dechayyim dilela. ad shittin nishme, deinun shittin (davar acher 33 chaser chad nishme) nishme illain, veilen raza dilhon, detalyayn behon chayye. umikkan uletatta, raza demota hu.

Veal da, david malka hava meshaer shiura delelya, begin deyitkayyem bachayyim, dela yishlot beh tama demota. vechad itpelig lelya, hava david mitkayyem beatreh. begin dechad itar palgu lelya vechitra kaddisha itar, baa dela leashkacha leh ledavid mitkashshar beatar ochora, beatar demota.

Begin dechad itpelig lelya ukedushsha illaa itar, uvar nash denaim bearseh vela itar leashgacha bikara demareh. ha ihu itkashshar beraza demota umitdabbak beatar ochora, veal da david malka hava kaim leashgacha bikara demareh tadir. chay legabbe chay, vela naim beshenta letaama tama demota. uvegin kach, hava mitnamnem kesus shittin nishme, vela bishlimu.

Atu ribbi yehuda veribbi yose uneshakuha, amru leh, ma shemach. amar lehon, chizkiyya. amru leh, yityayshsher chelach veyittakkaf orayytach. yetivu. amar ribbi yehuda, hoil vesharit, ema lan mehanne razin illain dekaamart.

Patach veamar, (Mishlei 3:19) Adonai bechachma yasad eretz konen shamayim bitvuna. ta chaze, kad bara kudesha berich hu alma, chama dela yachil leitkayyma, ad devara orayyta. begin deminnah nafkin kol nimmusin illain vetattain, uvah kayyme illae vetattae. hada hu dichtiv, Adonai bechachma yasad aretz konin shamayim bitvuna. deha bechachma kayymin kol kiyyumin dealma, vechullehu nafke miggavvah.

Davar acher Adonai bechachma yasad eretz, alma illaa la itbere ella miggo chachma. vealma tattaa la itbere ella miggo chachma tattaa. vechullehu nafkan miggo chachma illaa umiggo chachma tattaa. konen shamayim bitvuna. konen, may konen. ella, konen kol yoma veyoma vela pasik, vela ittakkan bezimna chada, ella bechol yoma veyoma atkin leh.

Vehayeynu raza dichtiv, (iyyov 15:15) veshamayim lo zakku veenav. vechi salka datach, digriuta ihu mishshamayim, ella chashivu mishshamayim ihu, begin chavivu ureu sagya, dekudesha berich hu rae behu, vachavivutayhu legabbeh. deha af al gav deihu matkin lon kol yoma veyoma, la dame beenoy deinun mittaknan kedka yeut. begin dirchimuta dilhon legabbeh, ureuteh leanhara lon tadir bela pesiku. deha alma deate appik nehorin zehirin kol yoma veyoma tadir bela pesiku, begin leanhara lon tadir. veal da lo zakku beenav. lo zakku bilchodoy la ketiv, ella lo zakku veenav. uvegin kach, konen shamayim bitvuna.
Man shamayim. da hu raza deavahan, veraza deavahan da hu yaakov deihu kelala dilhon. begin deyaakov tushebachta deavahan ihu, veihu kayyma leanhara al alma.

Uvegin deihu istallak go alma deate, nafak minneh anafa chada shappira bechezu, vechol nehorin mineh nafkin. vechol sava umeshach revu leanhara leara, uman ihu. da yosef hatztzaddik, deihu yahiv sava lechol alma, vealma minneh ittezan. uvegin kach, kudesha berich hu kol ma deavad bealma, kolla ihu beraza illaa, vecholla kedka chaze.

Adhachi ata ribbi elazar, kevan dechama lon amar, vadday shechinta hacha. bemay askitu. amru leh kol ovada. amar, vadday shappir kaamar. aval inun shittin nishme, vadday shittin nishme inun dechayyin, ben leela ben letatta. mikkan ulehala, ikka shittin nishmin ochoranin, deinun kullehu missitra demota, vedarga demota alayyhu, veikrun duremita, vechullehu taama demota.

Uvegin kach david malka hava ihu mitdebak beinun shittin nishmin dechayyin, umittamman ulehala la naim kelal. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 132:4) im etten shenat leenay leafappay tenuma. veal da shappir kaamar, begin deyakum david chay, besitra dechay vela besitra demota. yatvu kullehu veishtaddelu beorayyta veitchabbaru kechada.

Patach ribbi elazar veamar, (Tehillim 88:2) Adonai eloke yeshuati yom tzaakti vallayla negdecha. ta chaze, david malka hava kam befalgut lelya, veishtedal beorayyta beshirin vetushebchan, lechedva demalka umatronita. veda hava chedva dimhemnuta beara. begin dehay ihu shevacha dimhemnuta deitchaze beara.

Deha leela patche bechedva shirata kamma malachin illain, bechamma zinin deka meshabbechan belelya bechol sitrin. kehay gavvna letatta beara, man dimshabbach leh lekudesha berich hu beara belelya, rae beh (bae) kudesha berich hu. vechol inun malachin kaddishin deka meshabbechan leh lekudesha berich hu, kullehu tzayytin lehahu deka meshabbach leh belelya beara. dehay tushebachta ihu bishlimu, lesalka yekare dekudesha berich hu mittatta, ulezammera bechedva deyichuda.
Ta chaze, david malka katav, Adonai elohe yeshuati vegomer, Adonai elohe yeshuati, ematay ihu yeshuati. behahu yoma deakdemit tushebachta belelya legabbach, keden ihu yeshuati bimama.

Veta chaze, deha belelya, man dimshabbach lemareh betushebachta deorayyta, keden atkaf bitkifu biymama besitra dimina. deha chuta chad nafka missitra dimina, ucheden itmashshach aleh veittakkaf beh. veal da amar, Adonai elohe yeshuati yom tzaakti vegomer.

Uvegin kach amar, (Tehillim 115:17) lo hammetim yehallelu yah. lo hammetim, begin deitzterich leshabbecha chay lechay. umet lechay lav hachi, dichtiv lo hammetim yehallelu yah. vaanachnu nevarech yah, deha anan chayyin velet lan chulaka besitra demota kelal. chizkiyyahu amar, (Yeshayahu 38:19) chay chay hu yodecha kamoni, begin dechay itkerav lechay. david malka ihu chay, vekureva dileh lechay haolamim. uman deitkeriv legabbeh, ihu chay. dichtiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom. uchetiv, (Shmuel b 23:20) uvenayahu ben yehoyada ben ish chay rav pealim mikkavtzeel.
Zohar, Vayigash 6: Patach hahu yuday avatreh veamar, (Devarim 8:10) veachalta vesavata uverachta et Adonai elokecha. vechi la mevarchinan leh lekudesha berich hu ad la nichul, veha it lan leakdume betzafra ulesiddure shevacha dileh (demareh) kedka yeut, ulevarcha bishmeh ad la yevarech leachara bealma. uchetiv (Vayikra 29) lo tochelu al haddam, asur leh lemechal ad la yevarech lemareh. vehasheta ketiv veachalta vesavata uverachta.

Ella, da birchata ditzlota deyichuda, veda birchata dimzona. leachazaa legabbe darga dimhemnuta, sava kedka yaot. ucheden bee levarcha leh kedka yeut, dehahu darga dimhemnuta yitravve vivarech, veyitmalle chedu mechayyin dilela kema deitzterich, begin lemehav lan mezone.

Deha kashin mezona devar nash kame kudesha berich hu, kikriat yam sof. may tama. begin dimzona dealma dilela hu, ditnan bane chayye umezone vechulei, uvegin kach kashyayn kammeh mezone dealma. deha bemazzala talya milta. deminneh nafke mezone vechayye uvane. uvegin kach kashin kammeh mezone dealma, deha lav birshuteh kayyma, ad deyitbarech ihu.
Kegavvna da ziyivgin dealma kashin kammeh, vecholla begin derakia vilon la meshammesh kelum. vechol shekken illen millin dekayymin leela beatar ochora, veal da itzterich leitbarcha.

Ta chaze, kol zivugin dealma kashin kammeh hay darga, begin dechad hay ziuuga kaddisha ishtakkach, kol nishmatin nafkin miggo hay mazzala leela, deihu hahu nahar denagid venafik. vechad tiuveta ishtakkach milra leela, keden parchin nishmatin, veityeyhivu kullehu kelilan dechar venukeva kechada behay darga. ulevatar ihu parish lon kol chad vechad leatreh kedka chaze leh. ulevatar kashin kamme hay darga lechabbera lon kekadmita, begin dela mitchabberan, bar keinun arche debar nash, vecholla leela talyayn.
Veal da kashin kammeh kikriat yam sof. deha keriat yamma leitpattecha beh shevilin, leela ihu. uchema demitpattechin shevilin veorchin beh, hachi itbakka veitpattach.
Uvegin kach kolla talya leela, uveinan levarcha leh, ulemehav leh tukefa mittatta, begin deyitbarcha milleela, veyittakkaf kedka chaze. veal da ketiv, uverachta et Adonai, et dayyka.

Ulegabbe hay atar, itzterich leachazaa kammeh sava unehiru deanpin. ulegabbe sitra ochora, bezimna deihi shalta bealma, bee leachazaa kammeh kafna. dehahu darga raav ihu, veitchaze leachazaa kammeh kafna vela sova, hoil vesava la shalta bealma. veal da, veachalta vesavata uverachta et Adonai elokecha. amar ribbi elazar, hachi hu vadday, vehachi itzterich.

Amar ribbi yehuda, zakkain inun tzaddikayyay dekureva dilhon ihu shelama bealma. begin deyade leyachada yichuda, umekarve kureva leasgaa shelama bealma. deha yosef vihuda ad la itkerivu da im da, la hava shelama. kevan deitkerivu yosef vihuda kechada, keden asgiu shelama bealma. vechedu ittosaf leela vetatta, kema dekureva dihuda veyosef vechullehu shivtin ishtakkachu kechada beh beyosef. vehahu kureva asge shelama bealma, kema deokimna. dichtiv, vayyiggash elav yehuda:
Zohar, Vayigash 7: Velo yachol yosef lehitappek lechol hannitztzavim alav vegomer, ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Tehillim 112:9) pizzar natan laevyonim tzidkato omedet laad karno tarum bechavod. ta chaze, kudesha berich hu bara alma, veashlit aleh laadam, dihe malka al kolla.

Vehay bar nash, mitparshan minneh bealma kamma zinin. minnehon tzaddikayya uminnehon rashshiaya. minnehon tippeshin uminnehon chakkimin. vechullehu itkayymu bealma, atirin umiskenin. vechullehu begin lemizke illen beillen, lemizke tzaddikaya im rashshiaya, lemizke chakkimin im tippeshin, lemizke atirin im miskenin. deha begin kach, zache bar nash lechayye alma, veitkashshar beilana dechayye. vela od, ella deha tzedaka deihu avid, kaim lealmin. dichtiv vetzidkato omedet laad.

Pizzar natan laevyonim. ribbi elazar amar, kad bara kudesha berich hu alma, kaim leh al samcha chad, vetzaddik shemeh, vehay tzaddik ihu kiyyuma dealma, veda ihu deashke, vezan lecholla. dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan umishsham yippared vehaya learbaa rashim.

Umishsham yippared, mahu yippared. ella, hahu mezona umashkaya dehahu nahar, natil ginta kolla, ulevatar itbaddar hahu mashkaya led sitrin dealma. vechamma inun dimtzappan leitshakyay uleittezna mittamman. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 145:15) eni chol elecha yesabberu veatta noten lahem et achlam beitto. uvegin kach pizzar natan laevyonim, da tzaddik. tzidkato omedet laad, da keneset yisrael. divgin kach, ihi kayyma beraza dishlam, bekiyyuma shelim. rasha yire vechaas, da malchut ovde kochavim umazzalot.

Ta chaze, malchut shamayim, ihi be makdesha. lekayyma kol miskene bego tzilla desheruta dishchinta. vetzaddik da ihu ikre gabbay tzedaka, lemechan ulemezan lecholla. dichtiv pizzar natan laevyonim. begin kach, gabbae tzedaka natle agra lokovel kullehu deyahave tzedaka.

Ta chaze, velo yachol yosef lehitappek lechol hannitztzavim, illen inun kol dekayyme leittezana uleitshakyay minneh. velo amad ish itto behitvadda yosef el echav. itto, da keneset yisrael. echav, illen shear retichin chayaylin, dichtiv behu (Tehillim 122:8) lemaan achay vereay. davar acher, velo amad ish itto. bezimna dekudesha berich hu ate leizdavvevga bikkeneset yisrael. behitvadda yosef el echav, bezimna dekudesha berich hu hava mitchabber behu beyisrael, begin deinun natle bilchodayyhu, vela chibbura deammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot bahadayyhu. begin kach (Bamidbar 29:35) bayyom hashshemini atzeret tihye lachem. deha bezimna da, ihu kudesha berich hu bilchodoy, bechibbura chada im yisrael, dichtiv behu achay vereay kema deukemuha.

Ribbi yesa patach kera, bezimna dekudesha berich hu yokim lah lichneset yisrael meafra, veyibbae leinnakma nikmata meammemaya ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, keden ketiv, (Yeshayahu 63:3) umeamim en ish itti. uchetiv hacha, velo amad ish itto behitvadda yosef el echav. kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 63:9) vaynattelem vaynasseem kol yeme olam.

Velo yachol yosef lehitappek, ribbi chizkiyya patach veamar, (Tehillim 123:1) shir hammaalot elecha nasati et enay hayyoshvi bashshamayim, hay kera ukemuha veittemar. aval ta chaze, elecha nasati et enay, uchetiv, (Tehillim 121:1) essa enay el heharim. ella, da leela veda letatta. essa enay el heharim, da leela. begin leamshacha birchan meela letatta, meillen harim illain, leamshacha minnayyhu birchan lichneset yisrael deitbarcha minnayyhu. elecha nasati et enay, lemitzpe ulechakkaa leinnun birchan denachatu mittamman letatta.

Hayyoshvi bashshamayim, dechol tukefaha vechelaa vekiyyumaha, ihu bashshamayim. begin dechad yovela aftach mabbue dechol inun tarin, kullehu kayyme bashshamayim. vechevan deshamayim natil kol inun nehorin denafke miyyovela, keden ihu zan veashke lah lichneset yisrael al yeda detzaddik chad.

Vechevan deda itar legabbah, kamma inun dekayyman bechol sitrin leitshaka uleitbarcha mittamman. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 104:21) hakkefirim shoagim latteref ulevakkesh meel achlam. ucheden, ihi salka beraza derazin kedka chaze (davar acher 33 leh), umekabbela iddunin mivaalah kedka yeut, vechullehu dekayymin bechol sitrin amde bilchodayyhu. kema deat amer, velo amad ish itto. dichtiv, vayyikra hotziu kol ish mealay, ulevatar deihi mekabbela iddunin mibbaalah, kullehu itshakyayn levatar veittezanu. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 104:11) yashku kol chayto saday yishberu feraim tzemaam.
Zohar, Vayigash 8: Ribbi yose patach kera beeliyyahu, dichtiv, (Melachim 1 17:20) vayyikra el Adonai vayyomar Adonai elohay hagam al haalmana asher ani mitgorer immah hareota lehamit et benah. ta chaze, tere havu dekaamrin millin lokovel kudesha berich hu, moshe veeliyyahu. moshe amar, (Shemot Adonai:22) lamma hareota laam hazze. veeliyyahu amar, hareota lehamit et benah, vetarvayyhu milla chada kaamru.

May tama. ella raza ihu. moshe amar, lamma hareota, may tama. ella, begin deityehiv reshu lesitra ochora leshalletaa alayyhu deyisrael, hareota, yehavt reshu lesitra ochora dera, lemishlat alayyhu. eliyyahu amar, hareota yehavt reshu lesitra dera, litol nishmata deda. veda hu hareota, vecholla raza chada.

Ta chaze, eliyyahu amar, hagam al haalmana asher ani mitgorer immah. begin dekudesha berich hu amar leh leeliyyahu, hinne tzivviti sham ishsha almana lechalkelecha. vechol man dezan umefarnes leman deitzterich leh, vechol shekken beyoma dechafna. ha itachid beilana dechayye, vegarim leh chayyim velivnoy, veha okimna. vehasheta eliyyahu amar, kol man dekiyyem nafsha bealma, zache leh chayyim vezache leitachada beilana dechayye. vehasheta shalta ilana demota sitra dera al haalmana deant pekadt lemezan li. begin kach hareota (lamma haraot).

Vei tema dera la itavid levar nash meim kudesha berich hu. ta chaze, bezimna devar nash azil limina, netiru dekudesha berich hu tadir legabbeh, vela yachil sitra ochora leshaltaa aleh. vehay ra itkafya kammeh, vela yachil leshalletaa. vechevan dintira dekudesha berich hu itavra minneh, begin deihu itdabbak bera, keden hahu ra, kevan dechame delav immeh netiru, keden shallit aleh, veate leshetzaa leh, ucheden ityehiv leh reshu, venatil nishmateh.

Moshe amar lamma hareota, deityehiv leh reshu lesitra dera, lemishlat alayyhu deyisrael, lemeheve beshibuda dileh. davar acher lamma hareota, dechama kamma minhon dehavu metin, veitmesaru besitra dera.

Ta chaze, beshata detov itar, deihu yemina, kol chedu, vechol tivu, vechol birchan mishtakkechan, vecholla bachashay ihu, kema deukemuha, deamre baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed bachashay, veraza da begin (sefer acher dehay ihu yichuda) deihu keden yichuda kedka chaze.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, vechi eliyyahu, kevan deihu gazar, vekudesha berich hu mekayyem. veihu gazir al shemaya, dela laachata mitra vetalla, hech dachil ihu meizevel, deshadderat leh. dichtiv, (Melachim 1 19:2) ki chaet machar asim et nafshecha kenefesh achad mehem, umiyyad dachil vearak al nafsheh.

Amar leh ribbi yose, ha ukemuha, detzaddikaya la baan leatracha lemarehon, beatar denizka ishtakkechat (leh) leena. kegavvna dishmuel, dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 16:2) ech elech veshama shaul vaharagani, amar leh, eglat bakar tikkach beyadecha. begin detzaddikayya la baan leatracha lemarehon beatar denizka ishtakkach. uf hachi eliyyahu, kevan dechama denizka ishtakkach, la bae leatracha lemareh.

Amar leh, ana milla shemana, deha beeliyyahu la ketiv beh vayyira vayyelech el nafsho, ella (Melachim 1 19:3) vayyar. reiya chama. uma chama, ella chama deha mikkamma shenin azal batreh malach hammavt, vela itmasar bideh. vehasheta vayyelech el nafsho, may vayyelech el nafsho, azal lekiyyuma denafsha, uman ihu ilana dechayye leitdabbeka tamman.

Ta chaze, kullehu ketiv et nafsho, vehacha ketiv el nafsho, veraza da shemana, deamar ribbi shimon, kol nishmatin dealma, kullehu nafke mehahu nahar denagid venafik, vechullehu nakit lon hahu tzerora dechayyay (dechayye), vechad nukeva itabberat min dechura, kullehu betiuveta ditren sitrin, betiuveta denukeva legabbe dechura. vechad tiuveta didchura nafka biruta, keden inun nishmatin bekiyyuma yattir, begin decholla betiuveta ureu deilana dechayyay. veeliyyahu, begin dehava mehahu reuta yattir mibbar nash ochora, itkeyyaym.

Uvegin kach el nafsho ketiv, vela ketiv et nafsho. deha et nafsho da hi nukeva. vei tema veel haishsha amar, kelala diddechar venukeva. kad hi bego dechura, keden veel haishsha amar. et haishsha, nukeva bilchudaha, vela diddechura. kegavvna da el nafsho, dachar bilchodoy, et nafsho nukeva bilchudaha vela kelilu diddechura. uvegin deihu missitra diddechura yattir mikkol bene alma, itkeyyaym bekiyyumeh yattir, vela mit kishar bene alma. begin decholla ihu meilana dechayye, vela miggo afra. uvegin da istallak leela, vela mit keorach kol bene alma. dichtiv, (Melachim b 2:11) vayyaal eliyyahu bisara hashshamayim.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv vehinne rechev esh vesuse esh vegomer, (Shemot 197 amud alef) deha keden itpashshat gufa min rucha, veistallak dela kishar orach bene alma. veishtaar malacha kaddisha, kishar kaddishe elyonin, veavid shelichuta vealma. veha ukemuha, denissin deavad kudesha berich hu bealma, al yedeh itavidan.

Veta chaze, ma ketiv, (Melachim 1 19:3) vayyishal et nafsho. bekadmita, vayyelech el nafsho, kema deittemar bekiyyuma. vehacha et nafsho lamut, ilana deveh sharya mota. vetamman itgeli aleh kudesha berich hu, kema dichtiv, (Melachim 1 19:12) tze veamadta bahar. ma ketiv batreh, veachar haraash esh la vaesh Adonai veachar haesh kol demama dakka, da hu atar penimaa decholla, deminneh nafkin kol nehorin.

Ma ketiv, (Melachim 1 19:13) vayhi kishmoa eliyyahu vayyalet panav beaddarto vehinne elav kol vayyomer (tissa 190 amud alef) ma lecha fo eliyyahu vayyomer kanno kinneti, amar leh kudesha berich hu, ad matay atta mekanne li, terakat galla dela yachil leshalletaa bach mota lealma, vealma la yachil lemisbelach im banay (nasha). amar leh, ki azvu veritcha beni yisrael vegomer. amar leh, chayyecha, debchol atar devanay (nasha) yekayyeymu keyaym kaddisha, ant tehe zammin tamman. (davar acher veha ittemar begin kach metakkenin kurisaya leeliyyahu deihu zammin tamman)

Ta chaze, ma garam hahi milla deeliyyahu, dichtiv, (Melachim 1 19:18) vehisharti beyisrael shivat alafim kol habbirkayim asher lo karu labbaal vechol happe asher lo nashak lo. amar leh kudesha berich hu, mikkan ulehala, dela yachil alma lemisbelach im banay (nasha). veet elisha ben shafat meavel mechola timshach lenavi tachtecha. yehe nevia ochora legabbe banay (nasha), veat tistallak leatrach.

Veta chaze, kol hahu bar nash dimkanni leh lekudesha berich hu, la yachil malacha demota leshalletaa beh, kishar bene nasha. veyitkayyem beh shelam, veha ukemuha. kema deittemar befinchas, (Bamidbar 25:12) lachen emor hinni noten lo et beriti shalom:
Zohar, Yitro 27: (Shemot 20:8) zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho. rabbi yitzchak amar, ketiv (Bereshit 2:3) vayvarech elohim et yom hashshevii, uchetiv bamman (Shemot 16:26) sheshet yamim tilketuhu uveyom hashshevii shabbat lo yihye bo. kevan dela mishtechach beh mezone, ma bircheta ishtechach beh.

Ella hachi tana, kol birkan dilella vetatta, beyoma sheviaa talyayn. vetana, amay la ishtechach manna beyoma sheviaa, mishshum dehahu yoma, mitbarchan minneh kol shita yomin illain, vechol chad vechad yahiv mezoneh letatta, kol chad beyomoy, mehahi beracha demitbarchan beyoma sheviaa.

Uvegine kach, man deihu bedarga dimhemanuta, bae lesaddera patora, uleatkena seudata belelya deshabbeta, begin deyitbarech patoreh, kol innun shita yomin, deha behahu zimna, izdaman beracha, leitbarcha kol shita yomin deshabbeta, uvirchata la ishtechach befatora rekanayya. veal kach, bae lesaddera patoreh belelya deshabbeta, benahame uvimzone.
Rabbi yitzchak amar, afilu beyoma deshabbeta name. rabbi yehuda amar, bae leitanga behay yoma, ulemechal telat seudate beshabbeta, begin deyishtechach sava veinnuga behay yoma bealma.

Rabbi abba amar, leizdammena bircheta beinnun yomin dilella, demitbarchan mehay yoma. vehay yoma, malya resheh dizer anpin, mittalla denachit meattika kaddisha setima decholla, veatil lechakla detappuchin kaddishin, telat zimne, mikkad ayiyil shabbeta, deyitbarchun kullehu kachada.

Veal da bae bar nash, leitanga telat zimnin illen, deha beha talya mehemanuta dilella, beattika kaddisha, uvizer appin, uvechakla detappuchin. uvae bar nash leitanga behu, ulemechode behu. uman degara seudata minayyhu, achze pegimuta leela veonsheh dehahu bar nash saggi.

Begine kach, bae lesaddera patoreh, telat zimne, mikkad ayiyil shabbeta, vela yishtekach patoreh rekanayya, vetishre bircheta aleh, kol shear yome deshabbeta. uvehay milla, achze, vetale mehemanuta leella.

Rabbi shimon amar, hay man deashlim telat seudate beshabbata, kala nafik umachreza aleh, (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai, da seudata chada, lokovel (Vayikra 288 amud bet) attika kaddisha dechol kaddishin. vehirkavticha al bomote aretz, da seudata tinyayna, lokovel chakla detappuchin kaddishin. vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha, da hu shelimu deishtelim bizer appin.

Ulokavlayyhu bae leashlema seudateh, uvae leitanga bechullehu seudate, ulemechode bechol chad vechad minnayyhu, mishshum deihu mehemanuta shelemata. uvegin kach, shabbeta ityakkar, mikkol shear zimnin vechaggin, mishshum decholla beh ishtechach, vela ishtechach hachi bechullehu zimne vechagge. amar rabbi chiyyay, begin kach, mishshum deishtechach kolla beh, idkar telat zimnin. dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:2) vaychal elohim bayyom hashshevii. vayyishbot bayyom hashshevii. vayvarech elohim et yom hashshevii.

Rabbi abba, (nusach acher rav hamenuna sava) kad hava yativ bisudata deshabbeta, have chadde, bechol chad vechad, vahava amar, da hi seudata kaddisha, deattika kaddisha setima decholla. bisudata achara hava amar, da hi seudata dekudesha berich hu. vechen bechullehu seudate, vahava chadde bechol chad vechad. kad hava ashlim seudate, amar ashlimu seudate dimhemanuta.

Rabbi shimon, kad hava ate lisudata, hava amar hachi, atkinu seudata dimhemnuta illaa, atkinu seudata demalka, vahava yativ vechadde. kad ashlim seudata telitaa, havo machrize aleh, az titannag al Adonai vehirkavticha al bomote aretz vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha.

Amar rabbi elazar leavuy, illen seudate hech mittaknin. amar leh, lelya deshabbeta, ketiv, vehirkavticha al bomote aretz. beh belelya, mitbarcha matronita, vechullehu chakal tappuchin, umitbarcha patoreh devar nash, venishmeta ittosfat, vehahu lelya, chedva dematronita have. uvae bar nash lemechode bechedvavta, ulemechal seudata dematronita.

Beyoma deshabbeta, bisudata tinyayna, ketiv (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai. al Adonai vadday. dehahi shaata itgalya attika kaddisha, vechullehu almin bechedvavta, ushelimu vechedvavta deattika avdenan, useudata dileh hu vadday.

Bisudata telitaa deshabbeta, ketiv vehaachalticha nachalat yaakov avicha. da hi seudata dizer appin, dehave bishlemuta. vechullehu shita yomin, mehahu shelimu mitbarchan. uvae bar nash lemechode bisudateh, uleashlema illen seudate, deinnun seudate mehemanuta shelemata, dezara kaddisha deyisrael, di mehemanuta illaa, deha dilhon hi, vela deammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. uvegini kach amar, (Shemot lo) beni uven bene yisrael.

Ta chaze, bisudate illen, ishtemodun yisrael, deinnun beni malka. deinnun mehechala demalka, deinnun beni mehemanuta, uman defagim chad seudata minnayyhu, achze pegimuta leella, veachze garmeh delav mibbene malka illaa hu, delav mibbene hechala demalka hu delav mizzara kaddisha deyisrael hu. veyahavin aleh chumera ditlat millin, dina degehinnam vegomer.

Veta chazi, bechullehu shear zimnin vechaggin, bae bar nash lechde, ulemechde lemiskene. vei hu chadde bilchodoy, vela yahiv lemiskene, onsheh saggi, deha bilchodoy chadde, vela yahiv chidu leachara. aleh ketiv, (Malachi 2:3) vezeriti feresh al penechem peresh chaggechem. vei ihu beshabbata chadde, af al gav dela yahiv leachara, la yahavin aleh onsha, kishar zimnin vechaggin, dichtiv peresh chaggechem. persh chaggechem kaamar, velo peresh shabbattechem. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 1:14) chadshechem umoadechem sana nafshi. veillu shabbat la kaamar.

Uvegine kach ketiv, beni uven bene yisrael. umishshum dechol mehemanuta ishtechach beshabbata, yahavin leh levar nash nishmeta achara, nishmeta illaa, nishmeta dechol shelimu bah, kedugema dealma deate. uvegine kach ikre shabbat. mahu shabbat. shema dekudesha berich hu. shema deihu shelim mikkol sitroy.

Amar rabbi yosi, vadday kach hu. vavy leh levar nash, dela ashlim chedavavta demalka kaddisha. uman chedvavta deleh. illen telat seudate mehemanuta. seudate deavraham yitzchak veyaakov kelilan behu. vechullehu chidu al chidu mehemanuta shelemuta, mikkol sitroy.

Tana, bahaden yoma mitatteran avahan, vechol benin yankin, ma delav hachi bechol shear chaggin uzemanin. bahaden yoma, chayyayvayya degehinnam nayychin. bahaden yoma, kol dinin itkafyayn, vela mitarin bealma. bahaden yoma orayyta mitattera beitrin shelemin. bahaden yoma, chedvavta vetafnuka ishtema, bematan vechamshin almin.

Ta chazi, bechol shita yome deshabbeta, kad mata shaata ditzlota demincha, dina (156 amud alef) takkifa shalta, vechol dinin mitarin. aval beyoma deshabbeta, kad mata idan ditzlota demincha, raava deraavin ishtechach, veattika kaddisha galya ratzon dileh, vechol dinin mitkafyayn, umishtechach reuta vecheddu becholla.

Uvehay ratzon, istallak moshe, nevia mehemana kaddisha mealma. begin leminda, dela bedina istallak, vehahi shaata beratzon deattika kaddisha nafak nishmateh, veittammar beh. begin kach, (Devarim la) velo yada ish et kevurato ketiv. ma attika kaddisha, temira mikkol temirin, vela yadin illain vetattain. uf hacha, hay nishmeta deittammar behay ratzon, deitgalya beshaata ditzlota demincha deshabbeta, ketiv velo yada ish et kevurato vehu tamir mikkol temirin dealma, vedina la shalta beh. zakkaa chulakeh demoshe.

Tana, behay yoma, deorayyta mitattera beh, mitattera becholla, bechol innun pikkudin bechol innun gizrin veonashin, beshivin anafin dinhora, dezaharin mikkol sitra vesitra. man chame, anafin denafkin mikkol anafa vaanafa, chamishsha kayymin bego ilana, kullehu anpin behu achidan. man chame, innun tarin demitpattechan bechol setar usetar, kullehu mizdaharin venaharin, behahu nehora denafik vela pasik.

Kal karoza nafik, ittearu kaddishe elyonin, ittearu amma kaddisha, deitbachar leella vetatta. ittearu chedvavta lekadmut marechon. ittearu bechedvavta shelemata. izdemanu bitlat chedvavn, ditlat avahan. izdemanu lekadmut mehemanuta, dechedvav dechol chedvavta. zakkaa chulekechon, yisrael kaddishin, bealma den uvealma deate. da hu yaruta lechon, mikkol ammim ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. veal da ketiv, beni uven bene yisrael.

Amar Rabbi yehuda, hachi hu vadday. veal da ketiv zachor et yom hashshabbat lekaddesho uchetiv (Vayikra 19:2) kedoshim tihyu ki kadosh ani Adonai. uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 58:13) vekarata lashshabbat oneg likdosh Adonai mechubbad.

Tana, behay yoma, kol nishmatehon detzaddikayyay, mitaddenin betafnuke attika kaddisha, setima dechol setimin. verucha chada meinnuga dehahu attika kaddisha mitpashta (hahu mitpashshet) bechullehu almin, vesalleka venachta, umitpashsheta lechullehu bene kaddishin, lechullehu neture orayyta, venayychin benayycha shelim, mitneshe mikkullehu, kol rugezin, kol dinin, vechol pulechanin kashin. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 14:3) beyom hinniach Adonai lach meatzbecha umiragzecha umin haavoda hakkasha.

Begine kach, shakil shabbeta lokovel orayyta, vechol denatir shabbeta, keillu natir orayyta kulla. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 56:2) ashre enosh yaase zot uven adam yachazik bah shomer shabbat mechallelo veshomer yado measot kol ra. ishtema, deman denatir shabbat, keman denatir orayyta kulla.

Rabbi yuday shail leh lera shimon, yoma chad deara immeh bearcha, amar leh, Rabbi, ha ketiv (sefer acher befarsheta deshabbat) befarsheta da shabbat, deamar yeshaya, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 56:4) cho amar Adonai lassarisim asher yishmeru et shabbetotay vegomer, venatatti lahem beveti uvechomotay vegomer. ma ka mayyre.

Amar leh, kapputekaa, chamarach kitre betifsa, unechit, demilla deorayyta bae tzachuta. o afche laachorach, vezil avatray, utechavvevn libbach. amar leh, begineh demor avidna archa, uvatreh demor estakkel bishchinta.

Amar leh, ta chaze, milla da ha ukemuha chavrayyay, vela perishu milla. cho amar Adonai lassarisim. man sarisim. illen innun chavrayyay, demishtaddele beorayyta, umesarse garmayyhu kol shita yomin deshabbeta, velaan beorayyta, uvelelya deshabbeta mezarze garmayyhu beziuuga dilhon, mishshum deyade raza illaa, beshaata dematronita izdavvevgat bemalka.

Veinnun chavrayyay deyadin raza da, mechavvevnin libbayyhu limhemanuta demarehon umitbarchan beibba dimehon behahu lelya. veda hu dichtiv, asher yishmeru, kema deat amar, (Bereshit 37:11) veaviv shamar et haddavar.

Veikrun sarisim vadday, begin lechakkaa leshabbeta leashkecha raava demarehon, dichtiv vvcharo baasher chafatzti. may baasher chafatzti. da ziuuga dematronita. umachazikim bivriti, kolla chad, bivriti setam. zakkaa chulakeh deman deitkaddash bikdusha da, veyada raza da.

Ta chazi, ketiv sheshet yamim taavod veasita kol melachtecha veyom hashshevii shabbat laAdonai elohecha vegomer, kol melachtecha, beinnun shita yome avidtayyhu divne nasha uvegin hay milla. la mizdavvevge chavrayyay, bar bezimna dela yishtekach meavidtayyhu divni nasha, ella avidte dekudesha berich hu. umay avidte. ziuuga dematronita, leappaka nishmatin kaddishin lealma.

Uvegin kach, behay lelya chavrayyay mitkaddeshe bikdushsha demarehon, umechavvevne libbayyhu, venafke bene maale, benin kaddishin, dela satan limina velismala, benin demalka umatronita. veal illen ketiv, (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem, laAdonai elohechem vadday. begin deillen ikrun benin dileh, benin lemalka ulematronita.

Veha datayyhu dechavrayyay deyadin raza da, beda mitdabbekan. uvegin kach ikrun benin lekudesha berich hu. vehani innun dealma mitkayyeyma beginayyhu. vechad salik alma bedina, istakkal kudesha berich hu beinnun benoy, umerachem al alma. veal da ketiv (Yirmeyahu 2:21) kullo zera emet. zera emet vadday. mahu emet. izka kaddisha shelemata. kema deat amer (Micha 7:20) titten emet leyaakov. (emet da kudesha berich hu) vecholla chad. uvegine kach, zera emet vadday.

Amar leh Rabbi yuday, berich rachamana deshadarni hacha, berich rachamana, deha milla da shemana mippumach. bacha rabbi yuday. amar leh Rabbi shimon, amay ka bachit. amar leh, bachena, daamena devavy leinun bene alma, dearchehon kivire, vela yade vela mistakkele, detav lon dela itberiu. vavy lealma kad yippuk mor minneh, deman yachil legallaa razin, uman yinda lon, uman yistakkal bearche orayyta.

Amar leh, chayyecha, let alma ella leinun chavrayyay, demishtaddele beorayyta veyadin setime orayyta. vadday bikshot gazru chavrayyay al amma deara, dimchabbelin archayyhu, vela yadin ben yemina lismala, deha innun kivire, deyeot lemebad behu dina, afillu beyom hakkippurim. veal benayyhu ketiv, (Hoshea 2:6) ki vene zenunim hemma, vene zenunim mammash.

Amar leh, Rabbi, hay kera bae leityayshsheva bearchoy. ketiv (Yeshayahu 56:5) venatatti lahem beveti uvechomotay yad vashem tov mibbanim umibbanot shem olam etten lo. etten lahem mibbae leh, mahu etten lo.

Amar leh, ta chaze, venatatti lahem beveti, mahu beti. kema deat amar (Bamidbar 12:7) bechol beti neeman hu. (341 dekudesha berich hu ikre bet) uvechomotay, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 62:6) al chomotayich yerushala 40 hifkadti shomrim yad vashem, kelomar deyishlefun nishmatin kaddishin midducheta da. vehahu yad, chulak beashlamuta. tav, malya mibbenin umibbenatan. shem olam etten lo, lehahu chulak shelim. asher lo yikkaret ledare darin. davar acher etten lo lehahu deyada raza demilla, veyitkevavn bema devae lechavvevna.

Tu amar Rabbi shimon, ketiv, (Shemot 35:3) lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem beyom hashshabbat. may taama. begin dela itchaze dina behay yoma. vei tema ha laggavoah salleka. bechol moshvotechem kaamar, vela laggavoah. vehahu desalleka laggavoah, leachfeya ledina achara salleka. detanenan, it eshsha achla eshsha. veesha demadbecha, achla eshsha achara.
Uvegine kach, itgalya attika kaddisha behay yoma, mikkol shear yomin. uvezimna deitgalya attika, la itchaze dina kelal. vechol illain vetattain mishtakkechin bechedvavta shelemata, vedina la shalta.

Tana, ketiv (Shemot 31:17) ki sheshet yamim asa Adonai et hashshamayim veet haaretz. sheshet yamim vadday, vela besheshet. vehane yomin kaddishin illain, ikrun yome dishma kaddisha itkelil behu, veinnun itteklilan beh. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael mikkol ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, alayyhu ketiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom.

rashi: Vehaya kiroto ki en hannaar vamet. aviv mitztzarato:
Lehashiv yadcha al choravot noshavot. lehashechit shenit et hearim, shehayu charevot ad henna, veachshav nityashshevu:
Veel am meussaf. meammim haosim atta mikne vekinyan:
Al tabbur haaretz. al gova vechozek haaretz, ketabbur ze, shehu emtzai shel adam umeshuppa mikkol tzedadav:
targum: Lemibbaz biza ulemede adaa lechanasha mashiryatach al charvata deityatva veal ama deitkanshu mibbene ammaya deitzlachu benichsin vekinyanin yatvin al tukefa deara:

ohc: Vayyomer paro vegomer lemor vegomer. tzarich ladaat kavvanat amro lemor, gam kashe amro avicha vegomer bau elecha, hare ze ba lelammed venimtza lamed baddavar atzmo shellimmed.

Achen timtza ki paro bedabbero el yosef inyan echav sheyyikchu et avihem veyavou, amar (Bereshit 45:17): "emor el achecha zot asu vegomer ukechu et avichem vegomer uvou elay". vedavar ze yesh bo shete mashmauyyot: haachat ki yedabber alehem mishshem paro ki hu hametzavve davar, vehashsheniyya ki yosef yomar lahem ken mippi atzmo. uferush ze hu yoter tzodek mimma shemmatzinu sheamar achar kach (Bereshit 45:19): "veatta tzuvveta" vegomer. veim hakkol hu divre paro, lo yitztarech lomar shennatal rishyon mipparo, halo hakkol hu divre paro. vehinne timtza kesheddibber yosef el echav kodem sheyyedabber lefaro amar lahem (Bereshit 46:31): "eele veaggida lefaro vegomer achay vegomer bau elay", hare gilla dato ki hu hammetzavve otam lavo etzlo vehinne bau elav haanashim, veze hitzdik perush sheni. vechaasher dibber el paro lo dikdek lomar "bau elay" ella setam "achay vegomer bau meeretz kenaan" vegomer. ze yaggid ki biatam hi lefaro, velaze modio lomar kiyyemu devarecha, uchemo shepperashti bappasuk hassamuch laze. asher al ken heshiv paro leyosef lemor: avicha veachecha bau elecha, perush, shettomar shebbiat achecha bau elecha, ki en kavvanati beamri "emor el achecha zot asu" bishlichuti tedabber alehem ki ani hammetzavve, ella hirsheti otcha shettedabber alehem mishshimcha sheyyavou elecha, uchevar hirsheti otcha shettitten lahem tuv eretz mitzrayim, veim ken "eretz mitzrayim lefanecha hi bemetav haaretz" vegomer.
