Vehahefresh shebben im yihye haddavar bemitzvat paro o al pi yosef, yesh baze lomar tzad genay vetzad shevach. tzad genay sheshshalal hachiyyuv mimmennu alehem, veod ki minnimuse hammalchut kesheyyitten melech gedulla o hanaa leadam echad hi lo mattenat olamit, velaze im yihyu haddevarim hanneemarim mippi paro hinne hinnam baim lemaamar hammelech, vechiyyuv al hammelech lisbol ullam umetav haaretz yuttan lahem nitzchi bemalchuto. velaze hikpid paro shello yihye haddavar mimmennu ella miyyosef, vehachiyyuv elav hu velo al paro, uvaze en mattenato olamit ki eno ella shallit beeretz mitzrayim veen lo shem malchut, umattenato tehe kayyemet kol zeman sheyyachpotz hammelech bah. uvaze nitkavven shello yachshov yosef ki hu tzarich lahem, uletzorech hammalchut shalach acharehem leheyotam gibbore chayil lihyot chel vechoma lemalchuto. laze amar elav ki hu en lo tzorech bahem.

Vetzad hashshevach hu, ki lamma yitztarech lehodio haddavar keish asher en koach beyado laasot davar ad sheyyikkach reshut meet hammelech, halo kevar nittan lo reshut bakkol veaso yaase. vehu amro bau elecha – rauy atta sheyyavou bishvilcha, uvechoach maamarcha "eretz mitzrayim lefanecha hi, bemetav haaretz" vegomer mibbeli tzorech kachat reshut mimmenni. ulederech ze titparesh od "lemor" shennatan lo reshut lomar haddevarim hanneemarim elav, vehu al derech amram beferek 1 mimmassechet yoma (4:) veze leshono: amar rabbi menashya minnayin laomer davar lachavero shehu beval tomar ad sheyyomar lo emor, dichtiv "vaydabber Adonai vegomer lemor", ad kan. velaze hutzrach paro lehareshoto ki chol yekar ugedulla neemar lo mippi paro, vahagam sheyyaggia ketzat pechitut erech paro beemtzaut haddevarim, en bechach kelum.

Od yirmoz betevat elecha lemor lo ki taam haddavar shetztzivva lahem sheyyavou eno ella lema shennogea lichvodo shel yosef, kede shettukkar mishpachto bemitzrayim shello yihye nechshav lishfal anashim. vahagam shehukkeru echav bayyom shehitvadda alehem, odennu bachashad sheraa kat shel bachurim vechinna atzmo alehem, kaamur bedivrehem zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 100,9) befasuk (Bereshit 50:21) "vaynachem otam vaydabber al libbam". uveviat aviv veechav yeamen haddavar, vehu amro bau elecha – letzarkecha velichvodcha hi biatam:

rashi: Hon ashir. battora:
Kiryat uzzo. hi lo:
Mechittat dallim resham. aniyyutam, shello asku battora, hi mechittatam:
targum: Kinyana deattira kerakka deusheneh veshetzya demiskena tzerichutehon:

rashi: Veatta ven adam kach lecha etz echad vegomer. uchetov alav lihuda velivne yisrael chaverav. arba tevot hallalu ketov alav, lemor: etz ze lihuda velishevet binyamin shennilva alav:
Velakach etz echad uchetov alav. ze leyosef etz efrayim ushear tisha shevatim shehayu achare yaravam, shehaya mishshevet efrayim (Melachim 1 11:26):
targum: Veat bar adam sav lach lucha chada uchetov alohi leshivta dihuda velivne yisrael achehon vesav lucha chada uchetov alohi leshivta deyosef di hu shivta deefrayim vechol bet yisrael achehon:

rashi: He. kemo hinne, kemo vegam ani he darkech berosh natatti (Yechezkel 16):
ohc: Hen kaniti etchem hayyom. taam amro hayyom, gam hittil tevat hayyom, ben keniyyatam likniyyat haadama. ki keniyyatam hu al yede meshicha kedin keniyyat avadim (kiddushin 22:) uvemaase sheasa sheheevir haam learim mikkatze vegomer, zo hi keniyyatam. laze amar hen kaniti etchem hayyom, perush bema sheheeviram az learim. aval haadama en ze derech kinyanah, ucheshehizkir lemala "vayyiken yosef et admat mitzrayim" sham nirmaz ki kana beechad middarche kinyan haadama.

Veyesh lehair bedavar acher: shekkana otam ma tzorech likniyyat admatam? halo ma shekkana eved kana rabbo (fesachim pach:)? veulay ki letzad shello haya kinyanam kekinyan avadim, ella lifrat ze laavod et haadama vegomer velatet chamishit lefaro, en ze ella kekinyan sachir shello kana kinyano. velaze hutzrach liknot haadama, vekana otah bekinyan gamur, kemo sheggilla hakkatuv beamro: "vayyiken yosef et kol admat mitzrayim vegomer ki machru mitzrayim ish sadehu". veim yirtze paro lehavi poalim velaavod haadama lizchuto uleachrayuto, aso yaase, ma sheen ken gufam shel mitzrim lo amar shekkana kinyan gamur. vahagam sheamar "hen kaniti etchem", perush kekinyan sachir ledavar hammuzkar bedivre yosef "he lachem zera" vegomer. vetamo shel yosef ki ma yoil baadama im en oved, laze nitchakkem liknotam lechayyevam al haavoda.

rashi: Veatta tzuvveta. mippi, lomar lahem:
Zot asu. kach emor lahem, shebbirshuti hu:
Vannomer el adoni, lo chichadnu mimmecha davar (Bereshit Rabba):
Veachiv met. mippene hayyira haya motzi devar sheker mippiv, amar im omar lo shehu kayyam, yomar haviuhu etzli:
Levaddo leimmo. meoto haem en lo od ach:
Megorat rasha. ma shehu yare yavo lo. dor happelagga yaru veamru "pen nafutz" (Bereshit 11:4), vesofan ketiv "vayyafetz Adonai otam mishsham" (Bereshit 11:8):
Vetaavat tzaddikim yitten. mi shebbeyado littenah (latet):
targum: Charitzuta derashia hi atya leh veriggeta detzadikaya tityehev lehon:

rashi: Bashshana hashshenit. lishne haraav:
Ki im tam hakkesef vegomer. ki asher tam hakkesef vehammikne uva hakkol el yad adoni:
Bilti im geviyyatenu. kemo im lo geviyyatenu:
ohc: Lo nechached meadoni vegomer. kashe ma kavvanatam beamram lo nechached, veheach yecholin lechached bedavar sheomed lehitbarer, sheim yomru ki lo tam tzerichin lahavio, uma hi amana zo sheomrim lo shello yachchidu et haddavar? od tzarich ladaat amram ki im sheen lahem mashmaut. od, halo kevar amru lo beshana rishona afes kasef. od tzarich ladaat kavvanat amram umikne vegomer el adoni.

Veulay shennitkavvenu lomar al ze hadderech lo nechached vegomer, perush, en lanu kesef veanu machchidim oto meadoni, ki im haemet bema shehu tam hakkesef. vechavvanatam leval yachshedu otam ki heenu atzmam uvau levakkesh betorat tzedaka. veamram umikne habbehema el adoni, perush, kol ma sheyyesh mimmikne habbehema hu shel adoni, ki hu lo asa gevul lammikne ella bederech kelal kana hakkol, keamro "vaynahalem bechol miknehem". laze amru ki lo hutzrechu lomar "lo nechached" ella bakkesef shehu davar sheyyachol lehittamen, aval mikne habbehema kol ma sheyyesh lahem hu shel adoni, bechol makom shehem shello hem. veamram lo nishar vegomer, lomar sheen lahem lo kesef velo sheve kesef.

Ulefi ma shepperashti bappasuk "ki afes kasef" bederech sheniyya, ki taanu sheyyesh lahem ella sheeno matzuy beyadam, yityashshev hakkatuv al nachon, ki bau veamru lo lo yechachadu davar mimmennu kefaam rishona shettaanu sheker shehaya lahem ella shemmana mehem, lo chen hu, ki im tam mammash, perush, nishlam veen lahem od kesef. uvaze yeduyyak lamma befaam rishona amru "afes" uvefaam sheniyya amru "tam".
Veamram umikne habbehema el adoni – perush, mikne habbehema asher haya ad atta levittachon ad sheyyizdammen hakkesef, meatta yihye muchlat lecha, vehu amro "el adoni".

rashi: Ki avdecha arav et hannaar. veim tomar, lamma ani nichnas lattiggar yoter mishshear achay? hem kullam mibbachutz vaani nitkashsharti vekesher chazak lihyot menudde 4 olamot:
Vehakkol nishma bet paro. kemo bevet paro, vezehu leshon bayit mammash:
ohc: Vehakkol nishma vegomer lemor vegomer. perush, leheyot shekkevar hodia hakkatuv lemala ki shamu mitzrayim uvet paro bechi yosef, dichtiv (Bereshit 45:2) "vayyishmeu mitzrayim" vegomer, atta modia hakkatuv ki hakkol sheshshamu bet paro haamur lemala velo yadu ma hu veal ma haya, veatta amru lahem ki ze haya letzad biat echav shel yosef.
Vayyitav beene vegomer. perush, ki kodem hayta lahem cherpa ki eved molech, uveviat echav vayyitav beenav ki hukkar sheeno eved.

rashi: Nimtza chen. laasot lanu zot kemo sheamarta:
Vehayinu avadim lefaro. lehaalot lo hammas hazze bechol shana:
ohc: Vehayinu avadim lefaro. dikdeku lishlol ki avdutam lefaro velo leyosef.

Od yechavvenu lomar al derech ma shepperashti lemala, ki lo kenaam ella lifrat avodat haadama, laze amru "vehayinu avadim" behechlet haavdut lefaro velo laavodat haadama levad. veulay ki laze nitkavvenu keshennidberu mitzrayim im paro al yisrael veamru (Shemot 1:9) "hinne am bene yisrael rav vegomer mimmennu", perush ki en lo shem avdut kechullan shehayu avadim lefaro.

rashi: Chacham lev yikkach mitzvot. moshe rabbenu, shekkol yisrael hayu oskin bevizzat mitzrayim, vehu haya osek bemitzvot, shenneemar "vayyikkach moshe et atzmot yosef vegomer" (Shemot 13:19):
Veevil sefatayim yillavet. leshon yegia. veyesh besifre befarasha "vayhi haam kemitonnim" (Bamidbar 11:1): amru: kamma nitlabbatnu vadderech:
targum: Dechakkim libbeh yekabbel pukedana vesachla besifvateh mitached:

rashi: Habbaim mitzrayma. al shem hashshaa kore lahem hakkatuv baim, veen litmoah al asher lo chatav asher bau:
ohc: Veelle shemot vegomer. yesh lehair beferush mispar ze: 1 lamma hutzrach lomar yaakov uvanav, gam en lah mashmaut beharedafat hainyan. 2 amro (Bereshit 46:15) kol nefesh banav vegomer sheloshim veshalosh, uvifratan enam ki im sheloshim ushetayim.

Verazal hirgishu mizze veamru (Bereshit Rabba parasha 94) shehi yocheved shennolda ben hachomot. vedivrehem zichrono livracha yekubbelu mippihem velo mippi zulatam, ki en reaya laze mehakkatuv. gam mehem amru (Bereshit Rabba 94) ki shechinato yitbarach hi hammashlemet shivim, uledivrehem zichrono livracha en kan yocheved bamminyan sheim lo chen shelemim hem bemispar hashshivim. vedivrehem zichrono livracha yutzdeku beyishshuv pasuk (Bereshit 46:27) habba baacharona "kol hannefesh habbaa vegomer shivim" lo befasuk ze, ki lamma yitztaref livne lea levad, veim ken ma yaane bishloshim veshalosh sheenam ella sheloshim ushetayim. velammidrash sheamar zo yocheved vechulei vadday sheyyachlok al midrash hannizkar, vekashe li gam alav, ki lefi devarav sheamar sheyyocheved nolda uvah nishlemu sheloshim ushelosha bene lea, im ken lamma keshechazar hakkatuv lichlol kol perate hamminyanim besamuch amar (Bereshit 46:26) "kol hannefesh habbaa leyaakov vegomer shishshim vashesh", veim nolda yocheved yihye hacheshbon shishshim vasheva, al ze hadderech: sheloshim ushelosha shel lea, shishsha asar shel bene zilpa hare arbaim vetesha, achad asar shel bene rachel millevad yosef ushene vanav shehayu bemitzrayim hare shishshim, veshiva shel bene bilha hare shishshim vasheva, velamma yachchish hakkatuv atzmo veyomar "kol hannefesh vegomer shishshim vashesh" uvifratan hu mone shishshim vasheva?

Od yesh litmoah, ki chazar baacharona vetzeraf yosef uvanav vegomer, veamar "kol hannefesh vegomer shivim", veeno chen. hen emet ledivre hammidrash shetztzeraf Adonai immahem shechinato, yityashshev pasuk ze, vekashe lidvarav pasuk rishon.

Vehannachon bifshat hakketuvim hu, ki shene minyanim mone hakkatuv: beechad mone yaakov uveechad mone zera yaakov, velaze keshekkolel yaakov uvanav hinne hem shivim, ucheshemmefaret banav mibbalade yaakov enam ella shishshim vatesha.

Gam baze yeduyyeku hakketuvim bema shehearnu bahem, ki battechilla heranu baetzba ki machnis yaakov bamminyan harishon shel bene lea, vehu amro yaakov uvanav, perush ki machniso bichlal minyan ze. velaze amar levassof kol nefesh banav uvenotav sheloshim veshalosh, perush kol nefesh haamurim befarasha zo betzeruf banav uvenotav vehu immahem betzeruf hacheshbon, velo hutzrach lehazekiro vesamach al ma sherasham bitchillat hainyan "yaakov uvanav". veulay ki laze amar tevat kol lichlol haav im habbanim bemispar ze. vetimtza shebbetzeruf bene zilpa sheamar besamuch amar (Bereshit 46:18) "vatteled vegomer shesh esre nafesh" velo amar "kol", vahagam shebbemispar bene rachel (Bereshit 46:22) amar "kol", leheyot sheratza lichlol bene yosef shebbahem ole hacheshbon lassechum harashum, uma sheamar (Bereshit 46:25) "kol" bivne bilha nitkavven lomar sheen bechullan ella sheva cheshbon katan.

Od timtza shebbechol sheloshet haimmahot amar zichron halleda: bezilpa amar "vatteled et elle" vegomer, berachel amar "asher yullad leyaakov", bevilha amar "vatteled et elle" vegomer, ma shello amar ken bivne lea. uledarkenu nitkavven hakkatuv lehair ki lo kol hashsheloshim veshalosh hem noladim, velaze im haya omer "vatteled elle leyaakov sheloshim veshalosh" haya hannishma ki sheloshim veshalosh yalda, velo chen hu, shello yalda ella sheloshim ushetayim, uvetzeruf avihem im banav uvenotav sheloshim veshalosh.

Vaasher al ken keshetztzeref baacharona, heircha ki cheshbon habbanim uvanot bifne atzman levad miyyaakov eno chen, vehu amro betzeruf perate hacheshbon. "kol hannefesh habbaa leyaakov" – hare hotzio mikkelal hacheshbon, vedikdek lomar "yotze yerech yaakov shishshim vashesh", velo tikshe kushyatenu sheshshishshim vasheva, ki sham kalal yaakov vechan lo kelalo, uvetzeruf mispar hakkol levassof amar "kol hannefesh levet yaakov" – perush hu uvanav shebbau mitzrayma shivim.

Gam shennitchakkem hakkatuv lehaircha lema shepperashnu, bema sheddikdek leshannot devarav bishne ketuvim habbaim keechad bishne hatztzerufim: beechad dikdek lomar kol hannefesh habbaa leyaakov – hikdim habbia lehazekarat yaakov, uvefasuk sheni amar kol hannefesh levet yaakov habbaa – hikdim hazekarat yaakov lehazekarat habbia. nitkavven baze lomar ki betzeruf cheshbon rishon en yaakov bakkelal, velaze amar habbaa leyaakov – perush habbaa lo, ha lamadta ki hu eno bakkelal. uvetzeruf cheshbon sheni amar kol hannefesh sheyyesh levet yaakov shebbau mitzrayma vegomer, ha lamadta ki yaakov lo yatza mehakkelal.

Uchede shello listor chas veshalom divre razal sheamru yocheved nolda ben hachomot, ulay shermazah hakkatuv beamro kol nefesh vegomer uvenotav, velo matzinu lo ella bat achat, ella zo yocheved shennolda ben hachomot, aval lo kelalah bacheshbon ki yaakov hu hammashlim kemo shekkatavti. veyesh od taam baddavar shello tikkalel bacheshbon ki im nolda ben hachomot utzericha sheloshim yom kede shettetze mikkelal nefel velo hayta reuya lehimmanot bichnisatam. velo yikshe beenecha sheyyihye perushenu hefech divre chazal, ki kevar hodaticha ki bifshate hattora sheen halacha yotza mehem reshut netuna letalmid vatik lechaddesh, vaalehem neemar (Shir HaShirim 5:16) "chikko mamtakkim vechullo machamaddim". veyesh leyashshev ma shehikshenu ledivrehem zichronam livracha vehu dachuk, vehappeshat kiri mutzak (Iyov 37:18) vehadderasha tiddaresh.

rashi: Orach lechayyim. hashshomer musar hi hadderech lechayyim:
Veozev tochachat mate. et atzmo veet acherim:
targum: Orach dechaye natre marduta udeshavek machsenuta tae:

rashi: Mechasse sina sifte shaker. hechanef sefatav sheker, umechasse sina belibbo:
Umotzi dibba hu chesil. laaz, sheyyihyu anashim dovvin bo al chavero:
targum: Machmen beel devava sifvata deshikra umappik tava hu sichla:

rashi: Velo yachol yosef lehitappek lechol hannitztzavim. lo haya yachol lisbol sheyyihyu mitzrim nitztzavim alav veshomin sheechav mitbayyeshin behivvado lahem:
ohc: Velo yachol yosef lehitappek. perush shello atzar koach lehametin ad sheyyetzu kol hannitztzavim meatzman, vekara bekol gadol "hotziu chol ish". perush, bimhera, lo sheyyomru lahem latzet, ki kesheyyetzu meatzman yetzu bemittun, velo saval orech zeman hahotzaa. veamar velo amad, perush, lo nitakkev ish ella bimhera techef yatzu yachad.

Behitvadda yosef vegomer. perush, bishvil hitvaddeuto el echav, perush hakkarat davar kede sheyyakkiru veyatzdiku ki hu yosef, vedavar ze tzarich lehazekiram bimchirato, velo ratza lezalzel beechav sheyyachziku otam bidvar nevala kazo limkor achihem. veamar besamuch: vayyitten et kolo bivchi vayyishmeu mitzrayim vechulei, hare ze maggid ki ma shemmana hazzulat behitvaddeo leechav lo letziddo, ki hu kara bekol veshamu kol hair et haddavar, ella letzad boshet echav hu sheasa mittaam hannizkar.

rashi: Ki ze shenatayim haraav. avru mishshene haraav:

Amuta happaam. peshuto chetargumo. umidrasho savur hayiti lamut shete mitot, baolam hazze velaolam habba, shennistalleka mimmenni shechina, vehayiti omer sheyyitbaeni hakkabba mitatcha, achshav sheodcha chay, lo amut ella faam achat:
ohc: Vayyomer vegomer amuta happaam vegomer. taam amro happaam perush: leheyot sheamar (Bereshit 37:35) "ki ered el beni avel sheola", atta amar lo ere hashshachat.

Od nire lilmod bedikduk amro ki odcha chay, velo hispik lomar "achare reoti panecha", vehaddavar muvan ki chay hu. gam tzarich ladaat lamma lo amar yaakov ken keshebbisseruhu haachim ki yosef chay, umatzinu sheheemin kesheraa haagalot (Bereshit 45:26) "vattechi ruach" vegomer, uma davar chadash raa?

Achen kavvanat divre yaakov hem ki hagam shennitbasser ki odennu chay, ze hoil ladaat sheyyeshno bammetziut, aval adayin libbo davvay alav letzad heyoto ben haummot, shafal eved moshlim, im odennu betzidkuto velo chahata eno velo nas lecho, o letzad heyoto muvdal mimmennu venatun toch hakkelippot uvifrat tumat mitzrayim, uma gam letzad ma sheavaro meruach hakkodesh sheamar (Bereshit 37) "tarof toraf yosef chayya raa achalathu" (Bereshit Rabba 80 84). vedavar yadua hu ki hatztzaddikim yoter yachpetzu beheder habben bihyoto ben mevish, uma gam yaakov hatztzaddik. asher al ken lo hayta simchato shelema missafek ze ad vayyera elav vehikkir bo befanav ki hakkarat happanim taane baish, uchemo chen matzinu letzaddikim shelemim vechen rabbim shehikkiru beroshem happanim maase adam vechol shekken yaakov avinu sheyyakkir. laze keshehikkir bo amar elav "amuta happaam", perush happaam hazzot biriyyatcha velo mikkodem keshennitbassarti, vehattaam achare reoti panecha vehikkarti bahem sheodcha chay, perush tzaddik kemikkodem velo nishtanna deyoknecha mikkemot shehaya ella odcha chay, ki hatztzaddikim keruyim chayyim (berachot 18.), venachon.

rashi: Lechok. shello yaavor:
Et kol divre yosef. siman masar lahem bamme haya osek keshepperesh mimmennu – befarashat egla arufa, zehu shenneemar vayyar et haagalot asher shalach yosef, velo neemar asher shalach paro:
Vattechi ruach yaakov. sharta alav shechina, sheppersha mimmennu:
Kashshoa. kechoshech hamechasse et haaretz, shoa beruin belaaz:
targum: Vetisak beitregusheta tete kaanana desalek vechafe yat ara tehe at vechol mashiryatach veammin sagiin di imach:

rashi: Vayyesor yosef merkavto. hu atzmo asar et hassusim lammerkava lehizdarez lichvod aviv:
Vayyera elav. yosef nira el aviv:

Vayyevk al tzavvarav od. leshon harebot bechiyya, vechen ki lo al ish yasim od (Iyov 34), leshon ribbuy hu – eno sam alav alilot nosafot al chataav; af kan hirba vehosif bivchi yoter al haragil; aval yaakov lo nafal al tzavvere yosef velo neshako, veamru rabbotenu, shehaya kore et shema:
Nivhalu mippanav. mippene habbusha:
Vayvarech yaakov. hi sheilat shalom kederech kol hannirim lifne hammelachim lifrakim, shalevaayr belaaz:
ohc: Vayyaamidehu lifne faro. taam amro vayyaamidehu vegomer, ulay sheheemido bimkomo shel yosef shessam lo paro mekomo lifne kiso, kesheamar lo (Bereshit 41:40) "rak hakkisse egdal mimmekka", vehodia hakkatuv ki yosef heemid aviv lifne paro bammakom hameulle karov lammelech.
Od yirtze sheheemido lemul panav kederech hamevarchin, vayvarech yaakov vegomer.
Od yirtze lehodia ki hutzrach lehaamido lefanav, letzad heyot paro shefal anashim tzeir koma (moed katan 18.), hutzrach lehakkirennu lo veheemido lefanav lomar ki hu ze.

Vattomer el avadecha horiduhu. perush, lo hispik lecha leammet haddavar bidvarenu o al yede berur acher zulat lehorido elecha, vattosef lechazzek alenu leval nire fanecha zulato. vehodanu haddavar leavinu velo hoil lishloach oto ad asher kalta hattevua vegomer, vehutzrachnu lehorido.

rashi: Veet haam heevir. yosef meir leir lezikkaron, sheen lahem od chelek baaretz, vehoshiv shel ir zo vachavertah, velo hutzrach hakkatuv lichtov zot ella lehodiacha shivcho shel yosef shennitkavven lehasir cherpa meal echav, shelo yihyu korin otam golim (chullin 60):
Miktze gevul mitzrayim vegomer. ken asa lechol hearim asher bemalchut mitzrayim, miktze gevulah vead ketze gevulah:
Vehayu laachadim. ani achabberem, lishne haetzim, sheyyihyu etz echad beyadecha:
targum: Vetakrev yathon chad levat chad lach lelucha chad vihon lechod bidach:

rashi: Veten zera. lizroa haadama; veaf al pi sheamar yosef veod chamesh shanim asher en charish vekatzir, mikkevan shebba yaakov lemitzrayim baa veracha leraglav vehitchil lizroa, vechala haraav, vechen shaninu betosefta desota:
Lo tesham. lo tehe shemama; la tevur – leshon sede bur, sheeno charush:
Pen tivvaresh. dilma titmaskan, leshon morish umaashir:
Vattehi haaretz lefaro. kenuya lo:

Kol hannefesh habbaa leyaakov. sheyyatzu meeretz kenaan lavo lemitzrayim; veen "habbaa" zo leshon avar ella leshon hove, kemo baerev hi vaa (Ester 2 4), uchemo vehinne rachel bitto baa im hatztzon (Bereshit 29), lefichach tamo lematta beAlef, lefi shekkesheyyatzu lavo meeretz kenaan lo hayu ella shishshim vashesh, vehashsheni, kol hannefesh levet yaakov habbaa mitzrayma shivim – hu leshon avar, lefichach tamo lemala babbet, lefi shemmishshebbau sham hayu shivim, shemmatzu sham yosef ushene vanav, venittosfa lahem yocheved ben hachomot. uledivre haomer teomot noldu im hashshevatim, tzerichim anu lomar shemmetu lifne yeridatan lemitzrayim, shehare lo nimnu chan; matzati bevayyikra rabba, esav shesh nefashot hayu lo, vehakkatuv kore otan nafshot beto, leshon rabbim, lefi shehayu ovdin leelohut harebe; yaakov shivim hayu lo, vehakkatuv kore otan nefesh, lefi shehaya ovdim leel echad:
Yeshev na avdecha vegomer. lechol davar ani meulle mimmennu, ligvura ulemilchama uleshammesh (Bereshit Rabba):
ohc: Yeshev na avdecha. vahagam sheamar (Bereshit 43:9) "vehitztzagtiv lefanecha", shelucho shel adam kemoto (berachot lod:).

rashi: Lezera hassade. shebbechol shana:
Velaasher bevattechem. veleechol haavadim vehashshefachot asher bevattechem:
Letappechem. banim ketannim:
ohc: Chamishit lefaro vegomer. nitchakkem lomar ki kodem kol davar yittol paro chamishit hazzera, umashkachat lah sheyyishshaer bearba hayyadot shiur hammaspik lezera hassade vehem yetzu nekiyyim, af al pi chen lo yigra mehachamishit lefaro. achar kach "ulezera hassade" veyakdimu zera hassade, veachar kach yittelu hemma kol hannishar im meat veim harebe.
Vetaam amro veleechol letappechem velo kelalam "laasher bevattechem", leheyot shehattaf menatam merubba keneged chelek haodef, amar "veleechol letappechem".

rashi: Lemichya. lihyot lachem lemichya:
ohc: Veatta al teatzvu vegomer. tzarich ladaat amro "veatta" ma ba lishlol? shenit, lamma kafal lomar al teatzvu veal yichar, veod hem shene devarim hafekiyyim – haitztzavon yore al shivron hallev, vacharon af yaggid al haggaava. od tzarich ladaat lamma dikdek lomar tevat henna?

Achen perush shel devarim hu al ze hadderech: yodea ani ki attem neetzavim al hammecher, uchemo sheggillu datam beamram (Bereshit 42:21) "aval ashemim anachnu", gam lefi hammidrash (Bereshit Rabba 91:3) sheamru sheyyardu lifdoto bedamim yekarim, laze amar lahem veatta perush, kevan shemmevukkasham matzuy lahem behodaa zo tasiru haitztzavon, venitkavven gam ken baze lirmoz lahem ulehodiam ki yodea bahem sheddatam kerova etzlo vehem neetzavim alav ad atta, uvaze yatzdiku ki libbo nachon immam.

Veamro al yichar beenechem perush, letaam shemmechartem oti henna, sheggeramtem leatzmechem kol hitgalgelut hainyanim, hahishtachavayot asher bishvilam nitchakkamtem limkor, dichtiv (Bereshit 37:20) "venire ma yihyu" vegomer, vedavar ze yesovev hakkaas, keadam shebba letakken davar venimtza mekalkel veyichar appo al asher garam leatzmo. venatan taam laze, ki adrabba maasehem garmu lahem tova gedola, "ki lemichya shelachani elohim lifnechem, ki ze vegomer lasum lachem sheerit" vegomer, umeatta lo yichar beenechem al haddavar.

rashi: Veanochi aalcha. hivticho lihyot nikbar baaretz:
ohc: Anochi ered immecha mitzrayma vegomer. mehakkatuv mashma ki yarda immo shechina, vekashe ledivrehem zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 15:5) sheamru ki mitzrayim leheyotah melea gillulim lo hayta shechina sham, velaze haya moshe tzarich latzet chutz lair lehitpallel, dichtiv (Shemot 9:29) "ketzeti et hair".

Veulay shekkavvanat divre Adonai hi al derech amro (tehillim 91:15) "immo anochi vetzara", sheramaz lo ki kivyachol yisbol immo hatztzara, vehu amro anochi ered immecha mitzrayma perush leshon metzar, uchemo shemmatzinu shennigla lemoshe bassene lehareoto ki shochen bassene mekom kotzim letzad tzaar yisrael, uleolam lo yarda shechina lemitzrayim makom hametunnaf. ella sheraiti sheamru zichronam livracha bechamma mekomot ki shechina immahem bemitzrayim, keamram (Megila 29:) "galu lemitzrayim shechina immahem", vechen amru (tanchuma vaychi) "vayyishtachu yisrael al rosh hammitta" lashshechina shehayta vegomer, veamru od (Bereshit Rabba 94:9) ki hashshechina hishlima minyan shivim nefesh sheyyardu lemitzrayim ki bifratan enam ella 69, hare ki shechina yarda lemitzrayim.

Achen askilcha ki hadderagot or hashshechina rabbim hemma. halo timtza sheasara sheyyoshvim veoskim battora (avot 3,6) shanu rabbotenu ki shechina sheruya benehem, vaafillu shenayim veechad amru zichronam livracha ki metzuya shechina. umatzinu shello yarda shechina benehem shel yisrael ella achar sheasu hammishkan veachar kamma hachanot haamurim, uviridatah rau maase Adonai uchevod Adonai male hammishkan (Shemot 40:35), ma sheen hergesh ken velo kayyotze bo beshaa sheoskim battora afillu elef. ella vadday yesh haderagot en mispar lahem lehasheraat shechina, besod "ki gavoah meal gavoah shomer" (Kohelet 5:7), veyitrabbe haor behasheraato kefi bechinat hassovev hasheraat hashshechina. vetze ulemad hasheraat hashshechina behar sinay, ulematta mimmenna hasheraato bevet hammikdash, ulematta mimmennu hasheraat shechina al hannavi uvet hakkeneset uvet hammidrash uven asara sheoskim battora, ulematta behaderagot hamminyan. uvaze nityashshevu divrehem zichronam livracha ki lo yarda shechina shehi bechinat or haggavoah beyoter shehu hammenabbe, velaze amar moshe "ketzeti et hair", aval bechinat or hammatzuy etzel lomde tora vechayyotze yarad im yaakov avinu vesham haya ad yom tzet yisrael mimmitzrayim.

Vahagam shebbeoro yitbarach lo yutzdak laasot hefresh, ze emet ki beelohuto yitbarach hu or shave, aval baor hammavhik mimmennu hu sheyyityaches elav bechinot hahadragot, veze gam ken yimmatze bivchinot hanneshamot shehem or meor kisse chevodo yitbarach yesh benehem haferashot muflaot, vehaven.

Uvaze matzanu gam ken nachat ruach bema sheamar hakkatuv veanochi aalcha, shekkafal lomar paam sheniyya "veanochi" velo hispik bema shekkatav battechilla "anochi ered" vegomer, shennitkavven lomar al habbechina haelyona "aalcha" vegomer, vehu sod amro (Shemot 20:2) "anochi Adonai elohecha", vehi bechinat shechina haelyona shenat hayyovel shenat hamt, vehu sod 49 peamim shennizkera yetziat mitzrayim battora.

Od yechavven beamro veanochi paam sheniyya, ramaz lo shehahatztzala tihye al yado yitbarach, vehu al derech amro (mechilta ba) "vayyotzienu Adonai" vegomer – lo al yede malach velo vegomer, ella hakkadosh baruch hu bichvodo vegomer, vehu amro "veanochi" bichvodi aalcha vegomer (Devarim 6:21, Shemot 13:16).

Vetaam kefel aalcha gam alo, ramaz lo shete aliyyot: haachat yetziat mitzrayim, vehashsheniyya sheyyaalehu mishsham leval yikkaver beeretz mitzrayim, shehu hammora shehaya yare kemo shekkatavnu (Bereshit 46:3). veamar tevat "gam" lirmoz tosefet haribbuy sheyyaalu bo mimmitzrayim, ben bivchinat hammaala ben bivchinat habberurim sheyyevarru shamma nitzotze hakkedushsha leen ketz:
O yirtze gam alo lirmoz el chelek haruchani hayyored immo mitzrayim, veayyen bazzohar (Shemot 4) beferush pasuk "yatzu chol tzivot Adonai" (Shemot 12:41):

Veyosef yashit yado vegomer. nitkavven lehaveticho shello yamut bechayyav, gam letzad shekkamma peamim hizkir yaakov zichron hammavet al yosef veamar gam ken (Bereshit 37:35) "ki ered el beni" vegomer, laze chazar lehaveticho shello yachush lashshegaga hayyotzet (Kohelet 10:5) vegomer.

Od nitkavven lomar elav ki haaliyya shel yaakov lo tihye bachayyim chayyato ella leachar mita, vehu amro veyosef vegomer. gam mizze yada ki en lo reshut latzet mimmitzrayim bachayyim chayyato, kede sheyyekuyyam devar Adonai sheyyashit yosef yado al enav, veim yetze en haddavar yachol lehitkayyem.

rashi: Vechol agappeha. kol seviveha:
targum: Gomer vechol mashiryataha medinat garmamya seyafe tzippuna veyat kol mashiryathon ammin sagiin di imach:

rashi: Vayyeshev yisrael beeretz mitzrayim. vehechan? beeretz goshen shehi meeretz mitzrayim:
(Vayyeachazu vah. leshon achuzza):
ohc: Vayyeshev yisrael beeretz mitzrayim vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma kafal lomar "beeretz mitzrayim beeretz goshen"? od, ma kesher veshayyachut levayyifru" vegomer im "vayyeshev yisrael"?

Achen yitbaer hakkatuv al pi ma shekkatavnu befasuk (Bereshit 46:3) "ki legoy gadol" vegomer, ki sibbat yeridat mitzrayim hi lehaalot nitzotze hakkedushsha asher nitpazzeru uvau shamma, vehu amro vayyeshev yisrael beeretz mitzrayim perush shehi mekom kelippa hamezuhemet, beeretz goshen milleshon haggasha, ki shamma huggeshu kol nitzotze hakkedushsha beemtzaut anaf hakkedushsha shehu yisrael, shehu bivchinat even hashshoevet laddome lo. veamar leshon yachid remez el heyotam belev meyuchad kullam veen benehem perud, uveemtzaut ken vayyeachazu vah perush achazu davar bah, vehem hannitzotzot hannizkarim, uvaze vayyifru vayyirbu ki kesheyyitrabbu hannefashot yitrabbu hannoladim. veayyen ma shepperash hammaggid lemaharik beferush pasuk (Shemot 1:6) "vayyamat yosef vegomer uvene yisrael paru vayyishretzu vayyirbu" vetimtza ezer lidvarenu divre elohim chayyim.
Chassalat parashat vayyiggash

rashi: Chachamim yitzpenu daat. yishmeruhu belibbam, shello yishkachuhu:
targum: Chakkime nitshun yediata ufumeh deshatya shetzya kariv:

ohc: Avi veachay vegomer. perush, kaasher tzivvita alehem asot. vehinnam beeretz goshen kemo sheamarta (Bereshit 45:18) "veettena lachem et tuv eretz mitzrayim", veeretz goshen beerech mire hammikne hi tuv eretz mitzrayim. aval haachim bedabberam lifne paro lo bau betaana kaasher amarta ella kemitchannen al davar tov, veamru (Bereshit 47:4) "lagur vegomer ki en mire" vegomer veayyen besamuch:

rashi: Tzaddik leolam bal yimmot. keshehu mat en motato motat olam, ki yippol vekam (Mishlei 24:16):
targum: Tzadik laalam la nezua verashie la yitvadun beara:

rashi: Vayyippol al tzavvere binyamin achiv vayyevk. al shene mikdashot sheatidin lihyot bechelko shel binyamin vesofan lecharev:
Uvinyamin bacha al tzavvarav. al mishkan shilo sheatid lihyot bechelko shel yosef vesofo lecharev (sham):
Shaal et avadav. mittechilla vaalila vata alenu, lamma haya lecha lishol kol elle? bittecha hayinu mevakkeshim? o achotenu atta mevakkesh? veaf al pi chen
ohc: Adoni shaal vegomer lemor. taam hatztzaat haddevarim, lomar ki letzad hahechreach lakchu binyamin meet aviv, veim lo yirehu immahem yamut aviv middaagato. vehitchil lomar adoni shaal et avadav, perush: lo hayta sheelat adam lechayyotze bo sheyyuchal limnoa hatteshuva mimmennu, ella ki hayta meet adoni laavadav, vechevan shekken behechreach lemor lecha amittatan shel devarim. od yirtze beamro lemor, ki millevad hashsheela asita lanu davar hamechayyev otanu lemor lecha belo haalama, ki asa otam kimraggelim, vehutzrechu leammet divrehem kemishpat bedikat haanashim hannechshadim beriggul, shennivdakim bechol happeratim hagam sheenan nogim beinyan hariggul, veim haelem yaalimu davar yinnatnu bekolar, laze hichricham lemor.

rashi: Al eretz perazot. yoshve chefarim meen choma, shebbotchim bemauzzam veenam yereim lehitassef el are mivtzar:
Perazot. kemo "meare happerazi" (Devarim 3:5), meen choma:
Avo. el hashshoktim, veere ma hu mivtacham:
targum: Vetemar esak al ara deyatva sheleva bekirve fitzchaya ehach al ama deshaktin vesharan lerochatzan kulehon yatvin bela shura veavrin vedashin let lehon:

ohc: Uvene yehuda er veonan vegomer. tzarich ladaat leeze inyan hizkir otam shekkevar metu? gam en chiddush behodaat mitatam. gam tzarich ledakdek amro vayyihyu bene feretz vegomer, shehaya lo lomar "uvene feretz" vegomer keamro achar ze "uvene veria", ma hi kavvanato beamro vayyihyu vegomer. veefshar ki lefi ma shekkadam etzlenu bemitzvat yibbum ki yavi nefesh hammet, uvammetziut shellefanenu letzad shemmetu er veonan belo vanim veyutzrach hameyabbem lahaviam, vehinne naasa yehuda meyabbem bead shela vehevi shete hannefashot atzman, vehodia hakkatuv ki er veonan bimkoman omdim shennichnesu bimkoman chetzron vechamul, veze hu shiur hakkatuv: uvene yehuda chamishsha banim er veonan vegomer vayyamat" vegomer, uletzad ze hayu er veonan chazru lihyot bene feretz chetzron vechamul, ki chazru laolam meubbarim besod nefesh met vehayu chetzron vechamul.

Uvederech peshat yechavven hakkatuv behazekarat er veonan lelammed alehem zechut, ki taam mitat er veonan haya letzad shehayu beeretz kenaan, al derech amro (Vayikra 18:3) "kemaase eretz mitzrayim uchemaase eretz kenaan" vegomer, veamru zichronam livracha (Vayikra Rabba parasha 23): hishva hakkatuv maase mitzrayim vechulei. uletzad shehayu sham er veonan lamdu mimmaasehem, vezulat ze banav shel oto tzaddik en sharsham ra vamar chas veshalom, vetimtza shetztzivva hael yisrael leval yilmedu mehem dichtiv "kemaase" vegomer:
Vetaam amro vayyihyu, ramaz ki leelle yikkare havaya veen kemotam, letzad ki mehem yetze choter leyishay meshichenu malkenu asher yihye lenes ammim, elav goyim yidroshu.

rashi: Ufi reshaim yechasse chamas. hechamas yechasse al pihem veyahargem:
targum: Birketa tehevyan al reshe detzadikaya uvefumehon derashie nechase chatofa:

rashi: El gog. kach shem hammelech:
Hammagog. shem haumma, kema deat amar "gomer umagog" (Bereshit 10):
targum: Bar adam kabbel nevua al gog ara magog rav resh meshech vetuval veitnabbe alohi:

rashi: Kesef nivchar leshon tzaddik. sheyyodea lehochiach:

Lev reshaim kimat. sheeno shomea letochachat tzaddik. umidrash rabbi tanchuma omer (tanchuma, ki tissa 6): al iddo hannavi neemar, shekkara al hammizbeach bevet el; veyaravam, af al pi sheyyavsha yado, lo kibbel tochecha, shenneemar "chal na et pene Adonai elohecha vegomer" (Melachim 1 13:6) velo 'elohay; veomer "vattashav yado kevarishona" (Melachim 1 13:6) – omed umaktir laavodat gillulim, veaf bassof ken:
targum: Sama gavya lishneh detzadika velibba derashie machata:

rashi: Anshe chayil. bekiin beummanutan lirot tzon:
Al asher li. al tzon shelli:
ohc: Bemetav haaretz vegomer yeshvu beeretz goshen. hinne chash lomar "bemetav haaretz" levad, letzad sheyyosef ramaz bidvarav ki chafetz beeretz goshen, yachshov ki eno chafetz sheyyeshvu beeretz goshen mimma shello hiskim al devarav. veim haya omer "yeshvu beeretz goshen" yihye nishma shehu kemistappek lahem bintinat eretz goshen levad velo betov mimmenna im yichshar beene yosef, veze soter ma shekkadam bidvarav (Bereshit 45:18) "veettena lachem et tuv eretz mitzrayim". laze amar "bemetav vegomer beeretz goshen". veze shiur devarav: bemetav haaretz hoshev vegomer vaani modiacha ki eretz goshen hi hammetav. umatzinu shekken heid hakkatuv dichtiv (Bereshit 47:11) "vayyoshev yosef vegomer bemetav haaretz beeretz rameses" vegomer:

O yihye shiur hakkatuv al ze hadderech: bemetav vegomer, veim bacharu lahem eretz goshen – yeshvu vah. uvaze en hechlet lomar ki hiv ze mekomam, ella odam beshaar haratzon, im yitav beenehem makom acher – harshut beyadam lashevet bemetav haaretz.

rashi: Taanu et beirchem. tevua:
ohc: Zot asu. perush, davar ze enchem tzerichin laasoto birshut, aval haagalot enchem yecholin laasot ki im birshut, vaafillu reshut miyyosef lo toil ella tzarich sheyyomar shehu ose birshut paro, vehu amro veatta tzuvveta vegomer, vechen hu omer vayyitten lahem vegomer agalot al pi faro, veze haya minnimuse mitzrayim.
Od yirtze beamro zot asu, perush ki hu betzav lahem, lo shemmitratztze levad laasot immahem chesed, ella shehu chafetz baddavar veomer zot asu. ume yatza haddavar kede sheyyerdu avotenu mitzrayim.

rashi: Lehorot lefanav. ketargumo, lefannot lo makom, ulehorot heach yityashshev bah:
Lefanav. kodem sheyyaggiya lesham. umidrash aggada lehorot lefanav – letakken lo bet talmud shemmishsham tetze horaa:
Sifte tzaddik yiru rabbim vegomer. sherabbim ochlim bizchuto uvitfillato:
targum: Sifvata detzadike rayan sagie veshatye bachaserut rayana yemutun:

rashi: Vayyishma bet paro. beto shel paro, kelomar, avadav uvene veto, veen ze leshon bayit mammash, ella chemo bet yisrael, bet yehuda, mayshanedah belaaz:
Lefi hattaf. lefi hatztzarich lechol bene vetam:

Al tirgezu baddarech. al titasseku bidvar halacha shello tirgaz alechem hadderech, davar acher al tafsiu fesia gassa vehikkansu vachamma lair; ulefi feshuto shel mikra yesh lomar, lefi shehayu nichlamim, haya doeg, shemma yarivu vadderech al devar mechirato, lehitvakkeach ze im ze velomar al yadcha nimkar, atta sipparta lashon hara alav, vegaramta lanu lisnoto:
ohc: Vayshallach et echav. perush, kullan uvinyamin immahem, vechen hu omer bedivre yosef (Bereshit 45:9) "maharu vaalu el avi vegomer vehinne enechem vegomer veene achi vinyamin", hare ki matzdik haddevarim belev yaakov meedut binyamin haroe, umeatta lo nitle lomar taam shehayu atzmotav shel yehuda mitgalgelin hu letzad shello kiyyem devaro, ella letzad shennidduy al tenay tzarich hattara, keamram zichronam livracha (makkot 11:).

rashi: Umeakkesh derachav yivvadea. yishshaver veyityasser, kemo "vayyoda bahem et anshe sukkot" (Shoftim 8:16):
targum: Dimhalech bitmimuta nezel besaada vedimakman orchateh nityeda:

rashi: Koretz ayin yitten atztzavet. ze hammesit adam bikritzotav leraa:
targum: Deramez beaynohi yahev keeva vesalif besifvateh mitached:

rashi: Hikkon vehachen lecha. hikkon otcha, vehachen lecha chayil acherim:
Hikkon. hizdammen:
Vehayita lahem lemishmar. derech hammelachim latet lev al chelotehem heach yetzu, ulehaamid mishmarot shello yavo mashchit al chelo ballayla:
targum: Izdaraz veatken lach at vechol mashiryatach deitkenishu alach utehe lehon lematara:

rashi: Yaalu devarim. "yiskun hirhurin" (targum yonatan):
Machashevet raa. lehillachem kenegdi:
targum: Kidnan amar Adonai elohim vihe beidana hahi yiskun hirhurin al libbach utechashev machshevan bishan:

rashi: Veomra elav achay vegomer. veod omar lo, vehaanashim roe tzon vegomer:
Beera shava. kemo liver sheva; hei besof teva bimkom lamed bittechillatah:
Lelohe aviv yitzchak. chayyav adam bichvod aviv yoter mibbichvod zekeno, lefichach tala beyitzchak velo veavraham:
Shalach kezot. kacheshbon hazze, umahu hacheshbon? asara chamorim vegomer:
Mittuv mitzrayim. matzinu vattalmud sheshshalach lo yayin yashan sheddaat zekenim nocha hemennu, umidrash aggada gerisin shel pul:
Bar valechem. ketargumo:
Umazon. liftan:
ohc: Uleaviv shalach kezot vegomer. taam amro kezot velo hispik hammeforash, leheyot sheamar "nosim mittuv mitzrayim" velo noda ma hu tuv mitzrayim, laze hikdim lomar "kezot", lomar kammin hammuzkar besamuch, semalot uchele chesef mehammuvchar hannimtza mimmin ze bemitzrayim. uledivre rabbotenu zichronam livracha (Megila 16:) sheamru "tuv mitzrayim" – yayin yashan, uleman deamar (Bereshit Rabba 94:2) gerisin shel pol, yihye hakkatuv chaser vav, ucheillu amar "kazot vaasara" vegomer, vehakkavvana beamro "kezot" kemo shepperashnu, veod asara vegomer:

Veeser vegomer leaviv vegomer. taam shechazar lomar paam sheniyya leaviv, nitkavven lomar ki lo shelacham elav begeder shelichut hassemucha lah, ella netanam leechav veamar lahem shehem leaviv ladderech.

rashi: Vayyiggash elav vegomer … davar beozne adoni. yikkansu devaray beaznecha:
Veal yichar appecha. mikkan atta lamed sheddibber elav kashot:

Ki chamocha kefaro. chashuv atta veenay kemelech, zehu feshuto. umidrasho sofcha lilkot alav betzaraat kemo shellaka faro al yede zekenati sara al layla achat sheikkevah (Bereshit Rabba). davar acher ma paro gozer veeno mekayyem, mavtiach veeno ose, af atta chen; vechi zo hi simat ayin sheamarta lasum encha alav? davar acher, ki kamocha kefaro, im takniteni eherog otcha veet adonecha (Bereshit Rabba):
ohc: Vayyiggash elav. tzarich ledakdek lamma hutzrach lomar vayyiggash achar shekkarov elav haya umedabber immo ad atta, verabbotenu zichronam livracha darshu, yeuyyan sham divrehem (Bereshit Rabba 93,6), vetzarich ledakdek peshat hakkatuv. od, lo haya tzarich lomar tevat elav umuvan haddavar. od tzarich ledakdek amro bi adoni lo noda haritztzuy lamma, veim leval yichar appo haya lo leamro samuch lival yichar" vegomer. od tzarich ledakdek amro beazne adoni, verabbotenu zichronam livracha (sham) amru sheyyikkansu devarav beaznav, veze derech derash. od tzarich ledakdek kavvanat amro ki chamocha ki lo noda netinat taam ze lehechan chozeret, veadrabba letzad shehu gadol kefaro yakpid al miut hanehagat kavod ugedulla.

Achen peshat hakkatuv hu, ki davar yadua hu ki minhag hammelachim yeshvu lifnehem gedole hammalchut vesarehem veyoatzehem, vehaya im ba ish al devar mishpat o davar meet hammelech, lo yaamod behefsek ben hammelech vesarav hayyoshvim rishona bammalchut, vechutz laiggul yaamod vesham yedabber. uchemo chen haya medabber yehuda ad atta, veachar kach "vayyiggash elav", perush shennichnas lifnim mimmechitzato veamad ben hammelech uven hassarim kede shello yishshamu devarav lezulat hammelech.
Veayyen ma shekkatav 285 alashkar (bateshavebavetayv siman 93) beshinnuy tevat "lo" letevat "elav".

Vechilla pene hammelech sheyyitratztze lo ledabber beyichud elav, vehu amro bi adoni yedabber na avdecha davar beazne adoni been shomea zulatcha, veze lo yittachen im lo beaznav. vechilla panav shello yemaher lehitkaes al asher shoel kaze veeno mehammusar, vehu amro veal yichar appecha beavdecha. perush, ki derech ze yaasuhu gedolim hashshavim begeder gedulla ze laze, lo eved laadono, vehu amro beavdecha. vetaam haddavar "ki chamocha kefaro", perush al derech maase shehuva baggemara (avoda zara 10:) shel ketia bar shalom sheamru lo "natzacht lemalka vechol denatzach lemalka" vechulei ad kan. laze im haya notzeach yehuda leyosef bifne hashshomim, yikkanes besakkanat mavet middin notzeach lammelech. uleval yiton ki hammelech hu paro, laze amar ki chamocha kefaro vedinam shave, asher al ken mevakkesh al nafsho ledabber beazno. uvaze, hagam sheyyenatztzechehu batteanot, en bizzuy lammelech velo yikkanes bedin notzeach lammelech shechayyav, kevan shehu beno leven hammelech.

Od yirtze ki chamocha vegomer, al derech amro (Mishlei 21:1) "lev melech beyad Adonai", veim yedabber bederech shettishshama millato lechol hannimtzaim sham, yaasu lammelech hefech dato uretzono shel melech, venimtza hammelech ose davar shello kaasher sam Adonai belibbo, viavvetu yoatzav et libbo. laze al yichar appo al kenisato lifnim mimmechitzato ledabber beazne hammelech. gam baze higgid lo ki hu ish chesed, vedavka roe fanav nichnesu bachashad devar takkala bemered.

Uvederech derash yitbaer amro vayyiggash elav al derech amro (Mishlei 27:19) "kammayim happanim lappanim ken lev haadam laadam", velaze nitchakkem yehuda lehattot lev yosef alav lerachamim, vehikriv dato uretzono elav leohovo ulechabbevo kede shettitkarev dato shel yosef elav lekabbel devarav ufiyyuso, vehuchrach laasot ken, letzad shemmin hatteva lo yechabbevu bene yaakov ovde avoda zara ki (tehillim 125:3) "lo yanuach shevet haresha al goral hatztzaddikim", umimmezeg nafsham lisno asher besar chamorim besaram, laze hutzrach lefi shaa lehappech hammuteba ulehaggisho bilvavo ulehashivo betavvane delibbeh.

Od yirtze ki lo niggash yehuda ledabber ella lema sheelav, perush, lema shehevinu ki haggezera lo meet Adonai baa, kemo shepperashti bapparasha hakkodemet befasuk (Bereshit 44:17) "chalila", vechevan sheen hainyan ba ella miyyosef veelav hem haddevarim mesurim laasher yachpotz asot, laze "vayyiggash".

Od yirtze lomar ki letovato shel yosef hu niggash, ki bechol perate hanaot asher yaase haeved yehuda yaase yoter mibbinyamin, vehu amro vayyiggash elav, perush, liton taana shehi letovat hammelech, vehu (Bereshit 44:33) "yeshev na" vegomer.

Od yirtze beamro elav, leval yomar haomer ech soter yehuda divre atzmo "hinnennu avadim gam anachnu" (Bereshit 44:16), laze amar ki ma shenniggash ledabber devarim haamurim bainyan "yeshev na avdecha vegomer vehannaar yaal im echav" hu elav, perush ledivre yosef, hu shemmatza likkanes ledabber kaddevarim haelle sheamar "chalila" vegomer, aval lema sheamar yehuda en maane bilshono ledabber ma sheamar bainyan.

Veamro bi adoni. nitkavven lishlosha devarim: haechad leval yomar elav yosef lamma yedabber hu levad mikkullam, uma gam bema shekkadam shehikkir yosef ki reuven habbechor, dichtiv (Bereshit 43:33) "vayyeshvu lefanav habbechor" vegomer, veim ken yomar lamma yedabber kol kach hu velo echav. laze amar, "bi" nogea haddavar kemo shebbeer lo levassof. veleheyot shechash lo lehitkaes kodem haggaat haddavar elav, laze kadam techef vehodio, vehu amro "bi nogea haddavar adoni". vehashsheni shennitkavven liton taana hannishmaat lehatztzil binyamin, vehu bi adoni – perush, ani ganavti haggavia vehinnachtiv beamtachat binyamin, umeatta shurat haddin titten ki hu yillached, ki binyamin machchish vihuda mode – hu yihye eved. hashshelishi ramaz hakkatuv ki hasserara elav hi netuna, veze shiur haddevarim: "bi" taluy kinnuy tevat "adoni" ki hu hammelech. veamro yedabber na – perush, yedabber atta bechinnuy avdut lefi shaa, aval en haddavar omed ken, ki yehuda hu hammelech vechiso yikkon olam.

Od yirmoz hakkatuv beamro bi adoni, perush: beemtzauti hissagta ze, ki hu hassovev leyosef adnut, sheamar (Bereshit 37:27) "lechu venimkerennu layyishmeelim", shemmizze nitgalgel haddavar vehissig yosef haadnut.

rashi: Kaavor sufa veen rasha. pitom ba evrat ruach seara, nichrat harasha mimmekomo:
targum: Hech deyebar alola hechna nebar rashia vetzadika shitasaya vealma:

rashi: Hinne ani lokeach et etz vegomer. shello yihyu od lishte mamlachot:
targum: Itnabbe lehon kidnan amar Adonai elohim ha ana mekariv yat shivta deyosef di hu shivta deefrayim veshivte yisrael achehon vaachabber yathon alohi yat shivta dihuda veabedinun leama chad vihon chad kodamay:

rashi: Umiktze echav. min happechutim shebbahem ligvura, sheen nirim gibborim, sheim yire otam gibborim yaase otam anshe milchamto, veelle hem: reuven, shimon, levi, yissashchar uvinyamin – otan shello kafal moshe shemotam keshebberchan; aval shemot haggibborim kafal vezot lihuda shema Adonai kol yehuda; ulegad amar baruch marchiv gad; ulenaftali amar naftali, uledan amar dan, vechen lizvulun, vechen leasher; zehu leshon bera, shehi aggadat eretz yisrael. aval betalmud bavlit shellanu (bava kamma 92) matzinu, sheotan shekkafal moshe shemotan hem hachallashim, veotan hevi lifne faro, vihuda shehuchpal shemo lo huchpal mishshum challashut, ella taam yesh baddavar, kidita bevaka uvevarayta desifre shaninu vah bivzot habberacha, kemo talmud shellanu:
Keschok lichsil asot zimma. atzat chattaim:
Vechachma kischok leish tevuna. kelomar: kalla hi beenav laasot:
targum: Kad gachach sichla avad avidta vechachmeta legavra demitbayen:

rashi: Uvenot banav. serach bat asher veyocheved bat levi:
ohc: Banav uvene vegomer. achar sheamar besamuch "yaakov vechol zaro", lo haya tzarich lomar paam sheniyya "banav uvene" vegomer.
Od tzarich ladaat lamma hifsik ben banav uvene vanav leven benotav uvenot banav vechol zaro betevat "itto", velo hispik bema sheamar levassof "hevi itto mitzrayma"?

Achen kavvanat hakkatuv hu shebba lehodia ki yesh hefresh ben bene yaakov biridatam lemitzrayim, ki yesh mehem shebbau birtzonam lekabbel gezerat melech belev shalem, veyesh mehem shehayu chochchim lehitakkev meredet lechur habbarzel, vetziyyenam hakkatuv mi vami haholchim lifroa shetar chov haggalut mertzonam. veamar banav uvene vanav itto, perush ellu lo hutzrach lahaviam hu ella hem meatzmam bau itto bedome lo, veachar kach sidder otam shello bau mertzonam ad shehutzrach yaakov lehoridam beal karcham, vehu amro benotav uvenot banav vechol zaro, perush bene bene vanav, ellu "hevi itto mitzrayma", perush, hu heviam, lo lirtzonam bau.

Veraiti latet lev ledivrehem zichronam livracha (Shemot Rabba 1:5) sheamru shekkol zeman sheechad miyyorde mitzrayim kayyam, lo hitchil hashshibud, dichtiv (Shemot 1:6) "vayyamat yosef vegomer vechol haddor hahu", perush sheyyardu mitzrayim az hitchil hashshibud, ki ulay shezze haya lahem letashlum kabbalat gezerat melech beratzon, paka mehem hashshibud, ki samma deyissure kabbule. vehaed hanneeman laze gam ken, ki yocheved veserach bat asher hayu miyyorde mitzrayim (Bereshit Rabba 94:9), uvimehem haya hashshibud, vehattaam hu letzad sheheviam yaakov velo mertzonam. veayyen bedivre hazzohar (vayyakhel ketzach:) beferush pasuk "ashre sheel yaakov beezro sivro al Adonai" (tehillim 146:5).

Ach tarof vegomer. ramaz beamro ach ki meat tarof toraf, ki eno lo betzarat avdut velo betzarat mishmar, velaze gamar omer velo reitiv ad henna, hare ze maggid ki yeshno bannimtza ella sheadayin lo raahu ad atta.

Od yirtze beamro ach tarof vegomer, perush "ach" – miut, davka bitrefut. aval bema sheamar (Bereshit 37:33) "chayya raa achalathu", sheamru zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 84) shennitkavven el eshet potifar, baze en miut, ki kevar baavonot haya ma shehaya, sheggarma lo leabbed asara banim sheatid haya lehaamid shenem asar shevatim, keamram zichronam livracha (sota lo:), uveemtzaut harshaa nashru mimmennu eser tippot, velo yatzu mimmennu ella shenayim.

rashi: Veazav et aviv vamet. im yaazov et aviv, doagim anu shemma yamut badderech, shehare immo badderech meta:
Leavdi leyaakov. keen shennetattiha leyaakov, beli metzarim:
targum: Vitivun al ara dihavit leavdi leyaakov ditivu vah avahatchon veyatvun alah inun uvenehon uvene venehon ad alma vedavid avdi malka lehon laalam:

rashi: Asher rachshu beeretz kenaan. aval ma sherachash befaddan aram natan hakkol leesav bishvil chelko bimarat hammachpela; amar nichse chutza laaretz enan keday li, vezehu asher kariti li, heemid lo tzibburin shel zahav vachesef kemin keri veamar lo tol et ellu:
ohc: Vayyikchu et miknehem vegomer. taam shello amar ken bitchillat hannesia kesheamar (Bereshit 46:1) "vayyissa" vegomer. ulay ki mikkodem lo nasu ella lelauot yaakov gam lirot pene yosef, ach achar mare hannevua nitgalla lahem ki maskim el elyon sheyyaguru sham bemitzrayim ad yom sheyyirtze lehaalotam mishsham, uchemo shepperashti bappasuk "anochi ered veanochi" baze hiskimu leholich immam kol miknehem ulevusham vegomer. gam hodia hakkatuv ki hagam sheyyadu ki sham tzivva Adonai haggalut lo hikshu arpam velo nimneu chas veshalom millekayyem shetar chov haggalut, ella nasu tappam vegomer vayyavou mitzrayma.

rashi: Vaalu el avi. eretz yisrael gevoha mikkol haaratzot:
Veachare chen. meachar sherauhu voche velibbo shalem immahem dibberu echav itto shemmittechilla hayu voshim mimmennu:
ohc: Vayyevk alehem veachare chen dibberu vegomer. perush, achar sherau shebbacha alehem, az samach libbam vedibberu itto, ki chol haddevarim shehaya omer efshar shehaya omer lahem ken lehasir mehem habbusha, uleolam levavo yimar alehem mitztzad hammaase. achen kesherau shechibbek otam uvacha al peredatam, hikkiru bemiddat tuvo ki ach neeman hu vedibberu itto. vahagam shebbacha mikkodem, en hochacha mizze, ki efshar zachar tzarato uvacha aleha, ma sheen ken bechi ze shebbacha alehem. gam bechi harishon yesh makom litlot shebbacha al peredat binyamin, ma sheen ken keshebbacha alehem bifratut, ze yaggid achva ballev.

rashi: Vayvarech yaakov. kederech kol hanniftarim millifne sarim mevarchim otam venotlim reshut, uma beracha bercho? sheyyaale nilus leraglav, lefi sheen mitzrayim shota me geshamim ella nilus ole umashke, umibbirchato shel yaakov vaelach haya faro va el nilus vehu ole likrato umashke et haaretz (tanchuma):
Veshovavticha. eese otcha shovav, anvoyishir belaaz. kol haholech bishrirut libbo nikra shovav, kemo (Yeshayahu 57:17) "vayyelech shovav bederech libbo":

Venatatti chachim bilchayecha. derech chayya lehotziah bechachim shebbilchayeha, lefi sheenah rotza latzet; gam ani etten belibbecha hirhurin veyetzer, hammoshech otcha meartzecha lavo al eretz yisrael:
targum: Vaashadlinach veetten sherin al lisatach veappek yatach veyat kol mashriyatach susevan ufarashin levushe gemir kulehon mashiryan sagian di mezaynin baagilin uteresin ochode sayfin kulehon:

rashi: Bashshever asher hem shovrim. notnin lo et hakkesef:
ohc: Vaylakket vegomer. amar leshon lekita, perush shello nishar mehakkesef beyadam velo kelum, ki lo hinniach acharav leket.

rashi: Geshu na elay. raa otam nesogim leachor, amar achshav achay nichlamim, kara lahem belashon rakka vetachanunim, vehera lahem shehu mahul (Bereshit Rabba):
ohc: Vayyomer yosef vegomer geshu na vegomer. taam hahaggasha, letzad sheratza lomar lahem inyan hammechira, laze lo ratza lomar lahem ella bilchisha, laze amar "geshu", veachar shenniggeshu amar lahem vegomer "asher mechartem oti" vegomer, vahagam sheamar "hotziu chol ish" vegomer velo amad sham adam, af al pi chen chash laaznayim lakkir vedibber beaznehem.

Ani yosef achichem vegomer. taam shechazar paam sheniyya ani yosef, letzad sheraa shello anuhu chashash lishne devarim: haechad sheppachadu mimmennu velo yachlu lehashiv kevoshet gannav ki yimmatze, vehashsheni shello heeminuhu shehu yosef. laze amar keneged tzad hayyira sheattem yereim venivhalim, lo tachushu ledavar, ki ani yosef achichem, perush mitnaheg immachem bemiddat haachva ucheillu lo haya haddavar hahu. gam samach lomar achichem asher mechartem lomar sheafillu bizman hammecher lo chahata en haachva mimmenni. ucheneged tzad hatzedakat haddavar shehu yosef, amar lahem davar shebbo yatzdiku besiman muvhak ki hu ze, beamro asher mechartem oti mitzrayma vedavar ze lo yedao adam vaafillu navi (yalkut shemauni 142) im lo shettomar vadday gamur ki hu ze yosef.

rashi: Ben hakkenaanit. ben dina shennivala lichnaani; cheshehargu et shechem lo hayta dina rotza latzet ad shennishba lah shimon sheyyissaenna (Bereshit Rabba):
Elle bene lea, veet dina vitto. hazzecharim tala velea vehannekevot tala veyaakov, lelammedcha, ishsha mazraat techilla yoledet zachar, ish mazria techilla yoledet nekeva:

Sheloshim veshalosh. uvifratan i atta motze ella sheloshim ushenayim, ella zo yocheved shennolda ven hachomot bichnisatan lair, shenneemar asher yalda otah lelevi bemitzrayim – ledatah bemitzrayim veen horatah bemitzrayim:
Afes. ketargumo shelim:
ohc: Velamma namut vegomer ki afes kasef vegomer. perush, leheyot shello haya chafetz lakachat bischar hattevua ki im hakkesef velo peraon acher, vaasher mitztzad ze likket kol hakkesef hannimtza, veatta bau betaana lomar "lamma" vegomer letaam shettam hakkesef, shehare yecholin hemma lifroa hattevua bishve kesef. velaze heshivam yosef shennitratztza lakachat miknehem bead hallechem kevan shettam hakkesef, vedikdek bidvarav lomar im afes kasef, vezulat ze lo yitten lahem kol od sheyyesh lahem lefaro bechesef. vetamo lehaani mitzrayim kede shello yihyu echav dallim bifne ashirim, velaze nitchakkem sheyyiknu mimmennu bechesef, shekkol od shehammikne beyadam mezonotam alehem veyitztarchu liknot lechem lahem umezonot hammikne, ki min hassetam en deshe veen esev utzerichin latet seorim maachol labbehemot. laze hinniach tzarche hammikne alehem vayyishbor lahem bechesef, shebbaze lo nishlema shana rishona ad shehureku venaasu keli rek mikkol, ucheshebbau echav hayu ashirim lifne aniyyim vehayu lechavod uletifaret, ma shello haya chen im haya makdim lakachat mehem hammikne.

Od nire sheyyechavvenu lomar sheyyesh lahem kesef, ella sheeno benimtza lahem az, veze hu davar haragil shebbene adam lo yihye lahem matzuy tamid kesef, ki yishlechu beeretz merchakkim. vehu amro afes leshon menia. velaze taanu lamma yamutu letzad shekkaspam bemakom acher. veheshivam ki yittenu miknehem im nimna mehem hakkesef, vechavvanato hu, im emet divrehem sheyyesh lahem kesef ella sheeno matzuy, veze yore sheeno matzdik divrehem, veamar lahem sheyyittenu lo mikne habbehema mashkon bead hakkesef ad sheyyaggia leferek hitkabbel, veaz yachzir lahem hammikne.

rashi: Vechi hu moshel. vaasher hu moshel:

Vayyafog libbo. nechelaf libbo vehalach millehaamin, lo haya libbo fone el haddevarim, leshon mefigin taaman bilshon mishna uchemo meen hafugot (Eicha 3), verecho lo namar (Yirmeyahu 48), metargeminan verecheh la fag:
ohc: Vayyaggidu lo lemor. taam amro vayyaggidu shehallashon yaggid al hakkoshi, leheyot sheamru devarim shehem kashim etzlam leamram, ki sof sof tiggale raatam etzlo asher asu vaasher garmu laavihem kol hatztzaar vehabbechi, uchefi ze amar vayyaggidu lema shennogea lahem. o letzad shebbesora zo goremet yeridat mitzrayim vehashshibud hakkashe asher merru et chayye yisrael bemitzrayim, vechen timtza shehaya yare miridat mitzrayim ad sheamar lo Adonai (Bereshit 46:3) al tira merda mitzrayma.

Vetaam amro lemor nitchakkemu levassero bederech shello yistakken yaakov, ki davar yadua hu ki besora tova keshettihye al yagon, uma gam keshettihye muflet lerov hassimcha, yesukkan haadam veyechelash veyigva peta pitom. asher al ken chashshu al haddavar venitchakkemu ledabber elav bederech shello teera takkala, vehu amro vayyaggidu lo lemor, perush amru lo sheyyesh lahem besora lemor lo, uvaze titrachev nafsho veyismach libbo, veachar kach amru lo od yosef chay, velo nistakken, ki huchan belibbo hachanat kabbalat besora tova.

O yitbaer shiur hakkatuv al ze hadderech: vayyaggidu lo lemor od, perush, millevad shebbau shelemim shimon uvinyamin immahem, od yesh lahem lemor lo. veachar shehechin dato ledavar tov, hodiuhu "yosef chay", vehosifu od lomar vechi hu moshel, besora achar besora, lattaam hannizkar.

Raiti latet lev beinyan yosef, ech lo chash al tzaar aviv kamma shanim. vehen emet bime avduto nuchal lomar ki asa velo hitzliach, ella achar sheala ligdulla, lamma lo katav iggeret leaviv lehafig tzaaro, ki yodea haya yosef godel hafelagat chibbat yaakov bo vayyitabbel alav yamim rabbim. velamma lo shalach levassero? vetigdal od hakkushya al yeme haraav shehayu ovrim veshavim meeretz mitzrayim leeretz kenaan velo chash al tzaaro. veod, mi hittir lo achar shebbau echav lehaarich lo yeme tzara shello lehodio techef umiyyad?

Vehen emet ki lema shennitgalgel bainyanim sheggazar haggozer, rabbim hem shehayu tzerichin lihyot ken: haechad – leshallem leyaakov esrim ushetayim shanim shello shimmesh aviv, uchemo chen haya hu betzaar esrim ushetayim shanim, vegam lemispar 210 sheggazar Adonai sheyyihyu bemitzrayim, vegam laredet yaakov bechavod gadol ma shello haya ken im haya yored kodem, vechamma peratim shennimshechu, ella letzad yosef tzerichin latet taam laddavar.
Venire ki tamo shel yosef taam lishvach, vehu ki meet yeridato lemitzrayim ad et bo devaro yitbarach vehotzio mibbet haasurim limloch, en sippek beyado lehodia leaviv.
Vaafillu sheyyunach shehaya sippek beyado, chash al nafsho sheyyedu echav baddavar, uletzad bashtam uchelimmatam meavihem yimseru atzmam alav leabbedo min haolam, leval taggia lahem boshet meavihem.
Vegam efshar ki yekallelem veyamit kullam, umitztzad ze yevakshu lekakeo mehaolam. laze chash al nafsho sheyyedu echav baddavar, veyimmana mibbo bidme nafsho.

Veachar tzeto mimmaasar venaasa sar gadol vehalcha lah chashasha rishona, af al pi chen nimna mehodia leaviv. vehu al derech amram zichronam livracha (bava metzia 59.), mutav sheyyappil adam atzmo lechivshan haesh veal yalbin pene chavero, vechash al kevod haachim millevayyesham lifne yaakov veyitzchak vechol zera yaakov, vesaval sheyyishshaer aviv betzaaro millevayyesham.

Veod, af ki achar sheala ligdulla chashav yosef belibbam mechush hahastama mimmennu veyityaatzu alav leakro mehaolam, uchemo chen timtza sheamru zichronam livracha (tanchuma) sheratzu leakro afillu bime gedullato uva gavriel ufizzeran, vahagam sheamru zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 91) sheyyardu acharav lemitzrayim lifdoto bedamim yekarim, yishtanne haddavar im yifduhu hem sheaz yakkir beachvatam, vezulat ze evrato shemara netzach velo yishkach et asher asu lo veyakdimu hem lehargo. hinnecha roe ki im haya modia mikkodem leyaakov ki hu chay hayu mitazzerim uvaim umeabbedim oto mehaolam.

Vegam achar shebbau lefanav bishnat raav lo ratza legallot atzmo techef lahem velo leaviv, ki odennu besakkanat mechush kannizkar, ad shennitchakkem veheechilam vehishkam venatan lahem damim vehera lahem ki hu immahem belev shalem. gam nigla haddavar ki meAdonai yatza veyadu vadday ki lo shomer hu lahem eva, vegam beemtzaut ken husera busha meavihem, ki yomru elav ki chen gazar haggozer, uchemo shepperashti befasuk (Bereshit 45:8) "lo attem" vegomer veaz gilla lahem. veaf al pi chen hutzrach Adonai lishloach malach lehatztzilo miyyadam, kemaamaram zichronam livracha (tanchuma vayyiggash). veulay ki hu yosef lo yada baddavar. o efshar sheyyada shehitztzilo malach, veen lehakeshot alav shehaya lo lehodia leaviv kodem velo yachush el haachim ki hammalach haggoel oto atta yigalennu gam ken kodem, ki en somchin al hannes, uvaze en lehaashimo leyosef al haddavar, venachon.

rashi: Miyyamim rabbim tippaked. miyyamim rabbim shechatata li, tippaked atta lefanay, lizkor avonotecha ulehashiv gemulecha, vaasiacha beacharit hashshanim lavo el eretz yisrael hameshovevet mecherev, sheshshavu yoshveha min haggola, asher galu sham al yede cherev haoyev:
Asher hayu lecharba tamid. ze shanim rabbot; vesamuch levoacha alehem, chazru:
Vehi meammim hutzaa. vehaya lecha lasum al lev shehi meammim hutzaa, vehammotziah min haammim lo yaazvenna beyadcha:
targum: Miomin sagiin temani mashiryatach besof shenaya tehach al ara detavu ala mekatle charba deitkenashu meammin sagiin al ture ara deyisrael dahavo lecharva tedira veinun mibbene ammaya itgeliu vitivu lerochatzan kulehon:

ohc: Ki ech eele vegomer. perush, belo taam haamur sheamar "vechatati" vegomer, "ech eele" vegomer. veod ulay shennoten taam lema sheamar bitchilla (Bereshit 44:16) "hinnu avadim gam anachnu" vegomer, "ki ech eele vegomer pen ere vara", ucheshello yaalu kullan lo yire vegomer:

Od yechavven lehashiv letaanat ishsha chachama sheshshalach yoav ledavid (Shmuel 2 14:7), ki kama hammishpacha laharog et makke achiv utemitehu benefesh achiv vegomer, vehinne hu hanniddon shellefanenu, ki kesheyyaggid yehuda leaviv ki anus hu veeno yachol lehatztzil binyamin miyyad hammelech, peshita shello yitachzer yaakov veyishkal gam shenehem yehuda uvinyamin veyattir lenidduyo shel yehuda, laze amar taana shenit "ki ech eele" vegomer, ki choshesh lesakkanat mot aviv.

rashi: Shene meguray. yeme geruti; kol yamay hayiti ger baaretz:
Velo hissigu. betova:
Baavur teshvu beeretz goshen. vehi tzericha lachem shehi eretz mire, ucheshettomru lo sheen attem bekiin bimlacha acheret, yarchikchem mealav veyoshivchem sham:
Ki toavat mitzrayim kol roe tzon. lefi shehem lahem elohut:
Besifte navon timmatze chachma. kesheadam mochiach lenavon, meshiv lo: chatati! kegon david sheamar lenatan: "chatati" (Shmuel 2 12:13):
Veshevet legev chasar lev. aval chasar lev eno shomea ad sheyyilke, kemo paro (Shemot 7:14-11:10):
targum: Besifvate desucheltana tishkach chachmeta veshivta lefigra dachasar raayana:

rashi: Vaynahalem. kemo vaynahagem, vedome lo en menahel lah (Yeshayahu nusach acher), al me menuchot yenahaleni (Tehillim 23):
Al tira merda mitzrayma. lefi shehaya metzer al shennizkak latzet lechutza laaretz:
ohc: Al tira vegomer ki legoy vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma hu hammora shehaya leyaakov biridat mitzrayim, veim mora haggalut im ken ma hu kavvanat Adonai beamro "al tira" bema mesir mimmennu hammora, veim kavvanato shello yihye galut sham, matzinu shello chen haya, ki sham nishtabedu banav beinnuy vaavoda kasha. od kashe amro ki legoy gadol ma netinat taam ze lahasarat hammora, od tzarich ladaat amro legoy gadol asimcha sham velamma lo yesimehu goy gadol bemakom acher. od tzarich ladaat lamma amar legoy velo amar "ki goy gadol asimcha" vegomer:

Achen kavvanat hakkatuv hu letzad ma shekkadam mehahodaa lehaavot ki nigzera gezerat haggalut alehem, dichtiv (Bereshit 15:13) "ki ger yihye zaracha" vegomer, umin hassetam yaggid avraham levanav, vechen hu meforash bedivrehem zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 82). asher al ken kesheraa yaakov shever bemitzrayim ki sham yisbelu banav haggalut, laze kesheyyarad yare lenafsho ki yatchil haggalut mimmennu, gam yare haya shemma yikkaver sham beeretz temea. asher al ken nigla elav Adonai veamar lo "anochi elohe avicha", nitkavven baamira zo ki keshem sheavicha lo taam taam shibud veinnuy, kemo chen atta al tira hagam sheatta yored mitzrayma. uletzad sheyyachshov yaakov lachzor velaalot mimmitzrayim kesheyyimtza sheat hakkosher vehu achar avor shenat raav, vehavetachato yitbarach sheomer lo "al tira" hi al zeman muat sheyyihye sham, laze gamar omer ki legoy gadol asimcha sham, perush, rotze ani lasum otcha sham letzorech goy gadol.

Ulehaskil al davar akdim imre kadosh hu harashbi veanshe sodo (likkute tora mikketz) sheamru ki taam haggaluyyot hu levarer chelke hakkedushsha hammefuzzarim beanfe hakkelippa, vechi bemitzrayim leheyotah melea gillulim vesham tokef hattuma, sham hu sheviyyat chelke hakkedushsha harabbim vehaatzumim, ki leerech godel hattuma yihye bekirbah chelke hakkedushsha. veze haya miyyom shechata adam harishon sheshshalta shifcha raa benitzotze hakkedushsha, veene chol yisrael al ze bechol haggaluyyot uvifrat begalut mitzrayim. vehosifu lomar zichronam livracha (likkute tora vayyeshev) ki am hayyotze meeretz mitzrayim haomed al har sinay hu haam shehaya shavuy betoch kelippat mitzrayim, veelav amar moshe nevi Adonai (Devarim 4:8) "umi goy gadol" vegomer. velaze atzmo yechavven Adonai bedabbero im yaakov, taam shemmaskim al yeshivat yaakov bemitzrayim hu lesibbat goy gadol asher hu avud sham biklippat mitzrayim vetzarich hu lehotzio mishsham, vezulat yeridat yaakov en tikva laze, ki beotzem kedushshato yishav kol anfe hakkedushsha asher sham, ma sheen zulato yachol asohu. velaze timtza sheamru zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 79) shello met yaakov avinu ad sheraa shishshim ribbo yotze chalatzav, veotam shishshim ribbo nitannu sham achar kach venitzrefu bechur habbarzel beoni mitzrayim veyatzu mezukkakim. umimmotza davar hirgish yaakov ki retzono yitbarach lashevet sham yaakov, uvehavtachat ki lo yira meavor alav shibud veinnuy, veodennu betzaar kevurat haaretz, laze amar "anochi ered immecha vegomer veanochi aalcha" vegomer.
Od yechavven lomar lo taam asher chafetz hu sheyyitkayyem hashshibud vehainnuy bemitzrayim, shebbaze yihye haddavar kaved al banav, ki "legoy gadol" vegomer shehu sham, umuchrach haddavar lihyot ken.

rashi: Peullat tzaddik lechayyim. kemashmao. umidrash aggada (Devarim Rabba 2:20): shelomo asa peullat hammikdash lechayyehem shel yisrael, lechapparatan:
Utevuat rasha. tevuato (0 havaato) shel menashshe (divrei hayamim 2 33:7), shehichnis bo hassemel, hi hayta lechattat:
targum: Ovade detzadika lechaye alalteh derashia lachatuta:

rashi: Rav. rav li od simcha vechedva hoil veod yosef beni chay:
Birkat Adonai hi taashir, velo yosif etzev immah. en tzarich lehityaggea lehaashir bo, day babberacha ma shehu mevarcho:
targum: Birketa deelaha hi meattera vela nosef keva imah:

rashi: Zecher tzaddik livracha. hammazkir tzaddik mevarcho:
Veshem reshaim yirkav. rikkavon ole bishmam, sheen adam chafetz lehazekir shemo vehu mishtakkeach meelav (yoma lach:):
targum: Ducherana detzadike bircheta ushema derashie nidach:

rashi: Berov devarim lo yechdal pasha. hammarbe devarim mevi chet:
Vechosech sefatav. hu hammaskil:
targum: Besugea demile la fasek chova udechasech sifvateh sucheltana:

rashi: Sina teorer medanim. afillu avera shennittena leshichcha nizkeret al yede marbit avonot; baa sina acharona umeorertan. shekken yechezkel hochiach et yisrael al averot mitzrayim: "vaomar alehem ish et shikkutze enav hashelichu vegomer" (Yechezkel 20:7) – kamma shanim hayta sina zo kevusha velo hizkirah lahem hakkadosh baruch hu, ad achshav, shehirbu averot al pishehem (Vayikra Rabba 7:1):
Veal kol peshaim techasse ahava. kesheyyisrael metivim maasehem, hakkadosh baruch hu mechasse al peshaehem:
targum: Seniata tegarag tigre veal kulhon surechane mechasa rachamuta:

rashi: Vekarahu ason. shehassatan mekatreg bishat hassakkana (Bereshit Rabba):
Vehoradtem et sevati vegomer. achshav keshehu etzli, ani mitnachem bo al immo veal achiv, veim yamut ze, dome alay sheshshelashtan metu beyom echad:
Yaakov yaakov. leshon chibba:
Maoz lattom derech Adonai umechitta. hi lefoale aven sheenan holchin bah, vehi nifraat mehem:
targum: Mashena litmime orcheh deelaha veshetzya neheve leilen deavdin avta:

rashi: Et tov eretz mitzrayim. eretz goshen, nibba veeno yodea ma nibba, sofam laasotah kimtzula sheen bah dagim:
Chelev haaretz. kol chelev leshon metav hu:
Rameses. meeretz goshen hi:
Leav. lechaver ulefatron:
ohc: Veatta lo attem vegomer. perush, latet taam lehasir millibbam chashash hassina, leval yachshevu ki yosef yistom otam veyisnaem al asher nitachzeru alav, veyihye beenehem davar rachok sheyyihye lev yosef nachon immam, laze amar lahem: hen emet ki bishat maase asher mecharuhu hayu haddevarim zarim beenav, ech yihye kol haachzariyyut belev achim al achihem, ureuyim hem lihyot senuim etzlo.

Achen atta, achar reoto kol hannimshach miridato mitzrayim, yada ki hammaase haya meet Adonai, vehem shelichuto yitbarach asu velo shelichut atzmam, uvaze en makom lishmor lahem eva velo leharechik middat haachva mehem.

Veulay ki baze haya lahem panim laamod lifne avihem keshennigla haddavar, ki hem haggormim lo evel uvechi esrim ushetayim shana veasu hammaase hammufela bemecher achihem, veroani sheggam bosh lo yevoshu meavihem. vehaya nire lomar ki yaakov lo yada guf hammaase, veze derech rachok, ki peshita shello yimmana mechakor zot heach nitgalgelu haddevarim ad sheyyarad yosef lemitzrayim, vegam maase ketonet happassim hammuva elav mutbal bedam. ella vadday ki betaanat "lo attem shelachtem" vegomer sheamar yosef, hukkar haddavar ki meet Adonai hayta zot veen lehareher achar middotav, vehu amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 87:1) rauy haya yaakov laredet beshalshelaot vechulei:

rashi: Vehinne enechem root. bichvodi, vesheani achichem sheani mahul kachem, veod, ki fi hamedabber alechem bilshon hakkodesh (Bereshit Rabba):
Veene achi vinyamin. hishva et kullam yachad lomar, shekkeshem sheen li sina al binyamin achi, shehare lo haya vimchirati, kach en belibbi sina alechem:

Mekor chayyim pi tzaddik ufi reshaim vegomer. pihem yechasse chamas shebbelibbam, shemmachalikin et siftehem vesina temuna belibbam. veen pitron mikra ze dome lefitron haelyon (Mishlei 10:6), vehainyan yore alehem:
targum: Mabbua dechayye puma detzadike ufumehon derashie nechasa chatofa:

rashi: Bene rachel eshet yaakov. uvechullan lo neemar bahen eshet, ella shehayta ikkaro shel bayit:
Velechem en bechol haaretz. chozer lainyan harishon – litchillat shene haraav:
Vattela. kemo vattile, leshon ayefut, ketargumo; vedome lo kemitlahleah hayyore zikkim (Mishlei 26):
ohc: Velechem en vegomer ki chaved vegomer. perush: uletzad koved haraav hayu ochlim davar mufla vechillu hallechem, vahalo lirot enenu daava nafshenu bishne raav shehayu bammaarav, shehaya adam echad ochel shiur maachal asara bene adam veodennu raev bevitno, rachamana litzlan.

rashi: Hakkohanim. hakkumarim, kol leshon kohen mesharet leelohut hu, chutz meotan shehem leshon gedulla, kemo kohen midyan, kohen on:
Chok lakkohanim. chok kach vechach lechem layyom:
Tochelet tzaddikim simcha. sofah mitkayyemet usemechim:
Vetikvat reshaim toved. ki lo tavo:
targum: Sivrehon detzadike chedvata vesivra derashie neved:
Veegzar lehon keyam shelam keyam alam yehe imhon veevarchinun veasge yathon veetten yat makdeshi benehon laalam:
Hech chumetza leshine vechittenana leayne hechna shelicha atla limshalchoy:
Parsae kushee ufutae imhon kulehon mezaynin baagilin vekulesin:
Veabed yathon leama chad beara betur kudesha deyisrael deyisrael umalka chad yehe lechulehon lemeheve malka vela yehon od litren ammin vela yitpalgun od letarten malkevan od:
Vechad yemrun lach bene amach lememar hala techave lana ma ilen lach:
Vetemar kidnan amar Adonai elohim ha ana shelach rugezi alach gog rav resh meshech vetuval:
Dechalteh deelaha tosef yomata ushene derashie nizaran:
Veyedun ammaya are ana Adonai mekadesh yat yisrael bemeheve makdeshi benehon lealam:
Defaleach bekayta bera sucheltana hu udedamech bechatzda bera hu mevahatana:
Veitnabbe lehon kidnan amar Adonai elohim ha ana mekarev yat bene yisrael mibbene ammaya deitgeliu letaman veechnosh yathon mischor sechor veael yathon learahon:
Vahava fitgam nevua min kodam Adonai imi lememar:
Veashre shechinti benehon veeheve lehon lelaha veinun yehon kodamay leam:
Vela yistaavun od bemaavathon uveshikutzehon uvechol merdehon veefrok yathon mikkol motvanehon dechavu kodamay behon veadke yathon vihon kodamay leam vaana eheve lehon lelaha:
Vahava pitgam nevua min kodam Adonai imi lememar:
Veavdi david malka alehon ufarnas chad yehe lechulehon uvedinay yehachun ukeyamay yitrun veyabedun yathon:
Vihon luchaya di tichtov alehon bidach leenehon:

bart: Hammevi asham taluy. yetze veyire baeder. im shear tzono, kechullin gemurim. desavar rabbi meir, kevan delo tzarich leh lo makdish leh:

Yire ad sheyyistaev. demittoch shellibbo nokfo bishat hahafrasha umityare missefek hachet, gamar umakdish leh veaf al pi shello yitztarech, hilkach yire ad sheyyippol bo mum veyippelu damav lindava lehavi mehen olat nedava. vahalacha kachachamim:
Haddam yishshafech. laamma (shebbammikdash) [shebbaazara]:
Levet hasserefa. veaf al gav dechullin shennishchatu baazara teunim kevura, hay have kezevach pasul shettaun serefa:
Nizrak haddam. kodem shennoda lo:

Yeachel. habbasar. derachamana amar (Vayikra 5) vehu lo yada venislach lo, bishat selicha lo tehe yedia. vehacha nammi bishat zerikat haddam dehaynu sheat selicha lo hayta yedia, vahare gamar kol kapparat sefeko, vahava leh asham taluy kasher:

Afillu haddam bakkos yizzarek. desavar rabbi yose kele sharet mekaddeshin et happasul likkarev, vechol haomed lizzarek kezaruk dame, vehave keillu nizrak haddam kevar kodem shehayta lo yedia. veen halacha kerabbi yose:

Chattat haof. huchshera lippasel. kelomar mishennimleka nittosfa bah kedushsha, shehi nifselet im naga bah tevul yom o mechussar kippurim. vedavka nifselet bitvul yom, aval lo mittammea letamme acherim, shekkeshem shettevul yom posel et hatteruma kach hu fosel et hakkodesh:

Huzza damah chayyavin aleha mishshum piggul. dehazzaa shel chattat haof bimkom zerika divhema kae, dehazzaa kovaat piggul keshechashav bo kodem lachen kemo zerikat dam bivhema, veshuv yesh bo issur notar vetame:
Veen bah meila. dechevan dehuzza damah yesh [bah] hetter lakkohanim:
Lo yevienna veno acharav. im shagag habben beshiggat chattat, lo yavi chattat shehifrish aviv kede sheyyechuppar bah al shiggato:
Hamedayyer sadehu. leshon dir shel behemot, sheen lo makom panuy lehaamid behemotav ella sham, veeno mitkavven lezabbel sadehu beinyan ze, vedato lehachenis hazzevel laashpot achar kach:
Sahar. kemo sachar, hekkef shel mechitztza seviv hatztzon:

Oker shalosh ruchot. keshennitmallea hassahar zevel oker min hassachar shalosh ruchot vezokfan letzad [acher] shel emtzait umedayyer sham kemo chen bet satayim, veose ashpot betoch sadehu shalosh ashpot levet sea kidamran:

Nimtza medayyer bet arbaat seim. satayim mitztzad ze shel mechitztza emtzait vesatayim mitztzad acher. veashmeinan matnitin deshare ledayyer bet arbaat sein kodem sheyyaase mimmenna ashpot, aval tefe lo, shello yomru ledayyer sadehu mitkavven:
Mippene marit haayin. shello yehe nire kemitkavven lezabbel sadehu im ose et kullah sachar:
Kederech hammezabbelin. shalosh ashpot lechol bet sea. veen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:
En bonin madregot. maalot al pi haggeayot, shello yachaliku biridatan lakachat hammayim shennitkabbetzu baemek beotan haggummot, denire kimtakkenan lehashekot bahen sedotav bashsheviit:
Lo yismoch beafar. im ba lihyot socher mekom yetziat hammayim baavanim, lo yitten afar vetit ben haavanim, mishshum demechaze tefe shehu mitkavven lehashekot mehen sedotav:
Aval ose hu chayitz. avanim sedurot zo al zo keen gader belo afar vetit:
Kol even. shebbesadehu afillu ketanna, im keshehu bone haggader o habbinyan yachol lifshot yado velittelah velivnot bah:
Hare zo tinnatel. shehaggader mochachat alav delivnot gidro hu notlah velo letakken hassade lizria:
Hare ze nazir veasur bechullam. uveha kulle alma modu, mippene shehitna al ma shekkatuv battora vechol hammatne al ma shekkatuv battora tenao batel:
Aval eni yodea shehannazir asur beyayin hare ze asur. deyayin vetiglachat vetuma haasurim bannazir, hannozer meechad mehen nazir bechullan:
Verabbi shimon mattir. desavar eno nazir ad sheyyizzor mikkullan:
O mippene sheani kover metim hare ze muttar. dahave nidre onasim, vehu echad mearbaa nedarim shehittiru chachamim:
Verabbi shimon oser. desavar arbaa nedarim shehittiru chachamim tzerichim sheela lechacham. veen halacha kerabbi shimon behane tere bave dematnitin:
Mezabbelin. machnisin lahem zevel:

Meadderim. chofrim beikkere hailanot, shekkol davar shehu letzorech perot shel shishshit muttar betosefet sheviit, vedavar sheeno ella letzorech tikkun hailan asur, ella im ken hu davar sheafillu bashsheviit atzmah en issuro ella middivre sofrim, uvetosefet sheviit lo gazur:
Bet hashshelachin. sheen day lah beme geshamim vetzarich lehashekotah, targum vehu ayef (Bereshit 25) vehu meshalhe:
Meyabbelin. chotchin hayyabbelet, mumin hannoladin bailan:
Mefarkin. healin meal hailan lehakel mealav:
Meabbekin. sharashim hammegullim mechassim otan beavak:
Meashshenin. tachat hailan lehamit hattolaim haggedelim bo:
Af notel et healin. bashsheviit atzmah, vetanna kamma lo amar ella mefarkin et healin betosefet sheviit levad. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:

Kiyyem latteenim kullo kayyam kulei. vetama, dichtiv (sham) ishah yekimennu, yakim mimmennu, keshekkiyyem miktzato kiyyem kullo. aval yeferennu, delekka lemidrash hachi, eno mufar ad sheyyafer kullo. veellu divre yachid veenah halacha, ella halacha kachachamim sheomrim makkish hakama lahafara, ma hafara ma shehefer hefer uma shello hefer lo hefer, deha lekka lemidrash miyyeferennu hafara bemiktzat, af hakama ma shekkiyyem kiyyem uma shello kiyyem lo kiyyem, demiyyekimennu nammi lo darshinan hakama bemiktzat, ella orcheh dikra lemichtav hachi. veaf al gav divhattarat chacham amrinan neder shehuttar miktzato huttar kullo, bahafarat habbaal vehaav eno chen:
Pol hammitzri. 427 belaaz:
Shezzerao lezera. kede lehotzi mimmennu zera lizroa velo laachila:
Kayyotze vahem. batar hasherasha, keorez vedochan, ben leinyan maasrot ben leinyan sheviit. vedavka shezzerao lezera, aval zerao leyarak azlinan batar lekita keyarak:
Haggamlonin. haggassim:
Mishettirmelu. shehukshu venaasu kemin kis. vedugmato betarmilo [shabbat lo.] shehu kis shel roim:
Mitztza damah. mitztzuy deolat haof kae vimkom zerikat habbehema vehazzaa dechattat haof. divolat haof ketiv venimtza damo:

Ad shettetze levet haddashen. dechevan dechullah kalil velet bah sheat hetter levassof, leolam moalin bah ad shettissaref kullah vetinnatel meafarah terumat haddeshen, kedichtiv (Vayikra 6) veherim et haddeshen asher tochal haesh:
Meematay motziim zevalim leashpot. derech ovde adama lechannes hazzevel lemakom echad bassade veose sham ashpa gedola ad shehu mefazzero bassade lezabbelah:

Misheyyifseku ovre avera. laavod et haaretz bashshana hashsheviit, vekodem sheyyifseku ovre avera asur, shello yomru meovre avera hu ulezabbel sadehu hu motzi. veyesh sefarim shekkatuv bahem ovde avoda, vehi hi:
Mishsheyyivash hammatok. mishsheyyihye yavesh hazzevel shennoten metika lapperot:

Mishsheyyikkasher. keshemmatchil lehityabbesh mitabbe venaase kesharim, ukerovim divrehem lihyot shavim. uvayrushalmi mefaresh mishsheyyivash hammatok sedakin shebbabbika keshehammatar yored mitmalleim mayim veenam mityabbeshim ella leachar zeman, venikraim matok al shem matku lo rigve nachal (Iyov 21):

Hannetiot vehaddeluim mitztarfin levet sea. bidlaat yevanit davka ayre bematnitin shehi gedola keilan velo vishar deluin. vetzarich sheyyihyu hannetiot rabbot al haddeluim, kegon shehayu hannetiot shishsha vehaddeluim arbaa, mitztarfin laasara vechorshin kol bet sea bishvilan:
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer. afillu hayu kol haasara deluin chorshin kol bet sea bishvilan, lefi shehen kintiot. vahalacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:

Hareni nazir mikkan ad makom peloni. vehechezik badderech kede lalechet leoto makom. aval im lo hechezik lalechet leoto makom, naasa keomer mikkan vead sof haolam vehave nazir sheloshim yom, ben shehaya hammakom karov ben shehaya rachok vaafillu mahalach kamma shanim, shello nitkavven ella linzirut achat gedola:
