Kadshe kadashim sheshshechatan baddarom. af al pi sheddinan lehishshachet batztzafon, lo tema cheman dechankinhu damu vehavu chekadashim shemmetu sheyyatzu yede meila devar tora, kamashma lan dekadashim shemmetu lo chazu chelal, aval darom nehi deeno rauy lekadshe kadashim, aval rauy hu lekadashim kallim, hilkach moalin bahen, umi shennehena mehem shave feruta mevi karban meila. velo vilvad ki nishchatu vaddarom vekibbel daman batztzafon hu demoalin bahen, mishshum deikkar avoda vatztzafon haveya [kaddin], demikkabbala vaelach mitzvat kehunna, ella afillu shechatan batztzafon vekibbel daman baddarom, af al gav deikkar avoda haveya vaddarom shello chaddin, afillu hachi moalin bahen:
Vezarak daman ballayla. af al gav delayla lav zeman hakerava, moalin bahen:
Ballayla vezarak daman bayyom. hay chol shekken hu demoalin, deha zarak bayyom deikkar avoda hu. ella zo veen tzarich lomar zo katane:
O sheshshechatan. batztzafon, vechashav alehen leachlan chutz lizmannan shehu figgul sheyyesh bo charet, o chutz limkoman shehu fesul sheen bo charet, moalim bahen:
Kelal amar rabbi yehoshua kol shehaya lah sheat hetter lakkohanim. af al gav deshuv nifsela, veen rashshaim leachlan, afillu hachi en moalin bahen:

Shellana. leachar zerika, o shennitmea o sheyyatza chutz laazara leachar zerika. af al gav deenah reuya lakkohanim, kevan dehaya lah shaa achat hetter kodem shellana, en moalim bah, delav kadshe Adonai‏ karinan bah, deha chazu lakkohanim:

Veshekkibbelu fesulim vezarku et damah. kibbelu pesulim et damah af al pi shezzerakuhu kesherim, o shezzerakuhu pesulim af al pi shekkibbeluhu kesherim. veim leachar shekkibbelu pesulim et haddam uzerakuhu, chazru kesherim vekibbelu shear dam hannefesh uzerakuhu, hare zerikat hakkesherim moelet umatteret habbasar lakkohanim veen bo mishshum meila. vehane mille shear pesulim chutz min hattame, aval tame shekkibbel et haddam uzerako, af al pi shechazru kesherim vekibbelu shear dam hannefesh uzerakuhu, en labbasar sheat hetter, umoalim bo, shehattame hoil verauy laavodat tzibbur, shekkarban tzibbur doche et hattuma, keshezzarak haddam naasa shear haddam sheyarim, veshuv en zerikat hakkesherim moelet lehattir habbasar. veen lecha bappesulim mi sheose haddam sheyarim ella hattame vilvad:

Chaticha shel chelev vachaticha shel chelev notar kulei. mevi chattat mishshum chelev, veasham taluy mechamat safek shel notar, shehannotar becharet kachelev. veissur notar chal al issur chelev lefi shehu issur mosif:

Mevi shalosh chattaot. shetayim mishshum chelev veachat mishshum notar. vehu shehayta lo yedia bentayim, dei lav hachi eno mevi ella shete chattaot, achat mishshum chelev veachat mishshum notar. vehay delo tane hacha shalosh chattaot veasham vadday kidtane leel, mishshum derov notar en bo shave peruta, delo chazi lemidi, veasham meilot eno ba al pachot mishsheve peruta:

Kol chattat shehi vaa al chet. laafoke chattat yoledet sheenah baa al chet. desavar rabbi yose sheshshetayim meviot otah beshuttafut uvitnay, kidamrinan beferek kamma. ufesak halacha, sheen chattat baa beshuttafut, vaafillu chattat shel mechussere kappara:
Parim hannisrafim. en bahen lakkohanim hetter kelal:

Huzza daman kulei. hazzaat daman kovatan lappiggul laanosh karet haochel mehen im chashav alehem bishat shechita lehaketir emurehen chutz lizmannan, vechevan delet behu hetter lakkohanim, moalin bahen bevet haddeshen chutz lammachane hecha denisrefu im nehena mehen:
Ad sheyyuttach habbasar. kelomar sheyyihye nisraf venaase fechamim. aval leachar shennittach, shuv en bo meila, sheen lecha davar shennaaset mitzvato umoalim bo:
Mone nezirut keminyan yemot hashshana. shelosh meot shishshim vechamesh nezirut keminyan yemot hachamma:

Amar rabbi yehuda maase haya kevan shehishlim met. rabbi yehuda shameh lerabbi deaflig attanna kamma veamar shehaomer hareni nazir keminyan yemot hachamma have nezir olam. vehevi maase lehochiach sheeno nezir olam, demaase haya vechevan shehishlim met, uvinzir olam lo shayyach hashelama, ella vadday mone neziriyyot. vechen halacha:
Verabbi akiva mechayyev. rabbi akiva letaameh, dimchayyev asham taluy al sefek meilot:
Shenehem meviin asham echad. beshuttafut, veyomar ze laze, im atta achalta hachaticha shel kodesh yehe chelki machul lecha vihe asham kullo alecha:

En shenayim meviim asham echad. delet leh tenay bakkarbanot, ella im kedivre chachamim shenehem peturim, i kerabbi akiva kol echad mevi asham taluy. vahalacha kachachamim sheen meviim asham taluy al sefek meilot:

Hareni nazir min hachartzannim umin hazzaggim vechulei. im hizkir echad mikkol ellu, hare ze nazir keillu amar hareni nazir setam. umishshum devae lemitna sefa denazir olam unezir shimshon en kol dikduke nezirut alehem, tana hacha kol dikduke nezirut alav:

Ma ben nezir olam vechulei. matnitin chissure michassera vehachi katane, veim nadar lihyot nezir olam hare ze nezir olam. uma ben nezir olam linzir shimshon, nezir olam hichbid searo mekel betaar mishshenem asar chodesh lishnem asar chodesh deyalfinan meavshalom shehaya nezir olam uchetiv beh (Shmuel 2 14) vayhi mikketz yamim layyamim asher yegalleach ki chaved alav vegillecho, uchetiv hatam (Vayikra 25) yamim tihye geullato:

Veim nitma eno mevi karban tuma. vaafillu lechattechilla muttar littame, deshimshon haya mittamme lemetim, vehachi gemire la, vehay dekatane im nitma demashma diavad in lechattechilla lo, mishshum detana resha gabbe nezir olam veim nitma tana sefa nammi gabbe nezir shimshon veim nitma:

Machtzev. makom betoch sadehu shechotzvin mimmennu avanim levinyan. im haya mechusse afar velo haya nire en potchin oto battechilla bashsheviit, sheharoe omer letakken sadehu hu ose kede lizroa betocho velo lehotzi haavanim levinyan:

Ad sheyyehe vo shalosh murebiyyot. sheyyihyu niglim venirim meoto machatzev kodem sheviit shalosh shurot shel avanim, shekkol shura mehem shalosh ammot orech veshalosh ammot rochav berum shalosh ammot, shennimtzeu sham tesha avanim shekkol even hu amma al amma berum shalosh, vechen bechol shura veshura, hare esrim vesheva avanim leshalosh shurot, uvehachi nikkar shelletzorech avanim levinyan hu motziam velo letakken sadehu:
Mashpelot. kuppot shemmotziin bahem zevalim, shekkol mashpel machazik letech shehu masseoy shel chamor, vehalletech chatzi kor, chamesh esre sein:
Mosifin al hammashpelot. noten beashpa achat mashpelot kemo shehu rotze:
Veen mosifin al haashpot. laasot yoter mishshalosh ashpot bevet sea, shello yerae kimzabbel et hassade:
Rabbi shimon omer af al haashpot. mosifin, kevan sheyyesh tzibbur gadol bemakom echad lo mechaze kimzabbel. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Mesakkelin. mesirin et haavanim:
Mekarsemin. kemo mecharsemin bechaf, leshon yecharsemenna chazir miyyaar (tehillim 80), kelomar kortim vechotchin haanafim hayeveshim min hailan:
Mezardin. haanafim hallachim keshehem merubbin regilim lekatztzan umannichin miktzat mehen, vezehu zerud:
Mefasselin. shennotel et happesolet. veyesh mefarshim mefasselin leshon pesal lecha (Shemot 34), shechotchim kol haanafim shebbailan kede sheyyitabbe:

Kezerudah uchefissulah shel chamishshit vechulei. tanna kamma lo share ella ad rosh hashshana shel sheviit. verabbi yehoshua savar kishnat chamishshit ken shishshit, ma chamishshit nichneset lashshishshit kach shishshit nichneset lashsheviit, uchemo shemmezardin shal chamishshit bashshishshit kach mezardin shel shishshit bashsheviit.
Verabbi shimon omer. meatzeret veelach shehu neesar baavodat hailan neesar nammi bezerud ufissul. veshalosh machlokot baddavar, vahalacha ketanna kamma:

Mezahamin et hannetiot. keshekkelippat hailan nosheret madbikim sham zevel lehaverio kede shello yamut hailan. veyesh mefarshim mezahamin shemmoshchim hailanot bedavar sherecho ra kede sheyyivrechu hattolaim min hareach o sheyyamutu:

Vechorchim. yesh mefarshim shekkorchim davar seviv hailan bakkayitz mippene hachamma uvachoref mippene hatztzinna. veyesh mefarshim korchim haanafim zo im zo vekoshrin otam lemala berashehem shello yihyu netushim al haaretz:
Vekotmin otan. yesh mefarshim lashim besharshehem efer, targum efer kitma. veyesh mefarshim shover harashim, kemo niktam rosho [sukka 29:]:
Veosim lahem battim. regilim laasot lailan gader amma sevivotav umemalleim oto afar. veyesh mefarshim sheosim lo sukka millemala lehagen alav min hachamma o min hatztzinna:

Al hannof. shel hailan, aval lo al haikkar, shello yaase bashsheviit kederech sheose bishar hashshanim. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok, ella asur lehashekot hailan bashsheviit ben al hannof ben al haikkar:
Konam sheeni nehenet leabba uleavicha kulei‏ hare ze yafer. dechevan deneesra bahanaat aviha veaviv al yede shehi osa levaalah, genay hu labbaal vehave devarim shebbeno levenah:
Besar kadshe kadashim sheyyatza lifne zerikat damim. veachar kach nichnas veachar kach zarak et haddam:
Rabbi eliezer omer moalim bo. af al pi shezzarak et haddam. disvira leh lerabbi eliezer dizrika lo mahane layyotze laafoke mide meila:
Veen chayyavin alav mishshum piggul notar vetame. hoil veyatza. dizrika cheshera ka kava lefiggul, velo fesula:
Rabbi akiva savar en moalim bo. dekasavar dizrika mehanneya layyotze leappoke mimmeila:

Aval chayyavin kulei. aval, leshon beram, kemo veemet. vechi amar rabbi akiva dizrika mahane layyotze, kegon sheyyatza miktzat habbasar velo chullo, demiggo dimhanneya lehahu miktzat shebbifnim, mehanneya nammi lehahu miktzat sheyyatza chutz. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Amar rabbi akiva vahare hammafrish chattato veavda. hasheta mayte reaya lemay dekaamar dizrika moelet layyotze:
Vahare shetehen omdot. shechutot venitkabbel daman bishte chosot vezarak damah shel achat mehen:
Lo cheshem sheddamah. shel otah:
Poter et besarah. min hammeila:
Kach hu foter et besar chavertah. shello nizrak damah, min hammeila, hoil vehaya yachol lizrok damah shel ezo sheyyirtze:

Veim poter damah et besar chavertah min hammeila. af al gav difsula hi, demotar chattat hi, eno din sheyyiftor besarah shel atzmah, af al pi shennifsela beyotze. velo amar rabbi akiva cheshem sheddamah poter et besarah kach hu foter et besar chavertah, ella chesheshshachat shete hachattaot keachat, lefi sheim ratza mizze zorek ratza mizze zorek, aval baze achar ze lo amar rabbi akiva sheyyihye damah poter besar chavertah:
Chaticha shel chelev vachaticha shel kodesh kulei‏ mevi asham taluy. afillu lerabbanan deamre en meviim asham taluy al sefek meilot, hacha modu dechayyav, mishshum chaticha shel chelev:
Mevi chattat veasham vadday. al hachaticha shel chelev mevi chattat, veal basar shel kodesh asham vadday:

Chattat veasham. beshuttafut. umatne, im ani achalti chelev veatta kodesh yehe chelki baasham machul lecha vechelkecha bachattat machul li. veim ani achalti kodesh veatta chelev yehe chelki bachattat machul lecha vechelkecha baasham machul li:
En shenayim meviim chattat veasham. beshuttafut, ella ze mevi asham taluy veze mevi asham taluy. vehayenu tanna kamma. veha kamashma lan detanna kamma hu rabbi yose vahalacha kemoto:
Meviim mehekdesh kisba, seira. im hifrish maot likkach kisba lechattato, yachol likkach bahen seira im yirtze:
Hifrish lechisba o lisira. hifrish maot liknot bahen kisba o seira:

Heeni. yavi bahen of, vehashshear chullin. dichtiv bekarban ole veyored gabbe kisba useira, mechattato asher chata, demashma mimmiktzat haddavar shehifrish lechattato, sheim heeni yavi of mimmiktzat damim hallalu. vegabbe of nammi ketiv mechattato, demashma deim heeni yoter mevi mimmiktzat deme haof asirit haefa. vegabbe asirit haefa ketiv al chattato, demashma im heeshir yosif al haddamim hallalu veyavi of, o im heeshir yoter yavi kisba o seira:
Venistaava. humema:
Im ratza yavi vedameha of. kegon im heeni:

Sheen laof pidyon. devifsule hammukdashim ketiv (Vayikra 27) veheemid et habbehema lifne hakkohen, vehaya efshar sheyyomar veheemid otah, ma talmud lomar habbehema, lomar lach behema nifdet veen ofot velo etzim velo levona velo kele sharet nifdim:
Habbetzalim hassarisim. sheen osim zera kishar betzalim:
Ufol hammitzri. shezzerao leyarak, dei zerao lezera ha tenan leel deazlinan beh batar hasherasha afillu lo mana mehen mayim:
Shemmana mehen mayim sheloshim yom. yatzu mittorat yerakot haggedelot al kol mayim venaasu kisde vet habbaal shemmistappeket beme geshamim, hilkach mitasserin lesheavar:

Veshel baal. sade shehi baemek umeluchlachat veen tzarich lehashekotah, umikkol makom leyarak tzericha hashekaa, mishshum hachi katane shemmana mehem mayim shete onot, zeman hashekaatah shergilin lehashekotah kare ona. vahalacha kachachamim:

Hammafrish shete selaim. shekkach hu din asham, dichtiv baasham meilot (sham 5) beerkecha kesef shekalim beshekel hakkodesh leasham, vetargum shekalim selaim. vaasham gezelot vaasham taluy lemedim measham meilot bigzera shava, neemar kan beerkecha, veneemar lehallan beerkecha. vaasham shifcha charufa nammi, hoil vehu ayil, have af hu bechesef selaim kishlosha ashamot hallalu shehen ayil. aval asham metzora vaasham nazir divtarvayhu ketiv keves leasham, enan baim bechesef shekalim:

Im haya achad mehem yafe shete selaim. af al pi shebbishat haferasha lo haya yafe ella sela, im bishat kappara yafe shetayim, kasher, divma shehu shave bishat kappara azlinan, hilkach oto shehu yafe achshav bishat kappara shete selaim yikrav laashamo, veaf al pi shello kanahu mittechilla ella besela, vehashsheni yire, lefi shennikkach bimot asham uleshem asham, veyippelu damav lindava, dehachi kayma lan motar asham lindava:
Lakach bahem shene elim lechullin. laachila, maal bammaot veyatzu lechullin:
Yafe asara zuzim. kede shete selaim shemmaal bahen vechumshan, shehassela arbaa zuzim:
Hayyafe shete selaim yikrav laashamo. leshem oto asham shehifrish alav hammaot:

Vehashsheni limilato. mefaresh baggemara, lo sheyyakriv oto leasham, ella sheyyittenennu laggizbar bishvil shete selaim shehotzi lechullin, shennitchayyev bahen uvechumshan, shehem ben hakkeren vehachomesh asara zuzim. veyavi asham bishte selaim mibbeto lekarban meila:
Echad leasham veechad lechullin. lakach bishte selaim shehifrish shehayu kodesh, shene elim echad leasham veechad laachilat chullin, umaal besela:
Im haya shel asham yafe shete selaim yikrav laashamo. harishon, shehare lishmo nilkach mimmaot shennifreshu lo:
Vehashsheni. shehu chullin, yikrav limilato laasham meilot al shehotzi sela echad shel kodesh lechullin. uchegon deihu nammi yafe shete selaim, deen asham meilot pachut mishshete selaim kesef:
Veyavi immah sela vechumshah. keren shemmaal bo vechumshah, shehare sela hakkodesh hotzi lechullin:
Lechem happanim. hacha nammi lo garsinan beh lippasel belina, shehare neefa beerev shabbat veeno neechol ad lashshabbat haacheret:
Karvu habbezichin. hayenu machshirav, shebbeshabbat bishat silluk hallechem hayu makrivin habbezichin shel levona:
Veen bo meila. shehuttar lakkohanim venaaset mitzvato:

Hare ze yachazor veyafer. dahafara betaut lo haveya hafara ad sheyyechavven laishsha shennadra, dichtiv (Bamidbar 30) lo heni otah, ad shettihye hahafara leatzmah shel hannoderet. vegam sheyyechavven lanneder shennadra, dichtiv (sham) veshama aviha et nidrah, ad sheyyeda eze neder nadra:

Haomeret temea ani lach. beeshet kohen mayre, deneesra levaalah beones velo hifsida ketubbatah. veheeminuha chachamim leesor atzmah al baalah. vechevan deyotzet beget notelet ketubbatah, demissefer ketubbatah nilmod, lichshettinnasi leacher titteli ma shekkatuv lichi:

Hashshamayim beni uvenecha. mefaresh baggemara, deeno yore kachetz, kelomar devarim dekame shemayya galya veenah yechola levarer. umayre bevaa mechamat taana, deamra baina chutera leyada umara likvura, dei lav hachi, amrinan la zili, lo mippakdat apperiyya ureviyya:

Netula ani min hayyehudim. sheasra tashmish shel kol yisrael aleha. veaf al gav deamrinan beferek hammaddir hecha denadra ihi deyotza belo chetubba, dehi natna etzba ben shinneha, Rashi peresh bivamot [daf 112] kevan sheasra hanaat tashmish shel kol yisrael aleha vadday anusa hi ki kashe tashmish lah, vesavra mishna rishona daafillu devarim shebbeno levenah lo have, deefshar sheyyegarshenna:
Chazru lomar kulei. nitkalkelu haddorot vechashshu shehi meshakkeret lehafekia atzmah mittachat baalah:
Tavi reaya lidvareha. velo mehemninan lah beli reaya:
Yaasu derech bakkasha. yevakshu mimmenna shello tedabber od bo. uvayrushalmi mefaresh yaasu seuda vifayyes:
Yafer chelko utehe meshammashto. dahave devarim shebbeno levenah, umefer leatzmo:
Echad ilan serak. sheenah osa perot unetuin shelosha levet sea:
Im reuyin laasot. roin kol ilan veilan bifne atzmo im ilan shel teena kayyotze vo haya ose kikkar devela. velamma shiaru bitena, al shepperoteha gassin veosa harebe:
Letzarkan. melo ore vesallo chutza lo:

Hareni nazir min haggerogarot umin haddevela bet shammay omrim nazir. disvira lehu levet shammay en adam motzi devarav levattala, vechi amar hareni nazir addata delehave nazir kaamar, vechi hadar amar min haggerogarot umin haddevela, mahadar hu devae hadar beh, vaafillu betoch kede dibbur lo matze hadar beh, disvira lehu hekdesh betaut shemeh hekdesh velo shayyach beh sheela velo chazara, vehu haddin benazir dichtiv beh (Bamidbar 6) kadosh yihye, hilkach have nazir. uvet hillel savre hoil velo nadar kederech hannodrim lo have nazir, sheen nezirut min haggerogarot umin haddevela: amar rabbi yehuda af kesheamru vet shammay lo amru ella veomer hare hen alay karban. delo nechleku bet shammay uvet hillel leinyan nezirut delo have nazir. lo nechleku ella beomer belibbi haya sheyyihyu haggerogarot alay karban, bet shammay savre dahave nadur min haggerogarot, uvet hillel savre delo have nadur:
Eni yodea sheyyesh meferin. sheyyesh li reshut lehafer:
Yafer. bayyom shennoda lo sheyyesh lo reshut lehafer, shehu alav keyom shamo:
Eni yodea shezze neder. vetzarich hafara:
Rabbi meir omer lo yafer. dechevan sheyyodea sheyyesh beyado lehafer, af al pi shello yada shehu neder, mikkol makom haya lo lehafer. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Chattat haof safek. kegon sheyyalda veen yodim im min chiyyuv im min petur:
Mippene shemmachshirattah leechol bazzevachim. dimchusseret kappara hi missafek, veenah yechola leechol bakkadashim ad shettavi kapparatah:
Mishshennimleka noda lah. shello yalda:

Hare zo tikkaver. bedin hu demutteret bahanaa, dechullin gemurim hi, demishshum shennishchata baazara lekka lemesar, delo asra tora ella shechita, aval melika lo. aval rabbanan gazru daasura bahanaa shemma yomru nehenin mechattat haof safek. vechattat haof habbaa al hassafek enah neechelet, deshemma chullin hi unevela hi, dimlika nevela bechullin. vaasura nammi bahanaa, deshemma kodesh hi vekodesh sheeno neechol asur bahanaa:
Hare ellu mitztarfin. venechshavin keillu hen shel ish echad vechorshin kol bet sea bishvilan:
Vechamma yehe venehen. ben ilan leilan:
Kimlo vakar vechelav. tzemed bakar im haol, vehayenu arba ammot. aval pachot mikkan lemeakar kayme veen chorshin bishvilan:

Uvilvad shello yehe levalech reshut bahem. utenao kayyam, velo kana habbaal. veaf al gav divmattana zo matztzilo min hattorach, shehare ishto nizzonet min hammaot hallalu, umezonoteha hayu alav, atztzole mittircha enah chashuva hanaa:

Asham vadday eno chen. behahi lo pelige rabbanan deim noda lo ad shello shechato shello chata, yetze veyire baeder, detaama derabbanan beasham taluy kevan delibbo nokfo gamar umakdish missafek, aval asham vadday, kegon amru lo achalta kodesh venoda shello chata, shehuzammu haedim, i nammi kesavur kodesh achal venimtza chullin, iggallay milleta dehekdesh taut haya:
Hare ze yikkaver. kevan delo kaddish have kechullin shennishchatu baazara, ditunin kevura:

Nizrak haddam habbasar yetze levet hasserefa. baggemara mefaresh demi sheshshana leel hare ze yikkaver lo shana hacha habbasar yetze levet hasserefa, dechevan desavar asham vadday chullin hu velo kaddish leolam, eno nisraf ella nikbar:
Shor hanniskal eno chen. keasham taluy, dehacha lo pelige rabbanan sheim noda shello harag yetze veyire baeder:

Egla arufa enah ken. keasham taluy, sheim ad shello neerfa nimtza hahoreg, tetze vetire baeder. verambam peresh, shor hanniskal eno chen keasham vadday, deasham vadday mishshennishchat hare ze yikkaver, veshor hanniskal keshennoda leachar shenniskal muttar bahanaa. veegla arufa enah ken keshor hanniskal, deshor hanniskal im noda mishshenniskal muttar bahanaa, veegla arufa im noda hahoreg mishshenneerfa haegla tikkaver bimkomah:
Kippera sefekah. bishat arifa, shehare adayin safek haya, vehalcha lah. hilkach asura bahanaa, vetikkaver kedin kol haeglot haarufot:
Chaticha shel chelev vachaticha shel chelev kodesh kulei‏ mevi chattat. demimma nafshach chelev achal:
Rabbi akiva omer. af asham taluy kachattat (uleshon Rashi im hachattat), mishshum sefek meilot. veen halacha kerabbi akiva:
Mevi shete chattaot. vehu sheachalan bishte helemot. sheim lo hayta sham yedia bentayim, eno chayyav ella achat:
Ze mevi asham taluy vechulei. musaf al hachattat shehu tzarich lehavi mishshum ochel chelev mevi asham taluy mishshum sefek meilot:
Ushenehem meviin asham echad. beshuttafut, umatnin:
Rabbi yose omer kulei. vetanna kamma rabbi yose hu vahalacha kemoto:
Mavrichin. koffim zemorat haggefen baaretz umechassim otah beafar:
Markivim. meviim anaf shel ilan umarkivin oto al gav ilan acher shehu mimmino:

Pachot mishsheloshim yom. baggemara bemassechet rosh hashshana mochiach dahanach sheloshim yom diklita letanna kamma, ushelosha yamim derabbi yehuda, ushete shabbatot derabbi yose verabbi shimon, tzerichin kodem sheloshim yom detosefet sheviit, devainan shettiklot hannetia kodem tosefet sheviit, vechulehu sevira lehu tosefet sheviit sheloshim yom, hilkach letanna kamma deamar en kelita pechuta mishsheloshim yom tzarich sheloshim diklita usheloshim detosefet, lerabbi yehuda deamar bishlosha yamim have kelita tzarich shelosha diklita usheloshim detosefet, ledivre rabbi yose verabbi shimon deamre shete shabbatot tzarich shete shabbatot liklita usheloshim letosefet. uferush kelita shettehe hannetia nikletet veneechezet besharasheha baaretz. vahalacha kerabbi yose verabbi shimon:

Maase veishsha achat vechulei. matnitin chissure michassera vehachi katane, im haya shikkor veamar hareni nazir mimmennu, eno nazir, shello haya dato ella leesor oto hakkos alav vilvad, vechi hechi delo leyte leh kos acharina amar hareni nazir. umaase nammi veishsha achat shikkora vechulei:

Sachin et happaggim. perot shello nigmar bishshulan sachin otan beshemen keshehen mechubbarim lailan lemaher bishshulan. ufeamim shemmenakkevim otan umesimim shemen betoch hannekev, i nammi menakkevim happaggim kede sheyyikkansu vahem geshamim veyitbashshelu mehera:

Pagge erev sheviit. perot sheen mitbashshelim ad tishre shel sheviit, en sachin veen menakkevin otan bashshishshit, meachar sheen nigmar bishshulan ad shettikkanes sheviit. vaafillu bemakom shennahagu shello lasuch asar tanna kamma. verabbi yehuda maflig ben makom shennahagu lasuch lemakom shello nahagu lasuch, divmakom shello nahagu lasuch lo mechazya sicha avoda veshare:

Rabbi shimon mattir bailan. shehu male perot sheviit, laasot bo melacha bemotzae sheviit, mippene shehu rashshay baavodat hailan af al pi shehapperot kedoshim bikdushshat sheviit. vahalacha ketanna kamma:
Kol kinnuye nezirut. davar sheeno ikkaro shel shem mikkere kinnuy. kemo hammechanne shem lachavero [bava metzia noach:]:

Haomer ehe. lav kinnuy hu, ella yad mikkere, kemo bet yad shehakkeli neechaz bo kach hanneder nitpas belashon ze. umatnitin chasure michassera vehachi katane, kol kinnuye nezirut kinzirut vechol yedot nezirut kinzirut, ellu hen yedot nezirut, haomer ehe, ehe nave, veellu hen kinnuye nezirut, nazik naziach paziach:
Haomer ehe. sheraa nazir over lefanav veamar ehe, af al pi shello amar ehe kaze, im nitkavven lihyot nazir kemoto hare ze nazir, veaf al pi shello hotzi befiv kaze:

Ehe nave. shehaya tofes bisaro veamar ehe nave, mashma eheye nae begiddul sear ze. veim nitkavven leshem kach hare ze nazir veaf al pi shello peresh, sheellu vechayyotze bahem yadot linzirut hem vahavu kinzirut:
Nazik naziach paziach. leshonot shel goyim hem shekkorin kach lannazir, uleshonam karov lallashon shel yisrael, umekoro kinnuye nezirut:
Hareni kaze. veromez lannazir shekkenegdo:
Hareni mesalsel hareni mechalkel hare alay leshallach pera. vechullehu davka keshettofes bisaro vedato linzirut:
Mesalsel. machlik bassear:
Mechalkel. megaddel sear. vedugmato, mishshettechalkel haatara [nidda nov:], mishsheyyigdal sear haerva:
Hare alay tzipporim. shete torim o shene vene yona, vehem karban nazir shennitma. uchegon shennazir over lefanav:
Rabbi meir omer nazir. hoil venazir over lefanav vetzipporim karban nazir shennitma hem, mochichin haddevarim dahare alay tzipporim linzirut kaamar:
Vachachamim omrim eno nazir. vahalacha kachachamim, sheeno nazir, aval mevi tzipporim leshallem nidro:

Hareni nazir kisar roshi vechaafar haaretz vechulei‏ hare ze nezir olam. velo nezir olam mammash, deillu nezir olam megalleach echad lishnem asar chodesh veze megalleach achat lishloshim yom, hoil vetala neziruto bidvarim chalukim, have keillu nadar beminyan neziriyyotav keminyan sear rosho vaafar haaretz, ma sheen ken binzir olam shello chalak neziriyyot shello ella naasa hakkol nezirut achat:

Rabbi omer en ze megalleach achat lishloshim yom. dechevan deamar hareni nazir, hakkol nezirut achat hi veeno megalleach ella lishnem asar chodesh kinzir olam. veezehu megalleach lishloshim yom, haomer hare alay nezirut kisar roshi, deaz mochiach dinziriyyot mufsakot kibbel alav keminyan sear rosho. veen halacha kerabbi:
Netiot. yeladot, velizkenot kare ilan, vehacha ka mashma lan deaf al gav dishlosha ilanot levet sea karuy sede ilan vechorshin kol bet sea bishvilan, bintiot yeladot en chorshin ad sheyyihyu asara:
Shurot. shennetuot bemakom echad kechoma veenan mefuzzarot:
En chorshin ella letzarkan. mishshum dichshemmefuzzarot nire kechoresh letzorech hailan, aval hecha dekayme bemakom echad nire kimtakken et haaretz letzorech sheviit velo letzorech hailanot:
Shura. targum choma shura:
Atara. gader saviv:

Kevasim kodmim laizzim. bechol ducheta hikdim hakkatuv kevasim laizzim, dichtiv (Shemot 12) min hakkevasim umin haizzim tikkachu, vechen (Bamidbar 15) o lasse vakkevasim o vaizzim. yachol, haomer hare alay ola veyesh lo keves veez yavi keves davka:
Talmud lomar veim keves yavi karbano. uleel minneh ketiv vehevi et karbano seirat izzim, kan hikdim ez lakkeves, lelammed sheshshenehem shekulim vee ze mehen sheyyirtze yavi:
Torim kodmin livne yona. divrov mekomot ketiv beresha torim vahadar bene yona:
Im zacha habben lifne harav. sherov chachmato lamad mimmennu:

Kodem et haav. bechol makom, kegon lehashiv aveda velifdot mibbet hashshevi ulehachayot velifrok immo. veim aviv talmid chacham af al pi sheeno shakul keneged rabbo, aviv kodem lerabbo, vaafillu rabbo muvhak:
Ad sheyyihyu mishshelosha vead tisha. kelomar din ze sheamarnu hayenu mishshelosha vead tisha, aval im hayu asara o yoter af al pi sheenan osin chorshin:

Shenneemar becharish uvakkatzir tishbot. aresha kae ditnan en chorshin lahen ella letzarkan. uminnayin sheen chorshin kol habbet sea, shenneemar becharish uvakkatzir tishbot, veim eno inyan leshabbat bereshit shekkevar neemar (Shemot 20) sheshet yamim taavod veasita kol melachtecha, velo lishmitta shekkevar neemar (Vayikra 25) shesh shanim tizra sadecha veshesh shanim tizmor karmecha, tenehu inyan leesor shene ferakim shel erev sheviit, mippesach lisde lavan, umeatzeret lisde ilan. vehachi kaamar kera, becharish shekketziro asur veeze ze charish shel erev sheviit shennichnas lashsheviit, tishbot. uvakkatzir shecharisho asur veeze ze katzir shel sheviit sheyyotze lemotzae sheviit, nammi tishbot, shessefichim sheggadlu bashsheviit o sheavar vezara bashsheviit asur lekatzram bashsheminit:

Rabbi yishmael omer. leolam beshabbat mishtae kera kefashteh, vaata leashmeinan me charish reshut, sheen lecha charish shel mitzva, af katzir deamar rachamana tishbot bekatzir shel reshut, yatza ketzir haomer shehu mitzva devainan ketzira lishmah, shezze doche et hashshabbat:
Venolad lo ven hare ze nazir. devilshon bene adam lo mikre ben ella zachar, velo nekeva velo tumtum veanderoginos. uvalad mikre afillu nekeva vetumtum veanderoginos:

Chattat haof safek. haishsha sheyyalda sefek min petur sefek min chiyyuv, mevia keves leola, umatna, im min chiyyuv yehe lechova, veim min petur yehe lindava. aval chattat mevia besafek veenah neechelet, shemma chullin hi umelikat chullin nevela:
Taasenna vadday. veteachel lakkohanim kishar chattaot:
Shemmimmin shehi mevia. shehare perida achat min hattorim o min bene hayyona hi mevia lechattat, ben vadday yoledet ben al safek yoledet:
Ad ematay, sede hallavan. sade shel tevua vekitnit sheen bo ilan:
Hallecha. lachluchit hakkarka mechamat haggeshamim:
Mikshaot umidlaot. kishshuim udeluim. aval mishsham veelech mechaze kimtakken sadehu letzorech sheviit:
Natatta torat kol echad beyado. ze omer kalta lecha betoch shelli veze omer lo chalta lecha betoch shelli:
Ella bisde lavan. sheatid lezarah achar hacharisha vetzarich shettehe rov lecha kayyemet, en chorshim ella ad happesach:

Usede ilan. shehi netua kevar en tzarich shettehe rov lecha kayyemet sheen chorshin otah ella kede sheyyerdu haggeshamim beomek hakkarka, hilkach chorshim bah ad haatzeret. vechol hammishnayot hallalu dechuyot hen kidamrinan leel beferek kamma sherabban gamliel uvet dino nimnu al shene ferakim hallalu shehem pesach vaatzeret uvittelum, umuttar lacharosh ad rosh hashshana shel sheviit:
Ad sheyyachollu. ad sheyyetzu lechullin bashshana harviit al yede pidyon, veim lo fedaan bashshana harviit, ad sheyyeasu chullin mealehen bashshana hachamishshit:
Netia kishmah. bat shenatah keruya netia vetu lo. perush acher kishmah kol zeman shebbene adam korin lah netia veen korin lah ilan. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
Shennigmam. shennechtach:
Chalifin. giddulim, leshon gizo machalif:
Kintia. ben leinyan charisha ben leinyan arla. vahalacha kerabbi shimon:
Haorez. belaaz 510:
Vedochan. 96:
Vehapperagin. keen rimmon male zera vehazzera shello mekashkesh betocho, vekorin lo baaravi 640 uvelaaz 379:
Vehashshumshemin. kemin zera aroch, uveeretz yisrael mimmennu harebe, vekorin lo baaravi 206:
Mitasserim lesheavar. kemaasar shana sheavra, im hayta shana rishona usheniyya shel shemitta, maaser sheni, veim shelishit maasar ani:
Umuttarin bashsheviit. kevan shehishrishu beshana shishshit lifne rosh hashshana shel sheviit en bahem kedushshat sheviit:

Umitasserin leshana habbaa. kishnat lekitatan, kevan divotah shana hishrishu. veim hi shana sheviit en mitasserin kelal veyesh lahen kedushshat sheviit. af al gav divilan azlinan batar chanata, uveyarak batar lekita, uvitvua vezetim batar shelish, kelomar kesheyyaviu shelish bishshulan az nitchayyevu bemaasrot, mikkol makom beorez vedochan uferagin veshumshemin deen loktim otam keechad veen meviim shelish bishshulam keechad, en holchim bahem ella achar hasherasha, divshana achat mashreshet kol hassade, shehare bevat achat zorim otam:
Shel masseoy shenayim shenayim. sheyyesh bechol achat mehen masseoy shene vene adam:
Hare ellu yinnatelu. kullan vaafillu hakketannot shebbahen, velo mitchaze kimfanne haggader laasot mekomo sade:
Pachot mikkan mechatztzev. veeno notlo kullo ella gommo umanniach min hassela baaretz tefach kede shello yehe rauy lizria:
Bamme devarim amurim. hay delo yiftach machtzev vehay degommo:
Ma shehu rotze yittol. delo mechaze kimtakken sade kevan delav dideh hu, vaafillu beshello nammi lo mechaze kimtakken sade im hitchil littol meerev sheviit:
Setam nezirut sheloshim yom. dichtiv (Bamidbar 6) kadosh yihye. yihye begimatriyya sheloshim, mikkan samchu lomar sheen nezirut pachot mishsheloshim yom:

Hareni nazir achat gedola. ben sheamar hareni nazir nezirut achat gedola, ben sheamar hareni nazir achat ketanna, uven sheamar hareni nazir achat mikkan vead sof haolam, noheg nezirut sheloshim yom. umikkan vead sof haolam dekaamar hachi mashma, arukka alay zot hannezirut keillu hi mikkan vead sof haolam: hachi garsinan hareni nazir veyom echad hareni nazir veshaa echat hareni nazir achat umechetza hare ze nazir shetayim. vehachi perusho, amar hareni nazir veyom echad kevan sheamar hareni nazir kibbel alav nezirut achat, vechi amar tu veyom echad hare yesh kan nezirut acheret, deen nezirut pachot mishsheloshim yom. vechen nammi ki amar hareni nazir veshaa achat vahareni nazir achat umechetza, yesh kan shete nezirut, shei efshar lihyot nazir shaa achat o mechetza nezirut shello yihye nazir sheloshim yom, umishshum hachi hare ze nazir shetayim umegalleach lesof sheloshim venoheg nezirut acheret: hareni nazir sheloshim yom veshaa echat, hare ze nazir sheloshim veechad yom, sheen nezirut leshaot. shenneemar (sham) yeme nizro, vahare hu keillu amar sheloshim veechad yom. velo amrinan deshaa achat deamar haveya nezirut bifne atzma, hoil veyesh letzarfah im minyan sheloshim shehizkir techilla:

[Ze megalleach nazir shalem] veze megalleach nazir shalem divre rabbi meir. rabbi meir letameh desavar tefos lashon rishon, vechi amar hare alay legalleach, tiglachat shelema kaamar, vechi hadar kaamar chatzi nazir, lav kol kemineh lemehadar beh afillu toch kede dibbur. verabbanan savre neder ufitcho immo hu, vehave keomer chatzi karbanot shel nazir alay, sheeno chayyav ella chatzi karbanot shel nazir. vahalacha kachachamim:
Hareni nazir venazir lichsheyyihye li ven. mi shekkibbel alav nezirut setam, veod kibbel alav nezirut acheret kesheyyihye lo ben:
Mashlim et shello. techilla, umegalleach umevi karban, veachar kach mone et shel beno:
Hareni nazir kesheyyihye li ven venazir. shekkibbel alav techilla nezirut beno:
Vehitchil mone et shello veachar kach nolad lo ven. kodem sheyyishlemu sheloshim yom:
Manniach et shello umone et shel beno. dechevan shekkibbel alav nezirut beno techilla, miyyad keshennolad lo ben tzarich lehanniach et shello velimnot shel beno, veachar kach mashlim et shello:
Emure kadashim kallim. en moalim beemure kadashim kallim ella leachar zerikat damim, kidamrinan beshilhe firkin. veim yatzu lifne zerikat damim,

Rabbi eliezer omer en moalin bahen. dechi hechi deit leh lerabbi eliezer deen zerika moelet layyotze leappoke vesar kadshe kadashim mimmeila, hachi nammi en moelet layyotze lehavi emure kadashim kallim lide meila. vechi hechi deit leh lerabbi akiva dizrika moelet layyotze leappoke vesar kadshe kadashim mide meila, moelet nammi layyotze lehavi emure kadashim kallim lide meila:
Baot mikkol makom. afillu mittoch shello, demeda yedia dilvinyan kavae lehu velo letakken et hassade:

Vehakkabbelan. shekkibbel sade baarisut mevi mikkol makom, vaafillu meotah sade shehu aris bah, afillu avanim ketannot, sheen [sade zo chashuva keshello. veyesh mefarshim vehakkabbelan sheddarko livnot binyanim bekibbolet, sheen] kavvanato ella lekabbetz avanim, mevi [mikkol makom vaafillu missade] shello:
Rabbi yose omer kulei. vahalacha kerabbi yose:

Chayyavin lehavi leachar yom hakkippurim. deamar kera (Vayikra 16) mikkol chattotechem lifne Adonai‏ titharu, chet sheen makkir bo ella hammakom dehaynu shello noda lo shechata, yom hakkippurim mechapper. aval chet deikka deyada beh chutz min hammakom, en yom hakkippurim mechapper:
Hippila ishto. velo yada i bar keyama hu i nefel hu:
Eno nazir. umatnitin rabbi yehuda hi deamar lo machet eynish nafsheh assefeka, vechi amar kesheyyihye li valad, al valad vadday kaamar:

Rabbi shimon omer yomar im haya ven keyama vechulei. rabbi shimon savar sefek nezirut lehachemir, hilkach tzarich lihyot nazir missafek, umatne veomer im ben keyama hu hareni nezir chova, veim lav hareni nezir nedava, umegalleach umevi karbenotav lesof sheloshim yom. uvelo tenay lo haya yachol lehavi karban missafek. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:

Chazra veyalda hare ze nazir. shehare lo nahag nezirut mechamat hannefel, veachshav sheyyalda valad shel keyama chala nezirut. uledivre rabbi shimon tzarich lachzor ulehatnot, deshemma harishon haya valad shel keyama:
Im amar achat gedola nadarti. nezirut achat kibbalti veniret li gedola kimlo habbayit, nazir sheloshim yom:
Veim amar setam nadarti. velo haya belibbi ella kemo sheyyadunu chachamim leshoni, hare ze nazir kol yamav umegalleach kol shenem asar chodesh:
Shete hallechem. shemmeviin baatzeret:

Karmu fene hallechem battannur. hayenu techillat tikkunan, vehahi kerima vattannur chashiva hechsher lippasel bitvul yom umechussar kippurim kishchita dekadshe kadashim. vehacha lo garsinan uvelina, mishshum dishte hallechem neefot meerev yom tov, sheen afiyyatan docha et hayyom tov, veneechalot lemachar beyom tov. vehuchsheru lishchot alehen et hazzevach, dechevan dekarmu faneha keruya lechem:
Veen bahen meila. sheyyesh bahen sheat hetter lakkohanim uchevar naaset mitzvatan:
Chattat echat. umatne ze im ze kidfareshna leel:
En shenayim meviin chattat echat. aval asham taluy mayte kol chad vechad, mishshum chatichat hachelev. vehayenu tanna kamma. veha kamashma lan detanna kamma rabbi yose hu, vahalacha kemoto:

Amar, amra fara zo hareni nezira im omedet ani. mi shehayta parato revutza veenah rotza laamod, veamar, para zo sevura shello taamod veomeret belibbah hareni nezira im omedet ani, vaani omer hareni nazir mimmenna im lo taamod. vechen delet neula sheenah yechola lehippatach, veamar, sevura delet zo shello eftechennah veomeret hareni nezira im niftachat ani, vaani omer hareni nazir mimmenna im lo tippatach. veachar kach amda para zo meeleha o sheheemiduha acherim velo heemidah hu, vechen haddelet niftecha meeleha o ba acher ufetachah velo fetachah hu:

Bet shammay omrim hare ze nazir. deazle letaamayhu deamre bannoder min haggerogarot umin haddevela shehu nazir af al pi sheen nezirut min haggerogarot umin haddevela, hachi nammi af al pi sheen nezirut min habbehema umin haddelet, hare ze nazir. veaf al pi sheamda habbehema veniftecha haddelet, lo hayta dato ella sheyyaamidennah o yiftechennah hu beatzmo:

Uvet hillel omrim. ledivrehem devet shammay. ledidan afillu im lo amda kelal lo have nazir, mippene shennadar shello kederech hannodrim, sheen nezirut min habbehema umin haddelet, ella ledidchu deamrittu sheen adam motzi devarav levattala vechi amar hareni nazir addata deleheve nazir kaamar, odu lan mihat hecha deamda meeleha o acherim heemiduha delo have nazir, shehare hu lo amar ella im lo taamod vahare amda:

Amar rabbi yehuda vechulei. lo nechleku bet shammay al bet hillel leinyan nezirut delo have nazir. lo nechleku ella beomer belibbi haya shettihye behema zo karban bashshaa sheamarti sheeheye nazir mimmenna im lo taamod. devet shammay savre hoil velo heemidah hu haveya karban, uvet hillel savre hoil veamda enah karban:
Tesha nearot nidrehen kayyamim. nearot lav davka:

Bogeret vehi yetoma. shennisset umet baalah keshehi naara, vehi yetoma bechayye haav, sheachar shennisset en leaviha reshut bah, uvagra achar kach venadra, nidrah kayyam, sheen haav yachol lehafer, shehare hi bogeret, veod shehi yetoma bechayye haav:
Naara uvagra vehi yetoma. shennisset umet baalah. shennadra keshehi naara uvagra leachar mikkan, vehi yetoma bechayye haav kidfarishna:
Naara. beshaa shennadra, shello bagra adayin, vehi yetoma bechayye haav. vehanach telata, yetoma bechayye av kayla lehu:
Bogeret umet aviha. shebbeshaa shennadra hayta bogeret umet aviha, dehaynu yetoma mammash:
Naara uvogeret vechulei. vehanach telata nammi, met aviha kayel lehu:
Naara shemmet aviha umishshemmet aviha bagara kulei. hanach telata dekatane, bogeret kayla lehu. uvaggemara amrinan, dachachamim lo shanu ella shalosh nearot, bogeret vitoma vitoma bechayye haav:
Rabbi yehuda omer kulei. dechevan shennichnesa lachuppa yatzata mershut aviha behanehu nissuim:

Yater mikkan. mishshalosh [ashpot] muttar. vehayenu derabbi shimon deresha, vehasheta ata leashmeinan deshare rabbi shimon afillu en eser mashpelot, uvilvad shello yihye vah pachot mishshalosh, deaf al pi sheyyesh meat zevel baashpa vesalka datach amena demode rabbi shimon deim mosif haashpot nire kimzabbel, ka mashma lan delo mechaze kimzabbel hoil veeno mefazzero:
Ad sheyyaamik shelosha. sheyyaamik mekom haashpa o yagbiah mishshear hakkarka shelosha tefachim, sheyyihye nikkar delichnos hazzevel lemakom echad hu ose velo lezabbel et hassade:

Ose adam et zivlo otzar. otam shalosh ashpot shel sheloshim mashpelot yachol laasot otam ashpa achat ulehosif alehem kemo sheyyirtze, delo tema ki hechi deasur yoter mishshalosh ashpot levet sea hachi nammi asur yoter mishshiur shalosh ashpot bemakom echad:
Rabbi meir oser. bayrushalmi muchach divyoter mikkashshiur bilvad asar rabbi meir. aval bechashshiur, hasheta bishlosha mekomot muttar, bemakom echad lo kol shekken. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Haya lo davar muat. sheen lo lehotzi befaam achat kashshiur hameforash leel, motzi oto meat umosif alav veholech:
Rabbi elazar ben azarya oser. shemma lo yihye lo zevel yoter venire kimzabbel sadehu, ad sheyyotzi eser mashpelot keachat:
O ad sheyyaamik shelosha o yagbiah shelosha. shekkevan sheoto makom meshunne mishshear hassade lo mechaze kimzabbel, vechen im netano al hassela sheeno rauy lizria:
Hareni nazir vealay legalleach nazir. kibbel alav nezirut, veod kibbel alav lehavi karbanot al nazir acher, uva chavero gam hu veamar ken:
Im hayu fikkechim. kol echad poter et chavero bekarbenotav, veaf al pi shebbashshaa shennadar harishon legalleach nazir akkatti lo have hashsheni nazir:
Maase damim. zo zerikat haddam:
Veen moalin babbasar. leachar zerikat damim en moalin babbasar, dichvar yesh bo sheat hetter lakkohanim. vehayenu lehakel, demishshum zerikat damim atya leh kulla deen moalin bo:
Veal ze veal ze. ben al haemurin ben al habbasar leachar zerika:
Chayyavin mishshum piggul. im piggel beachat mearba avodot. dizrika kovaat befiggul vekava nammi lenotar vetame. vehayenu lehachemir:
Uvekadashim kallim. leachar zerika:
Kullo lehachemir. demoalin baemurim, dichvar chazu legavoah vekadashim ninhu velo mamon bealim:
Veal ze veal ze. ben al haemurim ben al habbasar chayyavin alav mishshum piggul notar vetame. vehayenu chullo lehachemir:
Lehaamik ad hassela. velo chayshinan dilma mimllach vezara leh, sheen derech bene adam lizroa samuch lirshut harabbim. aval beno leven chavero chayshinan dilma mimllach vezara leh, veasur:
Tzovro birshut harabbim. veachar kach notlo mishsham umetakken et reshut harabbim kemo shehaya:

Keshem sheen mekalkelim reshut harabbim kach lo yetakken. kelomar lo mibbaya litzbor afaro lirshut harabbim shehu asur af al pi sheyyesirennu achar kach, shehare mekalkel hu leshaa, ella afillu letakken asur, kegon im hayu avanim o afar mefuzzarim birshut harabbim lo yitzberem bemakom echad, ella yesallekam legamre mershut harabbim, vehayenu dekaamar keshem sheen mekalkelin reshut harabbim litzbor afaro lirshut harabbim af al pi sheddato lesalleko miyyad, kach lo yetakken litzbor avanim o afar hamefuzzarim birshut harabbim velasum otam betzidde reshut harabbim lefi shaa, ella yesallekam miyyad legamre mikkol reshut harabbim veyotziem layyam o lannahar:
Ma yaase beafar. allibba derabbi akiva:
Tzovro betoch sadehu kederech hamezabbelim. shalosh ashpot levet sea:

Vechen hachofer bor shiach umeara. bishar yemot hashshana, pelige vah rabbi yehoshua verabbi akiva. lerabbi yehoshua tzovro birshut harabbim, uvilvad sheyyesallekennu achar kach vitakken reshut harabbim kemo shehaya, ulerabbi akiva af al pi sheddato letakken asur, ella tzovro birshuto. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:
En moalin babbasar. deha yesh bo hetter lakkohanim, divsar chattat veasham vezivche shalme tzibbur neechol lakkohanim:
Aval moalin baemurim. sheen bahen hetter lakkohanim:
Veen moalin beorah. delakkohanim hi, kedichtiv (sham 7) or haola asher hikriv lakkohen lo yihye:
Aval moalin babbasar. kol zeman shehu nisraf al gabbe hammizbeach. dechalil hu:
Ad shettetze levet haddeshen. shemmerimim kol haefer meal hammizbeach umashlichim oto levet haddeshen. veshuv en bah meila, shekkevar naaset mitzvatah:
Hikshu. nityabbeshu venaasu kashin:
Asur lekayyeman bashsheviit. shepperot sheviit asur lehannichan lezera:
Hattemarot. hatztzitz kodem sheyyippatach dome litmara, vechamohu niktam rosho vealta vo temara beferek lulav haggazul [sukka log.]. perush acher temarot keen lulave gefanim:

Marbitzin beafar lavan. kelomar mashkim sede lavan. vechen halacha shemmashkim sede lavan erev sheviit kede sheyyetzu yerakot bashsheviit, velo od ella shemmashkim oto bashsheviit kede sheyyetzu yerakot lemotzae sheviit:
Memarsin baorez. mashkin afar haorez umearvin oto bemayim, kemo netano lammemares beyoma [perek 4‏ mishna 3]:
Aval lo mechassechin. sheen chotchim healin shel haorez, targum lo tizmor lo techassach. vahalacha kerabbi shimon:
Shezzizeatan hammacharesha. vaafillu lo zizeatan ella sheatida lezazean have keillu zizeatan:
Hare ellu yinnatelu. kullan aggav otam shetayim:
Hamesakkel sadehu. shemmesallek haavanim min hassade, leshon sakkelu meeven (yeshaya sav):
Umanniach et hattachtonot hannogot baaretz. devichhay gavna lo mechaze kimtakken sade:
Garger shel tzerorot. gal shel avanim ketannot:
Im yesh tachtehen sela o kash. lo mechaze kimtakken kevan deen hammakom rauy lizria:
Mitnaddev adam asham taluy. dechol atzmo shel asham taluy nedava hu. dei salka datach chova hu, ki mityeda leh shechata ammay mayte chattat, ella shema minna nedava hu:
Chutz meachar yom hakkippurim. dishar yemot hashshana hu deikka lemechash bisfek shum chet shemma asa o lav, aval hasheta lekka lemechash, deha kipper yom hakkippurim:

Vachachamim omrim en meviin asham taluy. dehaynu taama demayte asham taluy mikkamme demityeda leh, lehagen alav min hayyissurim ad sheyyivvada lo, shehattora chasa al gufo shel yisrael, veen asham taluy ba bindava. vahalacha kachachamim:
Konam sheeni osa al pi abba. hekdesh yehe kol ma sheani osa millavo al pi abba, kelomar, shello yuchal abba lehanot mimmaase yaday:
Eno yachol lehafer. sheen ze devarim shebbeno levenah. uveha modu chulle alma sheoseret hanaatah al peloni en habbaal mefer. vechen halacha:
Al picha eno tzarich lehafer. mishshum dimshabeda leh. veaf al gav dehekdesh motzi mide shibud, allemuha rabbanan leshibuda devaal sheen hakkonam mafkia shibudo:

Yafer shemma tadif alav yoter min harauy lo. vehahekdesh chal al hachelek haodef sheeno tachat shibudo, lefichach tzarich lehafer, vehahafara moelet bo mishshum dahave devarim shebbeno levenah, shei efshar shello yitarev oto haodef beshel baalah:

Rabbi yochanan ben nuri amar yafer shemma yegarshenna. veikkar maase yadeha tzarich hafara, shemma yegarshenna veyippaka shibudeh devaal veaz yachul hanneder utehe asura lachazor lo. vahalacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri, uveomeret yekuddeshu yaday leosehem, deyadayim itanhu baolam vechal alehem hekdesh:
Veneder almana ugerusha kulei. legufeh lo tzerich kera, dechevan deen lah baal mi yafer, ella keshennadra keshehi almana lizman, velo higgia zeman hanneder ad shennisset:
Eno yachol lehafer. af al pi shehanneder chal keshehi tachtav, devatar sheat hanneder azlinan:
Nadra vo vayyom, gershah bo vayyom, vehechzirah bo vayyom. veachar kach shama et nidrah:
Eno yachol lehafer. kevan sheyyatzat lirshut atzmah ben neder lahafara. deen habbaal mefer bekodmin:
